declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.fromMatrixT_basis_repr
declarations.statement:
lemma fromMatrixT_basis_repr (c0 c1 : C) (M : Matrix (basisIdx c0) (basisIdx c1) k)
    (φ : ComponentIdx ![c0, c1]) :
    (basis ![c0, c1]).repr (fromMatrixT (S := S) c0 c1 M) φ = M (φ 0) (φ 1)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix
declarations.doc:
The component matrix of a rank-two tensor: the `(x, y)` entry is
`repr t (ComponentIdx.pair.symm (x, y))`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def toMatrix {cs : Fin 2 → C} (t : S.Tensor cs) :
    Matrix (basisIdx (cs 0)) (basisIdx (cs 1)) k

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma toMatrix_apply {cs : Fin 2 → C} (t : S.Tensor cs)
    (x : basisIdx (cs 0)) (y : basisIdx (cs 1)) :
    toMatrix t x y = (basis cs).repr t (ComponentIdx.pair.symm (x, y))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix_apply_cons
declarations.doc:
`toMatrix_apply` at a `cons` colour list `![c0, c1]`, where the labels are named by the
colours.
declarations.statement:
lemma toMatrix_apply_cons {c0 c1 : C} (t : S.Tensor ![c0, c1])
    (x : basisIdx c0) (y : basisIdx c1) :
    toMatrix t x y = (basis ![c0, c1]).repr t (ComponentIdx.pair.symm (x, y))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix_fromMatrixT
declarations.statement:
lemma toMatrix_fromMatrixT (c0 c1 : C) (M : Matrix (basisIdx c0) (basisIdx c1) k) :
    toMatrix (fromMatrixT (S := S) c0 c1 M) = M

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.fromMatrixT_toMatrix
declarations.statement:
lemma fromMatrixT_toMatrix {c0 c1 : C} (t : S.Tensor ![c0, c1]) :
    fromMatrixT (S := S) c0 c1 (toMatrix t) = t

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix_injective
declarations.doc: Rank-two tensors with equal component matrices are equal.
declarations.statement:
lemma toMatrix_injective {cs : Fin 2 → C} :
    Function.Injective (toMatrix (S := S) (cs := cs))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix_permT_swap
declarations.doc: Swapping the two slots of a rank-two tensor transposes its component matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma toMatrix_permT_swap {c c1 : Fin 2 → C} (h0 : c 1 = c1 0) (h1 : c 0 = c1 1)
    (t : S.Tensor c) :
    toMatrix (permT ![1, 0] (IsReindexing.swap_of_eq h0 h1) t) =
      (toMatrix t).transpose.submatrix (basisIdxCongr h0.symm) (basisIdxCongr h1.symm)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.fromTripleT
declarations.doc:
The construction of a tensor with two indices from the tensor product
`V c1 ⊗[k] V c2 ` defined
categorically.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def fromTripleT {c1 c2 c3 : C} :
    V c1 ⊗[k] (V c2 ⊗[k] V c3) →ₗ[k] S.Tensor ![c1, c2, c3]

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.fromTripleT_tmul
declarations.statement:
lemma fromTripleT_tmul {c1 c2 c3 : C} (x : V c1)
    (y : V c2) (z : V c3) :
    fromTripleT (x ⊗ₜ[k] (y ⊗ₜ[k] z)) =
    permT id (And.intro Function.bijective_id (fun i => by fin_cases i <;> rfl))
      (prodT (fromSingleT (S := S) x) (prodT (fromSingleT y) (fromSingleT z)))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.actionT_fromTripleT
declarations.statement:
lemma actionT_fromTripleT {c1 c2 c3 : C}
    (x : V c1 ⊗[k] (V c2 ⊗[k] V c3)) (g : G) :
    g • fromTripleT (S := S) x = fromTripleT (TensorProduct.map (rep c1 g)
      (TensorProduct.map (rep c2 g) (rep c3 g)) x)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.fromTripleT_basis_repr
declarations.statement:
lemma fromTripleT_basis_repr {c c1 c2 : C}
    (x : V c ⊗[k] (V c1 ⊗[k] V c2))
    (φ : ComponentIdx ![c, c1, c2]) :
    (basis ![c, c1, c2]).repr (fromTripleT (S := S) x) φ =
    (Basis.tensorProduct (b c) (Basis.tensorProduct (b c1) (b c2))).repr x
    (φ 0, φ 1, φ 2)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.fromTripleT_apply_basis
declarations.statement:
lemma fromTripleT_apply_basis {c c1 c2 : C}
    (b0 : basisIdx c) (b1 : basisIdx c1)
    (b2 : basisIdx c2) :
    fromTripleT (S := S) (b c b0 ⊗ₜ[k] (b c1 b1 ⊗ₜ[k] b c2 b2)) =
    Tensor.basis ![c, c1, c2] (fun | 0 => b0 | 1 => b1 | 2 => b2)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.fromConstTriple
declarations.doc: A constant three tensor (e.g. the Pauli matrices).
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def fromConstTriple {c1 c2 c3 : C}
    (v : (Representation.trivial k G k).IntertwiningMap
      ((rep c1).tprod ((rep c2).tprod (rep c3)))) :
  S.Tensor ![c1, c2, c3]

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.actionT_fromConstTriple
declarations.doc: Tensors formed by `fromConstPair` are invariant under the group action.

modules.title: Contractions on tensors
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

This file defines tensor contraction for an arbitrary `TensorSpecies`.

The colors of a tensor record the type of each index. A pair of positions can be
contracted when their colors are dual, expressed by a proof
`S.τ (c i) = c j`, where `S.τ` is the color involution in the tensor species.
For a tensor with colors `c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C`, contraction at positions
`i` and `j` produces a tensor with two fewer indices and colors
`c ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove i j`.

The construction is first made on pure tensors in
`Physlib.Relativity.Tensors.Contraction.Pure`. There, `Pure.dropPair` removes the
two contracted factors from the remaining pure tensor, `Pure.contrPCoeff`
computes the scalar contraction of the two removed factors using `S.contr`, and
`Pure.contrP` multiplies that scalar by the dropped tensor. This file extends the
operation linearly to arbitrary tensors via `contrT`.

## ii. Key results

- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.contrT` is the linear contraction map on tensors.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.contrT_pure` identifies `contrT` on pure tensors with
  `Pure.contrP`.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.contrT_equivariant` says contraction commutes with the
  symmetry-group action.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.contrT_permT`, `TensorSpecies.Tensor.contrT_symm`, and
  `TensorSpecies.Tensor.contrT_comm` describe the interaction of contraction with
  reindexing, swapping the contracted pair, and performing two contractions.

## iii. Related files

- `Physlib.Relativity.Tensors.Contraction.SuccSuccAbove` contains the finite-index
  maps used to drop two positions.
- `Physlib.Relativity.Tensors.Contraction.Pure` defines `Pure.dropPair`,
  `Pure.contrPCoeff`, `Pure.contrP`, and the multilinear map used to define
  `contrT`.
- `Physlib.Relativity.Tensors.Contraction.Products` proves compatibility between
  contractions and tensor products.

## iv. Table of contents

- A. Tensor contraction

## v. References

There are no known references for the material in this module.

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contrT_decide
TensorSpecies.Tensor.contrT
declarations.doc:
For `c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C`, `i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)` with dual color, and a tensor
`t : Tensor S c`, `contrT i j _ t` is the tensor
formed by contracting the `i`th index of `t`
with the `j`th index.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def contrT (n : ℕ) {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C} (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1))
      (hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j) :
    Tensor S c →ₗ[k] Tensor S (c ∘ succSuccAbove i j)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contrT_congr
declarations.statement:
lemma contrT_congr {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    {i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)} {hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j}
    (i' j' : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (t : S.Tensor c)
    (hii' : i = i' := by decide)
    (hjj' : j = j' := by decide) :
    contrT n i j hij t = permT id (And.intro (Function.bijective_id) (by subst hii' hjj'; simp))
      (contrT n i' j' (by subst hii' hjj'; exact hij) t)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contrT_pure
declarations.statement:
lemma contrT_pure {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C} (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1))
    (hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j) (p : Pure S c) :
    contrT n i j hij p.toTensor = p.contrP i j hij

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contrT_equivariant
declarations.statement:
lemma contrT_equivariant {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j) (g : G)
    (t : Tensor S c) :
    contrT n i j hij (g • t) = g • contrT n i j hij t

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contrT_permT
declarations.statement:
lemma contrT_permT {n n1 : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    {c1 : Fin (n1 + 1 + 1) → C}
    (i j : Fin (n1 + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c1 i) = (c1 j))
    (σ : Fin (n1 + 1 + 1) → Fin (n + 1 + 1))
    (hσ : IsReindexing c c1 σ) (t : Tensor S c) :
    contrT n1 i j hij (permT σ hσ t) = permT _ (hσ.succSuccAbove i j hij.1)
      (contrT n (σ i) (σ j) (by simp [hσ.2, hij, hσ.1.injective.eq_iff]) t)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contrT_symm
declarations.statement:
lemma contrT_symm {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    {i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)} {hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j} (t : Tensor S c) :
    contrT n i j hij t = permT id (by simp)
      (contrT n j i ⟨hij.1.symm, by simp [← hij.2]⟩ t)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contrT_comm
TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.dropPair_basisVector
declarations.statement:
lemma Pure.dropPair_basisVector {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    {i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)} (hij : i ≠ j) (b : ComponentIdx c) :
    Pure.dropPair i j hij (basisVector c b) =
    basisVector (S := S) (c ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove i j) fun m => b (Fin.succSuccAbove i j m)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.contrPCoeff_basisVector
declarations.doc:
For a species with dual bases (`HasContrDualBases`), the contraction coefficient of a basis
vector is the Kronecker δ of its labels at `i` and `j`, the label at `j` read as a label at the
color `c i`. The per-species `contrPCoeff_basis` lemmas follow from it.
declarations.statement:
lemma Pure.contrPCoeff_basisVector [HasContrDualBases S] {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} (i j : Fin n)
    (hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j) (φ : ComponentIdx (S := S) c) :
    Pure.contrPCoeff i j hij (Pure.basisVector c φ) =
      if φ i = HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv S (c i) (basisIdxCongr hij.2.symm (φ j)) then 1
      else 0

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contrT_basis_repr_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma contrT_basis_repr_apply {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C} {i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)}
    (h : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j) (t : Tensor S c)
    (φ : ComponentIdx (c ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove i j)) :
    (basis (c ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove i j)).repr (contrT n i j h t) φ =
    ∑ (b' : DropPairSection φ), (basis c).repr t b'.1 *
      (S.contr (c i) (b (c i) (b'.1 i) ⊗ₜ[k] b (S.τ (c i))
      (basisIdxCongr (by rw [h.2]) (b'.1 j))))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contrT_basis_repr_apply_eq_sum_fin
declarations.statement:
lemma contrT_basis_repr_apply_eq_sum_fin {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C} {i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)}
    (h : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j) (t : Tensor S c)
    (φ : ComponentIdx (c ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove i j)) :
    (basis (c ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove i j)).repr (contrT n i j h t) φ =
    ∑ (x1 : basisIdx (c i)), ∑ (x2 : basisIdx (c j)),
    (basis c).repr t (DropPairSection.ofFinEquiv h.1 φ (x1, x2)).1 *
    ((S.contr (c i))
    (b (c i) x1 ⊗ₜ[k] b (S.τ (c i)) (basisIdxCongr (by rw [h.2]) x2)))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contrT_basis_repr_apply_eq_sum_dual
declarations.doc:
For a species with dual bases (`HasContrDualBases`), a component of a contraction is a single
sum over the labels at the first contracted index: the δ law
(`HasContrDualBases.contr_basis_eq_ite`) fixes the label at the second. This collapses the double
sum of `contrT_basis_repr_apply_eq_sum_fin`.
declarations.statement:
lemma contrT_basis_repr_apply_eq_sum_dual [HasContrDualBases S] {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    {i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)} (h : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j) (t : Tensor S c)
    (φ : ComponentIdx (c ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove i j)) :
    (basis (c ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove i j)).repr (contrT n i j h t) φ =
    ∑ x : basisIdx (c i), (basis c).repr t
      (DropPairSection.ofFinEquiv h.1 φ
        (x, basisIdxCongr h.2 ((HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv S (c i)).symm x))).1

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contrT_basis
declarations.statement:
lemma contrT_basis {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C} {i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)}
    (h : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j) (b : ComponentIdx (S := S) c) :
    contrT n i j h (basis c b) =
    Pure.contrPCoeff i j h (Pure.basisVector c b) •
      basis (c ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove i j) (b.dropPair i j)

modules.title: Cross contraction at named slots
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

`contrT` contracts two slots of a single tensor. Contracting a slot of one tensor against a slot of
another (`T^{μν} u_ν`, `g_{μν} v^ν`) is `prodT` then `contrT`, which leaves every call site to
locate the two post-product slots and discharge the distinctness and `τ`-duality goals.

`crossToEnd i j hc` performs that contraction at named slots `i` and `j`, with
`hc : S.τ (cA i) = cB j` recording their `τ`-duality. The output color is
`Fin.append (cA ∘ i.succAbove) (cB ∘ j.succAbove)`: every slot of `cA` except `i`, in order, then
every slot of `cB` except `j`. These are the survivors. Any slot is reachable:
`crossToEnd 2 0 _ R u` reads as `R_{μνρσ} u^ρ`. The survivors are appended rather than interleaved,
and appending is associative, so both bracketings of a chain produce the same survivor list in the
same order.

The complementary convention keeps the replacement index in place. Contracting slot `1` of
`![c₀, c₁, c₂, c₃]` against a rank-two `![S.τ c₁, d]` gives `![c₀, c₂, c₃, d]` here and
`![c₀, d, c₂, c₃]` there; that operation is `crossToSlot`, built on this substrate in
`Physlib.Relativity.Tensors.Contraction.CrossToSlot`.

## ii. Key results

- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd` : the slot-addressed cross contraction.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_two` : at rank two on each factor, a plain `contrT` of the
    product on slots `1, 2`.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_basis` : the contraction of two basis tensors, which
    characterises `crossToEnd`.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_basis_repr_eq_sum_fin` : the component formula at arbitrary
    slots and ranks for any species, the contraction of the two contracted basis vectors left as an
    opaque coefficient.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_basis_repr_eq_sum_dual` : the same formula for a species with
    contraction-dual bases, the δ collapsing the two sums into one.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_pair_basis_repr` : the component formula at rank two on each
    factor.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix_crossToEnd_pair` : the same as a matrix equation, cross
    contraction being the product of the component matrices.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_equivariant` : the contraction commutes with the `G`-action.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_assoc_rankTwo` : rebracket the chain
    `A —(iA·0)— B —(last·0)— C` at rank-two `B` and `C`, up to `permT id`. Not full associativity.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_permT_left` / `crossToEnd_permT_right` : move a relabelling of
    the left or right factor through the contraction, the contracted slot moving with it.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. Slot-addressed cross contraction
- B. Component formulas and equivariance
- C. Rebracketing the metric chain
- D. Permutation commutators

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text:
## B. Component formulas and equivariance

`crossToEnd i j hc` is the curried bilinear map `LinearMap.compr₂ prodT` post-composed with the
linear `permT`/`contrT` factors, so additivity, scalar multiplication, and finite sums in either
argument are already the generic `map_add`/`map_smul`/`map_sum` and need no lemmas of their own.

## C. Rebracketing the metric chain

Both bracketings reduce to one product contracted at its two seams in opposite order, then drop to
the pure-tensor level, so the seam permutation never crosses a contraction under `whnf`;
`Pure.permP_dropPair_dropPair_congr` closes the step.

## D. Permutation commutators

Moving a relabelling of one factor through the slot-addressed contraction. The relabelling `σ` need
not fix the contracted slot, so it carries the contraction from slot `i` to slot `σ i` and restricts
to the survivors as a map `σ'` filling the square `(σ i).succAbove ∘ σ' = σ ∘ i.succAbove`. Taking
`σ'` as an argument rather than deriving it lets a caller supply the survivor map it wants (`id`, a
swap-induced map) instead of an opaque composite.

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd
declarations.doc:
Slot-addressed cross contraction: contract slot `i` of `t1` against slot `j` of `t2`. The
survivors are `t1`'s slots except `i` followed by `t2`'s slots except `j`, so the output color is
a clean `Fin (nA + nB) → C` and a chain composes without recasts.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def crossToEnd {nA nB : ℕ} {cA : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {cB : Fin (nB + 1) → C}
    (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin (nB + 1)) (hc : S.τ (cA i) = cB j) :
    Tensor S cA →ₗ[k] Tensor S cB →ₗ[k]
      Tensor S (Fin.append (cA ∘ i.succAbove) (cB ∘ j.succAbove))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_two
declarations.doc:
Cross-contracting the last slot of a rank-2 tensor `A` with the `0`-slot of a rank-2 tensor `B`
is a plain `contrT` of their product on the middle slots `1, 2`, up to a color recast. Discharging
the slot arithmetic once lets a `contrT`-level identity lift to `crossToEnd` by one rewrite.
declarations.statement:
lemma crossToEnd_two {cA cB : Fin 2 → C} (h : S.τ (cA (Fin.last 1)) = cB 0)
    (A : Tensor S cA) (B : Tensor S cB) :
    crossToEnd (Fin.last 1) (0 : Fin 2) h A B
      = permT (id : Fin 2 → Fin 2) (IsReindexing.on_id.mpr (fun i => by fin_cases i <;> rfl))
          (contrT 2 (1 : Fin 4) (2 : Fin 4)
            (by
              refine ⟨by decide, ?_⟩
              rw [show (1 : Fin 4) = Fin.castAdd 2 (1 : Fin 2) from rfl,
                  show (2 : Fin 4) = Fin.natAdd 2 (0 : Fin 2) from rfl,
                  Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right]
              exact h)
            (prodT A B))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_basis
declarations.doc:
Cross contraction of two basis tensors: the contraction of the two contracted basis vectors
times the basis tensor of the surviving labels. These values determine `crossToEnd i j hc`, a
bilinear map in the two tensors.
declarations.statement:
lemma crossToEnd_basis {nA nB : ℕ} {cA : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {cB : Fin (nB + 1) → C}
    (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin (nB + 1)) (hc : S.τ (cA i) = cB j)
    (φA : ComponentIdx (S := S) cA) (φB : ComponentIdx (S := S) cB) :
    crossToEnd i j hc (basis cA φA) (basis cB φB) =
      S.contr (cA i) (b (cA i) (φA i) ⊗ₜ[k] b (S.τ (cA i)) (basisIdxCongr hc.symm (φB j))) •
        basis (Fin.append (cA ∘ i.succAbove) (cB ∘ j.succAbove))
          (ComponentIdx.prod.symm (fun m => φA (i.succAbove m), fun m => φB (j.succAbove m)))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_basis_repr_eq_sum_fin
declarations.doc:
The component formula for a cross contraction at arbitrary slots and ranks, for any species:
each contracted label is summed over its own slot, with the contraction of the two basis vectors as
coefficient. The counterpart of `contrT_basis_repr_apply_eq_sum_fin` for two tensors.
declarations.statement:
lemma crossToEnd_basis_repr_eq_sum_fin {nA nB : ℕ} {cA : Fin (nA + 1) → C}
    {cB : Fin (nB + 1) → C} (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin (nB + 1)) (hc : S.τ (cA i) = cB j)
    (t1 : Tensor S cA) (t2 : Tensor S cB)
    (φ : ComponentIdx (S := S) (Fin.append (cA ∘ i.succAbove) (cB ∘ j.succAbove))) :
    (basis (Fin.append (cA ∘ i.succAbove) (cB ∘ j.succAbove))).repr
        (crossToEnd i j hc t1 t2) φ =
      ∑ x₁ : basisIdx (cA i), ∑ x₂ : basisIdx (cB j),
        ((basis cA).repr t1 (ComponentIdx.insert i (x₁, φ.prod.1)) *
          (basis cB).repr t2 (ComponentIdx.insert j (x₂, φ.prod.2))) *
        S.contr (cA i) (b (cA i) x₁ ⊗ₜ[k]
          b (S.τ (cA i)) (basisIdxCongr (by rw [hc]) x₂))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_basis_repr_eq_sum_dual
declarations.doc:
The component formula for a cross contraction at arbitrary slots and ranks, for a species with
contraction-dual bases: the contraction coefficient is `δ` and one sum remains, the contracted label
of `t2` matched to that of `t1` by `contrDualIdxEquiv`.
declarations.statement:
lemma crossToEnd_basis_repr_eq_sum_dual [HasContrDualBases S] {nA nB : ℕ} {cA : Fin (nA + 1) → C}
    {cB : Fin (nB + 1) → C} (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin (nB + 1)) (hc : S.τ (cA i) = cB j)
    (t1 : Tensor S cA) (t2 : Tensor S cB)
    (φ : ComponentIdx (S := S) (Fin.append (cA ∘ i.succAbove) (cB ∘ j.succAbove))) :
    (basis (Fin.append (cA ∘ i.succAbove) (cB ∘ j.succAbove))).repr
        (crossToEnd i j hc t1 t2) φ =
      ∑ x : basisIdx (cA i),
        (basis cA).repr t1 (ComponentIdx.insert i (x, φ.prod.1)) *
        (basis cB).repr t2 (ComponentIdx.insert j
          (basisIdxCongr hc ((HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv S (cA i)).symm x),
            φ.prod.2))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_pair_basis_repr
declarations.doc:
The component formula for cross-contracting the last slot of a rank-two tensor with the first
slot of another. The surviving labels are supplied as a dependent pair, so the formula applies when
the species has colour-dependent basis-index types.
declarations.statement:
lemma crossToEnd_pair_basis_repr [HasContrDualBases S] {c0 c1 c2 c3 : C} (h : S.τ c1 = c2)
    (t1 : Tensor S ![c0, c1]) (t2 : Tensor S ![c2, c3])
    (y0 : basisIdx c0) (y3 : basisIdx c3) :
    (basis (Fin.append (![c0, c1] ∘ (Fin.last 1).succAbove)
        (![c2, c3] ∘ (0 : Fin 2).succAbove))).repr
      (crossToEnd (Fin.last 1) (0 : Fin 2) h t1 t2)
      (ComponentIdx.pair.symm (y0, y3)) =
      ∑ x : basisIdx c1,
        (basis ![c0, c1]).repr t1 (ComponentIdx.pair.symm (y0, x)) *
        (basis ![c2, c3]).repr t2
          (ComponentIdx.pair.symm
            (basisIdxCongr h ((HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv S c1).symm x), y3))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix_crossToEnd_pair
declarations.doc:
Cross contraction of two rank-two tensors is the product of their component matrices, the
middle labels matched by `HasContrDualBases.dualIdxEquiv`.
declarations.statement:
lemma toMatrix_crossToEnd_pair [HasContrDualBases S] {c0 c1 c2 c3 : C} (h : S.τ c1 = c2)
    (t1 : S.Tensor ![c0, c1]) (t2 : S.Tensor ![c2, c3]) :
    toMatrix (crossToEnd (Fin.last 1) (0 : Fin 2) h t1 t2) =
      toMatrix t1 * (toMatrix t2).submatrix
        (fun x : basisIdx (![c0, c1] 1) => HasContrDualBases.dualIdxEquiv h x) id

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_equivariant
declarations.doc: Cross contraction is `G`-equivariant, each of `prodT`, `contrT` and `permT` being so.
declarations.statement:
lemma crossToEnd_equivariant {nA nB : ℕ} {cA : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {cB : Fin (nB + 1) → C}
    (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin (nB + 1)) (hc : S.τ (cA i) = cB j) (g : G)
    (t1 : Tensor S cA) (t2 : Tensor S cB) :
    crossToEnd i j hc (g • t1) (g • t2) = g • crossToEnd i j hc t1 t2

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_assoc_rankTwo
declarations.doc:
Rebracket the chain `A —(iA·0)— B —(last·0)— C` for rank-two `B` and `C`: contracting `A·B`
first and then `·C` equals contracting `B·C` first and then `A·`, up to the color recast
`permT id`.

Not full associativity: only `A`'s attachment slot `iA` is free. `B`'s rank two is what makes the
statement possible, the second contraction being addressed at `Fin.last nA`, the slot `B`'s unique
survivor occupies in `A·B`. Other slots are reached by conjugating with the `permT` commutators.

With `A := T`, `B := g`, `C := g⁻¹` this reassociates `(T·g)·g⁻¹` to `T·(g·g⁻¹)`, after which
`g·g⁻¹` collapses to the unit tensor: the step behind raising then lowering a named index.
declarations.statement:
lemma crossToEnd_assoc_rankTwo {nA : ℕ}
    {cA : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {cB cC : Fin 2 → C}
    (iA : Fin (nA + 1))
    (hc1 : S.τ (cA iA) = cB 0)
    (hc2 : S.τ (cB (Fin.last 1)) = cC 0)
    (tA : Tensor S cA) (tB : Tensor S cB) (tC : Tensor S cC) :
    crossToEnd (Fin.last nA) 0
        (by
          rw [show (Fin.last nA : Fin (nA + 1)) = Fin.natAdd nA (Fin.last 0) from
              Fin.ext (by simp), Fin.append_right, Function.comp_apply, Fin.succAbove_zero,
            Fin.succ_last]
          exact hc2)
        (crossToEnd iA 0 hc1 tA tB) tC =
      permT id
        (IsReindexing.on_id.mpr fun i => by
          refine Fin.addCases (fun a => ?_) (fun a => ?_) i
          · simp only [Fin.append_left, Function.comp_apply, Fin.succAbove_last,
              show a.castSucc = Fin.castAdd 1 a from rfl, Fin.append_left]
          · simp only [Fin.append_right, Function.comp_apply, Fin.succAbove_zero]
            fin_cases a
            rfl)
        (crossToEnd iA 0
          (by
            rw [show (0 : Fin (1 + 1)) = Fin.castAdd 1 (0 : Fin 1) from rfl, Fin.append_left,
              Function.comp_apply, Fin.succAbove_last, Fin.castSucc_zero]
            exact hc1)
          tA
          (crossToEnd (Fin.last 1) 0 hc2 tB tC))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_permT_left
declarations.doc:
Left commutator: contracting slot `i` of `permT σ t1` equals contracting slot `σ i` of `t1`,
then relabelling the survivors by `σ'`. The square `hσ'` records how `σ'` carries the complement
of `i` to the complement of `σ i`, and implies its bijectivity.
declarations.statement:
lemma crossToEnd_permT_left {nA nB : ℕ} {cA cA' : Fin (nA + 1) → C}
    {cB : Fin (nB + 1) → C}
    (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin (nB + 1))
    (σ : Fin (nA + 1) → Fin (nA + 1)) (σ' : Fin nA → Fin nA)
    (hσ : IsReindexing cA cA' σ)
    (hσ' : (σ i).succAbove ∘ σ' = σ ∘ i.succAbove)
    (hc : S.τ (cA' i) = cB j)
    (t1 : Tensor S cA) (t2 : Tensor S cB) :
    crossToEnd i j hc (permT σ hσ t1) t2 =
      permT (Fin.append (Fin.castAdd nB ∘ σ') (Fin.natAdd nA))
        (IsReindexing.append_congr_left (cB ∘ j.succAbove)
          (IsReindexing.succAbove_of_succAbove_eq i hσ hσ'))
        (crossToEnd (σ i) j (by rw [hσ.2 i]; exact hc) t1 t2)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_permT_right
declarations.doc:
Right commutator, the mirror of `crossToEnd_permT_left`: contracting slot `j` of `permT σ t2`
equals contracting slot `σ j` of `t2`, then relabelling the survivors by `σ'`.
declarations.statement:
lemma crossToEnd_permT_right {nA nB : ℕ} {cA : Fin (nA + 1) → C}
    {cB cB' : Fin (nB + 1) → C}
    (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin (nB + 1))
    (σ : Fin (nB + 1) → Fin (nB + 1)) (σ' : Fin nB → Fin nB)
    (hσ : IsReindexing cB cB' σ)
    (hσ' : (σ j).succAbove ∘ σ' = σ ∘ j.succAbove)
    (hc : S.τ (cA i) = cB' j)
    (t1 : Tensor S cA) (t2 : Tensor S cB) :
    crossToEnd i j hc t1 (permT σ hσ t2) =
      permT (Fin.append (Fin.castAdd nB) (Fin.natAdd nA ∘ σ'))
        (IsReindexing.append_congr_right (cA ∘ i.succAbove)
          (IsReindexing.succAbove_of_succAbove_eq j hσ hσ'))
        (crossToEnd i (σ j) (by rw [hσ.2 j]; exact hc) t1 t2)

modules.title: Result-to-slot contraction against a rank-2 tensor
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

`crossToEnd` deposits the surviving index of a slot contraction at the end of the survivor list.
Raising and lowering a named index instead wants the replacement to stay *in place*: contracting
slot `i` of `t` against a rank-2 tensor `M` (a metric, the unit tensor) should return `t` with only
slot `i`'s color changed, `T^{μ}{}_{νρ} ↦ T_{μνρ}`. `crossToSlot i j hc M` is that operation, and
`crossToSlot_eq_crossToEnd` is the one place the two conventions meet.

This module stays at the `CommRing` altitude of `crossToEnd`; the `RCLike` round trips built on the
operation live with the unit-tensor collapse theory in
`Physlib.Relativity.Tensors.Contraction.UnitTensorContraction`.

## ii. Key results

- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot` : contract slot `i` against slot `j` of a rank-2 tensor and
    rotate the survivor back into position `i`; raising and lowering a named index.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot_eq_crossToEnd` : the bridge to the result-to-end convention.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot_basis_repr_apply` : the component bridge from result-to-slot
    to result-to-end contraction.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlotInv` : the returning half of a round trip, the contraction
    against the second factor with the round trip's color cast absorbed.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot_basis_repr_eq_sum_fin` : the component formula at arbitrary
    rank and slot for any species, the contraction of the two contracted basis vectors left as an
    opaque coefficient.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot_basis_repr_eq_sum_dual` : the same formula for a species with
    contraction-dual bases, the δ collapsing the two sums into one.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot_permT_right_id` : an identity reindexing of the rank-2 tensor
    passes through the contraction.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot_equivariant` : the contraction commutes with the `G`-action.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The result-to-slot contraction

## iv. References

* None.

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.crossToSlot_cycle
declarations.doc:
The survivor color of `crossToEnd i j` against a rank-2 tensor of color `cM` is `c` with
slot `i` replaced by the surviving color `cM (j.succAbove 0)`, once the survivors are rotated
back by the inverse of the cycle `[i, last]`.
declarations.statement:
lemma IsReindexing.crossToSlot_cycle {nA : ℕ} {c : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {cM : Fin 2 → C}
    (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin 2) :
    IsReindexing
      (Fin.append (c ∘ i.succAbove) (cM ∘ j.succAbove))
      (Function.update c i (cM (j.succAbove 0)))
      ⇑(Fin.cycleIcc i (Fin.last nA)).symm

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot
declarations.doc:
Contract slot `i` of `t` against slot `j` of the rank-2 tensor `M`, whose `j`-slot color must
equal the dual color `τ (c i)` (propositionally, via `hc`), and rotate `M`'s surviving slot back
into position `i`. The result is `t` with slot `i` relabelled to `M`'s surviving color.

This is raising and lowering a named index; the metric case is `j = 0`,
`M = metricTensor (τ (c i))`. Because `hc` is propositional, a rank-2 tensor whose slot color
matches only up to an equality enters directly, with no transport.

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot_eq_crossToEnd
declarations.doc:
The bridge between the two conventions: `crossToSlot i j hc M t` is `crossToEnd i j hc t M`
with the survivor rotated from the last slot back to slot `i` by the inverse cycle.
declarations.statement:
lemma crossToSlot_eq_crossToEnd {nA : ℕ} {c : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {cM : Fin 2 → C}
    (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin 2) (hc : S.τ (c i) = cM j) (M : S.Tensor cM) (t : S.Tensor c) :
    crossToSlot i j hc M t =
      permT ⇑(Fin.cycleIcc i (Fin.last nA)).symm (IsReindexing.crossToSlot_cycle i j)
        (crossToEnd i j hc t M)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot_basis_repr_apply
declarations.doc:
A component of `crossToSlot` is the corresponding component of `crossToEnd`, with the
surviving indices rotated back into the contracted slot.
declarations.statement:
lemma crossToSlot_basis_repr_apply {nA : ℕ} {c : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {cM : Fin 2 → C}
    (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin 2) (hc : S.τ (c i) = cM j) (M : Tensor S cM)
    (t : Tensor S c)
    (φ : ComponentIdx (S := S) (Function.update c i (cM (j.succAbove 0)))) :
    (basis _).repr (crossToSlot i j hc M t) φ =
      (basis _).repr (crossToEnd i j hc t M) (fun m =>
        basisIdxCongr ((IsReindexing.crossToSlot_cycle i j).inv_perserve_color m)
          (φ ((IsReindexing.crossToSlot_cycle i j).inv
            ⇑(Fin.cycleIcc i (Fin.last nA)).symm m)))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlotInv
declarations.doc:
`crossToSlot` of slot `i` with the first index of `M'`, followed by renaming slot `i` back to
its original colour `c i` (`he`).

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot_permT_right_id
declarations.doc:
An identity reindexing of the rank-2 tensor becomes the corresponding identity reindexing of
the contracted output: the `crossToSlot`-level case of `crossToEnd_permT_right` where the rank-2
tensor's colors are only propositionally recast.
declarations.statement:
lemma crossToSlot_permT_right_id {nA : ℕ} {c : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {cM cM' : Fin 2 → C}
    (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin 2) (hc : S.τ (c i) = cM' j)
    (M : Tensor S cM) (hM : IsReindexing cM cM' (id : Fin 2 → Fin 2)) (t : Tensor S c) :
    crossToSlot i j hc (permT (id : Fin 2 → Fin 2) hM M) t =
      permT (id : Fin (nA + 1) → Fin (nA + 1))
        (IsReindexing.on_id.mpr (fun a => by
          by_cases ha : a = i
          · subst ha
            simpa using hM.2 (j.succAbove 0)
          · simp [Function.update_of_ne ha]))
        (crossToSlot i j (hc.trans (hM.2 j).symm) M t)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot_basis_repr_eq_sum_fin
declarations.doc:
The component formula for a cross contraction into an arbitrary slot, for a species whose bases
are not assumed adapted to the contraction: each contracted label is summed over its own slot and
the contraction of the two basis vectors remains an opaque coefficient. Rotating the survivor back
to its slot only transports the surviving labels, so this is `crossToEnd_basis_repr_eq_sum_fin` read
through the cycle.
declarations.statement:
lemma crossToSlot_basis_repr_eq_sum_fin {nA : ℕ} {c : Fin (nA + 1) → C}
    {cM : Fin 2 → C} (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin 2) (hc : S.τ (c i) = cM j)
    (M : S.Tensor cM) (t : S.Tensor c)
    (φ : ComponentIdx (S := S) (Function.update c i (cM (j.succAbove 0)))) :
    (basis (Function.update c i (cM (j.succAbove 0)))).repr
        (crossToSlot i j hc M t) φ =
      ∑ x₁ : basisIdx (c i), ∑ x₂ : basisIdx (cM j),
        ((basis c).repr t (ComponentIdx.insert i
            (x₁, fun m => basisIdxCongr (by simp [Function.update_of_ne]) (φ (i.succAbove m)))) *
          (basis cM).repr M (ComponentIdx.insert j
            (x₂, fun m => basisIdxCongr (by fin_cases m; simp) (φ i)))) *
        S.contr (c i) (b (c i) x₁ ⊗ₜ[k]
          b (S.τ (c i)) (basisIdxCongr (by rw [hc]) x₂))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot_basis_repr_eq_sum_dual
declarations.doc:
The component formula for a cross contraction into an arbitrary slot, for a species with
contraction-dual bases: the contraction coefficient is `δ` and one sum remains, the contracted label
of `M` matched to that of `t` by `contrDualIdxEquiv`.
declarations.statement:
lemma crossToSlot_basis_repr_eq_sum_dual [HasContrDualBases S] {nA : ℕ} {c : Fin (nA + 1) → C}
    {cM : Fin 2 → C} (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin 2) (hc : S.τ (c i) = cM j)
    (M : S.Tensor cM) (t : S.Tensor c)
    (φ : ComponentIdx (S := S) (Function.update c i (cM (j.succAbove 0)))) :
    (basis (Function.update c i (cM (j.succAbove 0)))).repr
        (crossToSlot i j hc M t) φ =
      ∑ x : basisIdx (c i),
        (basis c).repr t (ComponentIdx.insert i
          (x, fun m => basisIdxCongr (by simp [Function.update_of_ne]) (φ (i.succAbove m)))) *
        (basis cM).repr M (ComponentIdx.insert j
          (basisIdxCongr hc ((HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv S (c i)).symm x),
            fun m => basisIdxCongr (by fin_cases m; simp) (φ i)))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot_equivariant
declarations.doc:
Cross contraction into a slot is `G`-equivariant, both constituents (`crossToEnd`, `permT`)
being so.
declarations.statement:
lemma crossToSlot_equivariant {nA : ℕ} {c : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {cM : Fin 2 → C}
    (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin 2) (hc : S.τ (c i) = cM j) (g : G)
    (M : Tensor S cM) (t : Tensor S c) :
    crossToSlot i j hc (g • M) (g • t) = g • crossToSlot i j hc M t

modules.title: The interaction of contractions and products

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.contrPCoeff_natAdd
TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.contrPCoeff_castAdd
TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.prodP_dropPair
declarations.statement:
lemma Pure.prodP_dropPair {n n1 : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    {c1 : Fin n1 → C}
    (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j)
    (p : Pure S c) (p1 : Pure S c1) :
    p1.prodP (dropPair i j hij.1 p) = permP _ (IsReindexing.append_succSuccAbove_natAdd i j)
    (dropPair (Fin.natAdd n1 i) (Fin.natAdd n1 j)
    (by simp_all [Fin.ext_iff]) (p1.prodP p))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.prodP_contrP_snd
declarations.statement:
lemma Pure.prodP_contrP_snd {n n1 : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    {c1 : Fin n1 → C}
    (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j)
    (p : Pure S c) (p1 : Pure S c1) :
    prodT p1.toTensor (contrP i j hij p) =
    ((permT id (IsReindexing.append_succSuccAbove_natAdd i j)) <|
    contrP (Fin.natAdd n1 i) (Fin.natAdd n1 j) (by simpa using hij) <|
    prodP p1 p)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.prodT_contrT_snd
declarations.statement:
lemma prodT_contrT_snd {n n1 : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    {c1 : Fin n1 → C}
    (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j)
    (t : Tensor S c) (t1 : Tensor S c1) :
    prodT t1 (contrT n i j hij t) =
    ((permT id (IsReindexing.append_succSuccAbove_natAdd i j)) <|
    contrT _ (Fin.natAdd n1 i) (Fin.natAdd n1 j)
      (by simpa using hij) <| prodT t1 t)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contrT_prodT_snd
declarations.statement:
lemma contrT_prodT_snd {n n1 : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    {c1 : Fin n1 → C} (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j)
    (t : Tensor S c) (t1 : Tensor S c1) :
    (contrT _ (i.natAdd n1) (j.natAdd n1) (by simpa using hij) <| prodT t1 t) =
    ((permT id (IsReindexing.on_id_symm (IsReindexing.append_succSuccAbove_natAdd i j))) <|
      (prodT t1 (contrT n i j hij t)))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.prodT_contrT_fst
declarations.doc:
A contraction internal to the left factor commutes past the outer product with a right
spectator. The mirror of `prodT_contrT_snd`, obtained from it by `prodT_swap`, so the right-hand
side contracts the swapped product `prodT t1 t` and carries a block swap.
declarations.statement:
lemma prodT_contrT_fst {n n1 : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    {c1 : Fin n1 → C}
    (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j)
    (t : Tensor S c) (t1 : Tensor S c1) :
    prodT (contrT n i j hij t) t1 =
    permT _ IsReindexing.append_swap
      (permT id (IsReindexing.append_succSuccAbove_natAdd i j) <|
      contrT _
        (Fin.natAdd n1 i)
        (Fin.natAdd n1 j)
        (by simpa using hij) <|
      prodT t1 t)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.dropPair
declarations.doc:
Given `i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)`, `c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C` and a pure tensor `p : Pure S c`,
`dropPair i j _ p` is the tensor formed by dropping the `i`th and `j`th parts of `p`.
declarations.statement:
def dropPair (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j) (p : Pure S c) :
    Pure S (c ∘ succSuccAbove i j)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.dropPair_equivariant
TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.dropPair_symm
declarations.statement:
lemma dropPair_symm (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (p : Pure S c) : dropPair i j hij p =
    permP id (by simp) (dropPair j i hij.symm p)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.dropPair_comm
TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.dropPair_update_fst
declarations.statement:
lemma dropPair_update_fst {n : ℕ} [inst : DecidableEq (Fin (n + 1 +1))] {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j) (p : Pure S c)
    (x : V (c i)) :
    dropPair i j hij (p.update i x) = dropPair i j hij p

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.dropPair_update_snd
declarations.statement:
lemma dropPair_update_snd {n : ℕ} [inst : DecidableEq (Fin (n + 1 +1))] {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j) (p : Pure S c)
    (x : V (c j)) :
    dropPair i j hij (p.update j x) = dropPair i j hij p

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.dropPair_update_succSuccAbove
declarations.statement:
lemma dropPair_update_succSuccAbove {n : ℕ} [inst : DecidableEq (Fin (n + 1 +1))]
    {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j) (p : Pure S c)
    (m : Fin n)
    (x : V (c (succSuccAbove i j m))) :
    dropPair i j hij (p.update (succSuccAbove i j m) x) =
    (dropPair i j hij p).update m x

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.dropPair_permP
declarations.statement:
lemma dropPair_permP {n n1 : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    {c1 : Fin (n1 + 1 + 1) → C} (i j : Fin (n1 + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (σ : Fin (n1 + 1 + 1) → Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hσ : IsReindexing c c1 σ) (p : Pure S c) :
    dropPair i j hij (permP σ hσ p) = permP _ (hσ.succSuccAbove i j hij)
    (dropPair (σ i) (σ j) (by simp [hσ.1.injective.eq_iff, hij]) p)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.permP_dropPair_dropPair_congr
declarations.doc:
Two `permP`–`dropPair`–`dropPair` towers over a common pure tensor agree once their composite
slot maps agree pointwise. Comparing two orders of dropping two pairs of slots this way keeps
every slot map an opaque variable, so the comparison closes by unification rather than by
`whnf`-reducing the color and index-map composites.
declarations.statement:
lemma permP_dropPair_dropPair_congr {nP nOut : ℕ}
    {c : Fin (nP + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1) → C} {cOut : Fin nOut → C} (p : Pure S c)
    (aL bL : Fin (nP + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1)) (habL : aL ≠ bL)
    (a2L b2L : Fin (nP + 1 + 1)) (hab2L : a2L ≠ b2L)
    (σ1L : Fin nOut → Fin nP)
    (h1L : IsReindexing ((c ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove aL bL) ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove a2L b2L) cOut σ1L)
    (aR bR : Fin (nP + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1)) (habR : aR ≠ bR)
    (a2R b2R : Fin (nP + 1 + 1)) (hab2R : a2R ≠ b2R)
    (σ1R : Fin nOut → Fin nP)
    (h1R : IsReindexing ((c ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove aR bR) ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove a2R b2R) cOut σ1R)
    (hslot : ∀ m : Fin nOut,
      Fin.succSuccAbove aL bL (Fin.succSuccAbove a2L b2L (σ1L m)) =
      Fin.succSuccAbove aR bR (Fin.succSuccAbove a2R b2R (σ1R m))) :
    permP σ1L h1L (dropPair a2L b2L hab2L (dropPair aL bL habL p)) =
    permP σ1R h1R (dropPair a2R b2R hab2R (dropPair aR bR habR p))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.permP_dropPair_permP_congr
declarations.doc:
Two `permP`–`dropPair`–`permP` towers over a common pure tensor agree once their composite
slot maps agree pointwise. The one-contraction, inner-relabelled sibling of
`permP_dropPair_dropPair_congr`.
declarations.statement:
lemma permP_dropPair_permP_congr {nP nOut mL mR : ℕ}
    {c : Fin nP → C} {cL : Fin (mL + 1 + 1) → C} {cR : Fin (mR + 1 + 1) → C}
    {cOut : Fin nOut → C} (p : Pure S c)
    (σ0L : Fin (mL + 1 + 1) → Fin nP) (h0L : IsReindexing c cL σ0L)
    (aL bL : Fin (mL + 1 + 1)) (habL : aL ≠ bL)
    (σ1L : Fin nOut → Fin mL)
    (h1L : IsReindexing (cL ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove aL bL) cOut σ1L)
    (σ0R : Fin (mR + 1 + 1) → Fin nP) (h0R : IsReindexing c cR σ0R)
    (aR bR : Fin (mR + 1 + 1)) (habR : aR ≠ bR)
    (σ1R : Fin nOut → Fin mR)
    (h1R : IsReindexing (cR ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove aR bR) cOut σ1R)
    (hslot : ∀ m : Fin nOut,
      σ0L (Fin.succSuccAbove aL bL (σ1L m)) = σ0R (Fin.succSuccAbove aR bR (σ1R m))) :
    permP σ1L h1L (dropPair aL bL habL (permP σ0L h0L p)) =
    permP σ1R h1R (dropPair aR bR habR (permP σ0R h0R p))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.contrPCoeff
declarations.doc:
Given a pure tensor `p : Pure S c` and a `i j : Fin n`
corresponding to dual colors in `c`, `contrPCoeff i j _ p` is the
element of the underlying ring `k` formed by contracting `p i` and `p j`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def contrPCoeff {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C}
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j) (p : Pure S c) : k

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.contrPCoeff_congr
declarations.doc:
`contrPCoeff` is insensitive to its proof arguments once the two contracted slots agree. Lets a
coefficient comparison rewrite the slots without a `congr` search through the proof fields.
declarations.statement:
lemma contrPCoeff_congr {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} (p : Pure S c)
    {i i' j j' : Fin n} (hi : i = i') (hj : j = j')
    {hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j} {hij' : i' ≠ j' ∧ S.τ (c i') = c j'} :
    p.contrPCoeff i j hij = p.contrPCoeff i' j' hij'

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.contrPCoeff_permP
declarations.statement:
lemma contrPCoeff_permP {n n1 : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C}
    {c1 : Fin n1 → C} (i j : Fin n1) (hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c1 i) = c1 j)
    (σ : Fin n1 → Fin n) (hσ : IsReindexing c c1 σ) (p : Pure S c) :
    contrPCoeff i j hij (permP σ hσ p) =
    contrPCoeff (σ i) (σ j) (by simp [hσ.1.injective.eq_iff, hij, hσ.2]) p

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.contrPCoeff_update_succSuccAbove
declarations.statement:
lemma contrPCoeff_update_succSuccAbove {n : ℕ} [inst : DecidableEq (Fin (n + 1 +1))]
    {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j) (m : Fin n)
    (p : Pure S c) (x : V (c (succSuccAbove i j m))) :
    contrPCoeff i j hij (p.update (succSuccAbove i j m) x) =
    contrPCoeff i j hij p

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.contrPCoeff_update_fst_add
declarations.statement:
lemma contrPCoeff_update_fst_add {n : ℕ} [inst : DecidableEq (Fin n)] {c : Fin n → C}
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j)
    (p : Pure S c) (x y : V (c i)) :
    contrPCoeff i j hij (p.update i (x + y)) =
    contrPCoeff i j hij (p.update i x) + contrPCoeff i j hij (p.update i y)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.contrPCoeff_update_snd_add
declarations.statement:
lemma contrPCoeff_update_snd_add {n : ℕ} [inst : DecidableEq (Fin n)] {c : Fin n → C}
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j)
    (p : Pure S c) (x y : V (c j)) :
    contrPCoeff i j hij (p.update j (x + y)) =
    contrPCoeff i j hij (p.update j x) + contrPCoeff i j hij (p.update j y)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.contrPCoeff_update_fst_smul
declarations.statement:
lemma contrPCoeff_update_fst_smul {n : ℕ} [inst : DecidableEq (Fin n)] {c : Fin n → C}
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j)
    (p : Pure S c) (r : k) (x : V (c i)) :
    contrPCoeff i j hij (p.update i (r • x)) =
    r * contrPCoeff i j hij (p.update i x)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.contrPCoeff_update_snd_smul
declarations.statement:
lemma contrPCoeff_update_snd_smul {n : ℕ} [inst : DecidableEq (Fin n)] {c : Fin n → C}
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j)
    (p : Pure S c) (r : k) (x : V (c j)) :
    contrPCoeff i j hij (p.update j (r • x)) =
    r * contrPCoeff i j hij (p.update j x)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.contrPCoeff_dropPair
declarations.statement:
lemma contrPCoeff_dropPair {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    (a b : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c (succSuccAbove a b i)) = (c (succSuccAbove a b j)))
    (p : Pure S c) : (p.dropPair a b hab).contrPCoeff i j hij =
    p.contrPCoeff (succSuccAbove a b i) (succSuccAbove a b j)
      (by simpa using hij)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.contrPCoeff_symm
TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.contrPCoeff_mul_dropPair
TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.contrPCoeff_invariant
TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.contrP
declarations.doc:
For `c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C`, `i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)` with dual color, and a pure tensor
`p : Pure S c`, `contrP i j _ p` is the tensor (not pure due to the `n = 0` case)
formed by contracting the `i`th index of `p`
with the `j`th index.

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.contrP_update_add
declarations.statement:
lemma contrP_update_add {n : ℕ} [inst : DecidableEq (Fin (n + 1 +1))] {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    (i j m : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j)
    (p : Pure S c) (x y : V (c m)) :
    contrP i j hij (p.update m (x + y)) =
    contrP i j hij (p.update m x) + contrP i j hij (p.update m y)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.contrP_update_smul
declarations.statement:
lemma contrP_update_smul {n : ℕ} [inst : DecidableEq (Fin (n + 1 +1))] {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    (i j m : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j)
    (p : Pure S c) (r : k) (x : V (c m)) :
    contrP i j hij (p.update m (r • x)) =
    r • contrP i j hij (p.update m x)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.contrP_equivariant
TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.contrP_symm
declarations.statement:
lemma contrP_symm {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    {i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)} {hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j} {p : Pure S c} :
    contrP i j hij p = permT id (by simp)
    (contrP j i ⟨hij.1.symm, by simp [← hij.2]⟩ p)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.contrPMultilinear
declarations.doc: The multi-linear map formed by contracting a pair of indices of pure tensors.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def contrPMultilinear {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j) :
    MultilinearMap k (fun i => V (c i))
      (S.Tensor (c ∘ succSuccAbove i j))

modules.title: The bilinear map and the product of rank-two tensors
modules.doc:
The bilinear map of a rank-two tensor and the product of two rank-two tensors.

## i. Overview

A rank-two tensor `M` defines a bilinear map on one-slot tensors by contracting one argument into
each of its slots, `t, s ↦ M_{zw} tᶻ sʷ`. In the bases dual to the slots of `M` the matrix of this
map is the component matrix `toMatrix M`.

`contractInnerT A B` is the tensor `A_{μν} B^{νρ}`, in which the second index of `A` is contracted
with the first index of `B`. Its indices are `μ` and `ρ`, with colours `![cs 0, ds 1]`. The general
contraction `crossToEnd` gives the same tensor, but its colours are a composite of the two colour
lists. With `contractInnerT`, an identity such as `η_{μν} η^{νρ} = δ_μ^ρ` needs no renaming of the
colours of the product. For contraction-dual bases, the matrix of `A_{μν} B^{νρ}` is the matrix
product of `(A_{μν})` and `(B^{νρ})` (`toMatrix_contractInnerT`).

## ii. Key results

- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.toLinearMap₂` : the bilinear map `t, s ↦ M_{zw} tᶻ sʷ` of a rank-two
    tensor, with its component formula `toLinearMap₂_apply`.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix₂_toLinearMap₂` : its matrix in the dual bases is the component
    matrix of `M`.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.contractInnerT` : the contraction `A_{μν} B^{νρ}` of two rank-two tensors.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix_contractInnerT` : for contraction-dual bases, its matrix is the
    matrix product.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. Pairing a rank-two tensor with two vectors
- B. Contracting two rank-two tensors

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text:
## A. Pairing a rank-two tensor with two vectors

Contracting a vector into each slot of a rank-two tensor `M` gives a bilinear map. This holds for
any species: the only colour condition is duality, an argument contracts with a slot when its
colour is dual to the slot's. For a species without conjugation this map is the metric form
itself; a species with conjugation composes it with conjugation of one argument to get a
sesquilinear form (`ConjTensorSpecies.toSesqForm`).

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toLinearMap₂
declarations.doc:
The bilinear map `t, s ↦ M_{μν} tᵘ sᵛ` of a rank-two tensor: `t` fills the first index of `M`,
`s` the second. For the Minkowski metric this is the inner product `η_{μν} tᵘ sᵛ`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def toLinearMap₂ (x y : C) {cM : Fin 2 → C} (M : Tensor S cM)
    (hx : S.τ x = cM 0 := by rfl) (hy : S.τ y = cM 1 := by rfl) :
    Tensor S ![x] →ₗ[k] Tensor S ![y] →ₗ[k] k

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toLinearMap₂_apply
declarations.doc: In components, the bilinear map is `∑_{μ,ν} M_{μν} tᵘ sᵛ`.
declarations.statement:
lemma toLinearMap₂_apply [HasContrDualBases S] {x y : C} {cM : Fin 2 → C} (hx : S.τ x = cM 0)
    (hy : S.τ y = cM 1) (M : Tensor S cM) (t : Tensor S ![x]) (s : Tensor S ![y]) :
    toLinearMap₂ x y M hx hy t s =
      ∑ w : basisIdx y, ∑ z : basisIdx x,
        (basis ![x]).repr t (ComponentIdx.single.symm z) *
          toMatrix M (HasContrDualBases.dualIdxEquiv hx z) (HasContrDualBases.dualIdxEquiv hy w) *
          (basis ![y]).repr s (ComponentIdx.single.symm w)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix₂_toLinearMap₂
declarations.doc:
On basis vectors, the bilinear map gives `M(e_μ, e_ν) = M_{μν}`, so its matrix is the component
matrix `(M_{μν})`.
declarations.statement:
lemma toMatrix₂_toLinearMap₂ [HasContrDualBases S] {x y : C} {cM : Fin 2 → C}
    (hx : S.τ x = cM 0) (hy : S.τ y = cM 1) (M : Tensor S cM) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix₂
      ((basis ![x]).reindex (ComponentIdx.single.trans (HasContrDualBases.dualIdxEquiv hx)))
      ((basis ![y]).reindex (ComponentIdx.single.trans (HasContrDualBases.dualIdxEquiv hy)))
      (toLinearMap₂ x y M hx hy) = toMatrix M

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contractInnerT
declarations.doc:
The contraction `A_{μν} B^{νρ}` of the second index of `A` with the first index of `B`, whose
colours are dual by `h`. The result has the indices `μ` and `ρ`, in that order.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def contractInnerT {cs ds : Fin 2 → C} (h : S.τ (cs 1) = ds 0) :
    Tensor S cs →ₗ[k] Tensor S ds →ₗ[k] Tensor S ![cs 0, ds 1]

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contractInnerT_apply
declarations.doc:
`contractInnerT` is `crossToEnd` of the last index of `A` with the first index of `B`, with the
colours of the result renamed to `![cs 0, ds 1]`.
declarations.statement:
lemma contractInnerT_apply {cs ds : Fin 2 → C} (h : S.τ (cs 1) = ds 0) (a : Tensor S cs)
    (b : Tensor S ds) :
    contractInnerT h a b = permT id (IsReindexing.on_id.mpr fun j => by fin_cases j <;> rfl)
      (crossToEnd (Fin.last 1) (0 : Fin 2) h a b)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_eq_permT_contractInnerT
declarations.doc:
`crossToEnd` of the last index of `A` with the first index of `B` is `contractInnerT` with its
colours renamed. This is `contractInnerT_apply` read from right to left.
declarations.statement:
lemma crossToEnd_eq_permT_contractInnerT {cs ds : Fin 2 → C} (h : S.τ (cs 1) = ds 0)
    (a : Tensor S cs) (b : Tensor S ds) :
    crossToEnd (Fin.last 1) (0 : Fin 2) h a b =
      permT id (IsReindexing.on_id.mpr fun j => by fin_cases j <;> rfl) (contractInnerT h a b)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix_contractInnerT
declarations.doc:
The matrix of `A_{μν} B^{νρ}` is the matrix product of `(A_{μν})` and `(B^{νρ})`, with the
labels of `ν` in `B` matched to those in `A` by `dualIdxEquiv`. This is `toMatrix_crossToEnd_pair`
at general colour lists.
declarations.statement:
lemma toMatrix_contractInnerT [HasContrDualBases S] {cs ds : Fin 2 → C} (h : S.τ (cs 1) = ds 0)
    (a : Tensor S cs) (b : Tensor S ds) :
    toMatrix (contractInnerT h a b) =
      toMatrix a * (toMatrix b).submatrix (HasContrDualBases.dualIdxEquiv h) id

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contractInnerT_right_injective
declarations.doc:
If the matrix `(M_{μν})`, made square by the label bijection `e`, is invertible, then
`t ↦ M_{μν} t^{νρ}` is injective.
declarations.statement:
lemma contractInnerT_right_injective [HasContrDualBases S] {cs ds : Fin 2 → C}
    (h : S.τ (cs 1) = ds 0) (e : basisIdx (cs 0) ≃ basisIdx (cs 1)) (M : Tensor S cs)
    (hM : IsUnit ((toMatrix M).submatrix id e).det) :
    Function.Injective (contractInnerT h M)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contractInnerT_equivariant
declarations.doc:
`contractInnerT` commutes with the action of `G`. For a Lorentz transformation `Λ`,
`(Λ A)_{μν} (Λ B)^{νρ} = Λ (A_{μν} B^{νρ})`.
declarations.statement:
lemma contractInnerT_equivariant {cs ds : Fin 2 → C} (h : S.τ (cs 1) = ds 0) (g : G)
    (a : Tensor S cs) (b : Tensor S ds) :
    contractInnerT h (g • a) (g • b) = g • contractInnerT h a b

modules.title: Defining succSuccAbove
modules.doc:
In Mathlib there is the `Fin.succAbove` function which gives an embedding of `Fin n` into
`Fin (n + 1)` by leaving a hole at a specified index. We will need a version of this which
gives an embedding of `Fin n` into `Fin (n + 1 + 1)` by leaving holes at
two specified indices. We call this `succSuccAbove`.

We will also need an explicit inverse of this map from
`Fin (n + 1 + 1)` to `Fin n` which is defined on the complement of the two specified indices.
This is similar to `Fin.predAbove` (although not exactly the same),
for this reason we call it `predPredAbove`.

## Implementation

In previous versions of Physlib the function which is now called `succSuccAbove`
was previously called `dropPairEmb` and the function which is now called `predPredAbove` was
previously called `dropPairEmbPre`.

sections.text:
The definition below is deliberately explicit. Later lemmas identify it with
`Finset.orderEmbOfFin` and `Finset.orderIsoOfFin`, giving a bridge to the Mathlib
API while keeping this form convenient for computation and goals solved by
`decide`.

declarations.name: Fin.succSuccAbove
declarations.doc:
The embedding of `Fin n` into `Fin (n + 1 + 1)` which leaves a hole
at `i` and `j`.
declarations.statement: def succSuccAbove (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (m : Fin n) : Fin (n + 1 + 1)

declarations.name: Fin.succSuccAbove_val
declarations.statement:
lemma succSuccAbove_val (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (m : Fin n) :
    (succSuccAbove i j m).val = if m.1 < i.1 ∧ m.1 < j.1 then m.1
    else if m.1 + 1 < i.1 ∧ j.1 ≤ m.1 then m.1 + 1
    else if i.1 ≤ m.1 ∧ m.1 + 1 < j.1 then m.1 + 1
    else m.1 + 2

declarations.name: Fin.succSuccAbove_self_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma succSuccAbove_self_apply (i : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (m : Fin n) :
    succSuccAbove i i m = if m.1 < i.1 then ⟨m.1, by omega⟩ else ⟨m.1 + 2, by omega⟩

declarations.name: Fin.succSuccAbove_eq_succAbove_succAbove
declarations.statement:
lemma succSuccAbove_eq_succAbove_succAbove (i : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    succSuccAbove i (i.succAbove j) = i.succAbove ∘ j.succAbove

declarations.name: Fin.succSuccAbove_eq_predAbove
declarations.statement:
lemma succSuccAbove_eq_predAbove {i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    succSuccAbove i j = fun x => i.succAbove (((Fin.predAbove 0 i).predAbove j).succAbove x)

declarations.name: Fin.succSuccAbove_injective
declarations.statement:
lemma succSuccAbove_injective {n : ℕ}
    (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) : Function.Injective (succSuccAbove i j)

declarations.name: Fin.succSuccAbove_eq_iff_eq
Fin.succSuccAbove_leq_iff_leq
Fin.succSuccAbove_lt_iff_lt
Fin.succSuccAbove_monotone
declarations.statement:
lemma succSuccAbove_monotone {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) :
    Monotone (succSuccAbove i j)

declarations.name: Fin.succSuccAbove_strictMono
declarations.statement:
lemma succSuccAbove_strictMono {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) :
    StrictMono (succSuccAbove i j)

declarations.name: Fin.succSuccAbove_range
declarations.statement:
lemma succSuccAbove_range {i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    Set.range (succSuccAbove i j) = {i, j}ᶜ

declarations.name: Fin.succSuccAbove_eq_orderEmbOfFin
declarations.statement:
lemma succSuccAbove_eq_orderEmbOfFin {n : ℕ}
    (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    succSuccAbove i j = Finset.orderEmbOfFin {i, j}ᶜ
    (by rw [Finset.card_compl]; simp [Finset.card_pair hij])

declarations.name: Fin.succSuccAbove_symm
declarations.statement:
lemma succSuccAbove_symm (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) :
    succSuccAbove i j = succSuccAbove j i

declarations.name: Fin.apply_succSuccAbove_symm
declarations.statement:
lemma apply_succSuccAbove_symm {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C} (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1))
    (k : Fin n) : c (succSuccAbove i j k) = c (succSuccAbove j i k)

declarations.name: Fin.succSuccAbove_apply_eq_orderIsoOfFin
declarations.statement:
lemma succSuccAbove_apply_eq_orderIsoOfFin {i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)} (hij : i ≠ j) (m : Fin n) :
    (succSuccAbove i j) m = (Finset.orderIsoOfFin {i, j}ᶜ
      (by rw [Finset.card_compl]; simp [Finset.card_pair hij])) m

declarations.name: Fin.succSuccAbove_image_compl
declarations.statement:
lemma succSuccAbove_image_compl {i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (X : Set (Fin n)) :
    (succSuccAbove i j) '' Xᶜ = ({i, j} ∪ succSuccAbove i j '' X)ᶜ

declarations.name: Fin.fst_ne_succSuccAbove_pre
declarations.statement:
lemma fst_ne_succSuccAbove_pre (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (m : Fin n) :
    ¬ i = succSuccAbove i j m

declarations.name: Fin.succSuccAbove_ne_fst
declarations.statement:
lemma succSuccAbove_ne_fst (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (m : Fin n) :
    ¬ succSuccAbove i j m = i

declarations.name: Fin.snd_ne_succSuccAbove_pre
declarations.statement:
lemma snd_ne_succSuccAbove_pre (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (m : Fin n) :
    ¬ j = (succSuccAbove i j) m

declarations.name: Fin.succSuccAbove_ne_snd
declarations.statement:
lemma succSuccAbove_ne_snd (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (m : Fin n) :
    ¬ succSuccAbove i j m = j

declarations.name: Fin.eq_or_exists_succSuccAbove
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_or_exists_succSuccAbove(i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j) (m : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) :
    m = i ∨ m = j ∨ ∃ m', m = succSuccAbove i j m'

declarations.name: Fin.succSuccAbove_apply_lt_lt
Fin.succSuccAbove_natAdd_apply_castAdd
declarations.statement:
lemma succSuccAbove_natAdd_apply_castAdd {n n1 : ℕ}
    (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (m : Fin n1) :
    (succSuccAbove (n := n1 + n) (Fin.natAdd n1 i) (Fin.natAdd n1 j))
    (Fin.castAdd n m) = Fin.castAdd (n + 1 + 1) (m)

declarations.name: Fin.succSuccAbove_castAdd_natAdd_apply_castAdd
declarations.doc:
Reinserting a left-block survivor `a` after removing the `i`-th slot of the left block and the
`j`-th slot of the right block of `Fin ((nA + 1) + (nB + 1))`, the removal read at the contracted
length `(nA + nB) + 1 + 1`. Unlike `succSuccAbove_natAdd_apply_castAdd` the two holes straddle the
two blocks, so the statement carries the reshaping `Fin.cast`s.
declarations.statement:
lemma succSuccAbove_castAdd_natAdd_apply_castAdd {nA nB : ℕ} (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin (nB + 1))
    (a : Fin nA) :
    Fin.cast (show (nA + nB) + 1 + 1 = (nA + 1) + (nB + 1) by omega)
        ((Fin.cast (show (nA + 1) + (nB + 1) = (nA + nB) + 1 + 1 by omega)
            (Fin.castAdd (nB + 1) i)).succSuccAbove
          (Fin.cast (show (nA + 1) + (nB + 1) = (nA + nB) + 1 + 1 by omega)
            (Fin.natAdd (nA + 1) j)) (Fin.castAdd nB a))
      = Fin.castAdd (nB + 1) (i.succAbove a)

declarations.name: Fin.succSuccAbove_castAdd_natAdd_apply_natAdd
declarations.doc:
Reinserting a right-block survivor, the mirror of
`Fin.succSuccAbove_castAdd_natAdd_apply_castAdd`.
declarations.statement:
lemma succSuccAbove_castAdd_natAdd_apply_natAdd {nA nB : ℕ} (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin (nB + 1))
    (a : Fin nB) :
    Fin.cast (show (nA + nB) + 1 + 1 = (nA + 1) + (nB + 1) by omega)
        ((Fin.cast (show (nA + 1) + (nB + 1) = (nA + nB) + 1 + 1 by omega)
            (Fin.castAdd (nB + 1) i)).succSuccAbove
          (Fin.cast (show (nA + 1) + (nB + 1) = (nA + nB) + 1 + 1 by omega)
            (Fin.natAdd (nA + 1) j)) (Fin.natAdd nA a))
      = Fin.natAdd (nA + 1) (j.succAbove a)

declarations.name: Fin.succSuccAbove_natAdd_image_range_castAdd
Fin.succSuccAbove_comm_natAdd
declarations.statement:
lemma succSuccAbove_comm_natAdd {n n1 : ℕ}
    (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (m : Fin n) :
    succSuccAbove (n := n1 + n) (Fin.natAdd n1 i) (Fin.natAdd n1 j) (Fin.natAdd n1 m)
    = Fin.natAdd (n1) (succSuccAbove i j m)

declarations.name: Fin.predPredAbove
declarations.doc:
The preimage of `m` under `succSuccAbove i j hij` given that `m` is not equal
to `i` or `j`.
declarations.statement:
def predPredAbove (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j) (m : Fin (n + 1 + 1))
    (hm : m ≠ i ∧ m ≠ j) : Fin n

declarations.name: Fin.predPredAbove_val
declarations.statement:
lemma predPredAbove_val (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j) (m : Fin (n + 1 + 1))
    (hm : m ≠ i ∧ m ≠ j) :
    (predPredAbove i j hij m hm).val = if m.1 < i.1 ∧ m.1 < j.1 then m.1
    else if m.1 - 1 < i.1 ∧ j.1 ≤ m.1 then m.1 - 1
    else if i.1 - 1 ≤ m.1 ∧ m.1 < j.1 then m.1 - 1
    else m.1 - 2

declarations.name: Fin.succSuccAbove_predPredAbove
declarations.statement:
lemma succSuccAbove_predPredAbove (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j) (m : Fin (n + 1 + 1))
    (hm : m ≠ i ∧ m ≠ j) :
    succSuccAbove i j (predPredAbove i j hij m hm) = m

declarations.name: Fin.predPredAbove_eq_orderIsoOfFin
declarations.statement:
lemma predPredAbove_eq_orderIsoOfFin (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j) (m : Fin (n + 1 + 1))
    (hm : m ≠ i ∧ m ≠ j) :
    predPredAbove i j hij m hm =
    (Finset.orderIsoOfFin {i, j}ᶜ (by rw [Finset.card_compl]; simp [Finset.card_pair hij])).symm
    ⟨m, by simp [hm]⟩

declarations.name: Fin.predPredAbove_injective
declarations.statement:
lemma predPredAbove_injective (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (m1 m2 : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hm1 : m1 ≠ i ∧ m1 ≠ j) (hm2 : m2 ≠ i ∧ m2 ≠ j) :
    predPredAbove i j hij m1 hm1 = predPredAbove i j hij m2 hm2 ↔ m1 = m2

declarations.name: Fin.predPredAbove_surjective
declarations.statement:
lemma predPredAbove_surjective (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (m : Fin n) : ∃ m' : Fin (n + 1 + 1), ∃ (h : m' ≠ i ∧ m' ≠ j),
    predPredAbove i j hij m' h = m

declarations.name: Fin.predPredAbove_succSuccAbove
declarations.statement:
lemma predPredAbove_succSuccAbove (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (m : Fin n) :
    predPredAbove i j hij (succSuccAbove i j m) (by simp) = m

declarations.name: Fin.succSuccAbove_comm
Fin.succSuccAbove_comm_apply
Fin.funPredPredAbove
declarations.doc:
Given a bijection `Fin (n1 + 1 + 1) → Fin (n + 1 + 1))` and a pair `i j : Fin (n1 + 1 + 1)`,
then `funPredPredAbove i j _ σ _ : Fin n1 → Fin n` corresponds to the induced bijection
formed by dropping `i` and `j` in the source and their image in the target.

declarations.name: Fin.funPredPredAbove_injective
declarations.statement:
lemma funPredPredAbove_injective {n n1 : ℕ} (i j : Fin (n1 + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (σ : Fin (n1 + 1 + 1) → Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hσ : Function.Bijective σ) :
    Function.Injective (funPredPredAbove i j hij σ hσ)

declarations.name: Fin.funPredPredAbove_surjective
declarations.statement:
lemma funPredPredAbove_surjective {n n1 : ℕ} (i j : Fin (n1 + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (σ : Fin (n1 + 1 + 1) → Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hσ : Function.Bijective σ) :
    Function.Surjective (funPredPredAbove i j hij σ hσ)

declarations.name: Fin.funPredPredAbove_bijective
declarations.statement:
lemma funPredPredAbove_bijective {n n1 : ℕ} (i j : Fin (n1 + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (σ : Fin (n1 + 1 + 1) → Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hσ : Function.Bijective σ) :
    Function.Bijective (funPredPredAbove i j hij σ hσ)

declarations.name: Fin.funPredPredAbove_id
declarations.statement:
lemma funPredPredAbove_id { n1 : ℕ} (i j : Fin (n1 + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    funPredPredAbove i j hij id (Function.bijective_id) = id

declarations.name: Fin.succSuccAbove_succAbove_comm_apply
declarations.doc: Pointwise form of commuting deletion of one slot with deletion of a pair.
declarations.statement:
lemma succSuccAbove_succAbove_comm_apply {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1 + 1))
    (k : Fin (n + 1)) (m : Fin n) :
    (i.succSuccAbove j k).succAbove
        (((Fin.predAbove 0 (i.succSuccAbove j k)).predAbove i).succSuccAbove
          ((Fin.predAbove 0 (i.succSuccAbove j k)).predAbove j) m) =
      i.succSuccAbove j (k.succAbove m)

modules.title: Contraction against the unit tensor
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

The unit tensor is the identity for slot contraction: contracting any slot of `t` against
`unitTensor` for that slot's color returns `t`, the slot relabelled to the survivor tail. That is
what collapses "raise then lower" to the identity, a metric contracted against its dual becoming
the unit tensor and then contracting away.

`crossToEnd_unitTensor` is proved by decomposing `t` along its last slot (`eq_sum_evalT`) and
transporting to an arbitrary slot with the transposition `swap i (last)`. On it the round trip
against a matched pair is assembled in both conventions, and a pair collapsing in *both* orders
makes the two contractions mutually inverse, which `crossToSlotEquiv` bundles as a linear
equivalence between the two color assignments.

Since `unitTensor` is `RCLike`-valued, this material sits over an `[RCLike k]` variable block, apart
from the `CommRing` `crossToEnd`/`crossToSlot` algebra.

## ii. Key results

- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_unitTensor` : the unit tensor is an identity for `crossToEnd`
    at any named slot.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_round_trip_of_unit_slot` : two contractions against a pair that
    collapses to the unit tensor return the original tensor, in result-to-end form.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot_raise_lower_round_trip` : the round trip in result-to-slot
    form, every color propositional.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlotEquiv` : raising and lowering a named index against a pair that
    collapses in both orders, as a linear equivalence.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.contractInnerT_eq_unitTensor_comm` : if the label sets of the two indices
    of `M` are in bijection, `M_{μν} M'^{νρ} = δ_μ^ρ` implies `M'^{νρ} M_{ρσ} = δ^ν_σ`.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The unit tensor as a slot-contraction identity
- B. Round trips against a matched pair
- C. Raising and lowering as an equivalence
- D. One contraction law from the other

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text:
## A. The unit tensor as a slot-contraction identity

Contracting a named slot against `unitTensor` returns the tensor unchanged, the slot carried to the
survivor tail by `move_last`.

## B. Round trips against a matched pair

If `M_{μν} M'^{νρ} = δ_μ^ρ`, contracting an index of a tensor `t` with `M` and then with `M'` gives
back `t`. The metric and its inverse are such a pair.

## C. Raising and lowering as an equivalence

Both collapse orders are hypotheses here and each is used once: `M · M' = δ` gives one round trip
by section B, `M' · M = δ` the other through injectivity of the lowering half. If the label sets of
the two indices of `M` are in bijection, as for a metric, the second law follows from the first
(section D).
## D. One contraction law from the other

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_unitTensor
declarations.doc:
Contracting slot `i` of `t1` against the unit tensor for that slot's color returns `t1`, the
contracted slot relabelled by `move_last i`. The unit tensor acts as an identity for `crossToEnd`
at any named slot.
declarations.statement:
lemma crossToEnd_unitTensor {nA : ℕ} {cA : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {c : C}
    (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (hc : cA i = c) (t1 : Tensor S cA) :
    crossToEnd i (0 : Fin 2) (by simp [hc] : S.τ (cA i) = ![S.τ c, c] 0) t1 (unitTensor c) =
      permT (Fin.append i.succAbove (fun _ : Fin 1 => i)) (IsReindexing.move_last i hc) t1

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_round_trip_of_unit_slot
declarations.doc:
If `M₁_{μν} M₂^{νρ} = δ_μ^ρ`, contracting slot `i` of `t` with `M₁` and then with `M₂` gives
back `t` with that slot moved to the end, because `crossToEnd` places the surviving index last.
The last slot is a variable `j` with `hj : j = last nA`, so the lemma also applies where `j` is
last only up to an equality.
declarations.statement:
lemma crossToEnd_round_trip_of_unit_slot {nA : ℕ} {c : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {d : C}
    (i j : Fin (nA + 1)) (hj : j = Fin.last nA)
    (M₁ : Tensor S ![S.τ (c i), d]) (M₂ : Tensor S ![S.τ d, c i])
    (hM : contractInnerT rfl M₁ M₂ =
      permT (id : Fin 2 → Fin 2) (IsReindexing.unitTensor_of_tau_eq rfl)
        (unitTensor (S := S) (c i)))
    (t : Tensor S c) :
    crossToEnd j (0 : Fin 2)
        (by subst hj
            rw [show (Fin.last nA : Fin (nA + 1)) = Fin.natAdd nA (0 : Fin 1) from
                  Fin.ext (by simp), Fin.append_right]; rfl)
        (crossToEnd i (0 : Fin 2) rfl t M₁) M₂ =
      permT (Fin.append i.succAbove (fun _ : Fin 1 => i))
        (by
          subst hj
          exact ⟨by
            rw [Fin.append_succAbove_const_eq_cycleIcc i]
            exact (Fin.cycleIcc i (Fin.last nA)).bijective,
          fun x => by
            refine Fin.addCases (fun a => ?_) (fun a => ?_) x
            · simp only [Function.comp_apply, Fin.append_left, Fin.succAbove_last,
                show (Fin.castSucc a : Fin (nA + 1)) = Fin.castAdd 1 a from rfl]
            · fin_cases a
              simp [Fin.append_right, Fin.succAbove_zero]⟩)
        t

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot_raise_lower_round_trip
declarations.doc:
If `M_{μν} M'^{νρ} = δ_μ^ρ`, contracting slot `i` of `t` with `M` and then with `M'` gives back
`t` in place, up to renaming the colour of slot `i`. The equalities `ha`, `hb` and `he` match
slot `i` with the indices of `M` and `M'`, so `M` and `M'` can have any colour lists.
declarations.statement:
lemma crossToSlot_raise_lower_round_trip {nA : ℕ} {c : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {cs ds : Fin 2 → C}
    (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (he : c i = ds 1) (ha : S.τ (c i) = cs 0) (hb : S.τ (cs 1) = ds 0)
    (M : Tensor S cs) (M' : Tensor S ds)
    (hM : contractInnerT hb M M' =
      permT (id : Fin 2 → Fin 2)
        (IsReindexing.unitTensor_of_tau_eq ((congrArg S.τ he.symm).trans ha))
        (unitTensor (S := S) (ds 1)))
    (t : Tensor S c) :
    crossToSlot (S := S) i (0 : Fin 2)
        (by rw [Function.update_self]; exact hb : S.τ (Function.update c i (cs 1) i) = ds 0) M'
        (crossToSlot (S := S) i (0 : Fin 2) ha M t) =
      permT (id : Fin (nA + 1) → Fin (nA + 1)) (IsReindexing.update_update_of_eq i he) t

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlotInv_crossToSlot
declarations.doc: If `M_{μν} M'^{νρ} = δ_μ^ρ`, `crossToSlotInv` with `M'` undoes `crossToSlot` with `M`.
declarations.statement:
lemma crossToSlotInv_crossToSlot (t : Tensor S c) :
    crossToSlotInv i he hb M' (crossToSlot i (0 : Fin 2) ha M t) = t

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot_crossToSlotInv
declarations.doc:
If also `M'^{νρ} M_{ρσ} = δ^ν_σ`, `crossToSlot` with `M` undoes `crossToSlotInv` with `M'`. The
second law makes `crossToSlotInv` injective, so its left inverse is also a right inverse.
declarations.statement:
lemma crossToSlot_crossToSlotInv (t : Tensor S (Function.update c i (cs 1))) :
    crossToSlot i (0 : Fin 2) ha M (crossToSlotInv i he hb M' t) = t

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlotEquiv
declarations.doc:
The linear equivalence `crossToSlot` with `M`, with inverse `crossToSlotInv` with `M'`, when
`M_{μν} M'^{νρ} = δ_μ^ρ` and `M'^{νρ} M_{ρσ} = δ^ν_σ`. Slot `i` has colour `c i` on one side and
the colour `cs 1` of the second index of `M` on the other. For the metric this lowers and raises
an index with `η_{μν}` and `η^{νρ}`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def crossToSlotEquiv : Tensor S c ≃ₗ[k] Tensor S (Function.update c i (cs 1))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contractInnerT_eq_unitTensor_comm
declarations.doc:
If the label sets of the two indices of `M` are in bijection, `M_{μν} M'^{νρ} = δ_μ^ρ` implies
`M'^{νρ} M_{ρσ} = δ^ν_σ`. Without the bijection `e` this fails, since `A B = 1` does not imply
`B A = 1` for rectangular matrices.
declarations.statement:
lemma contractInnerT_eq_unitTensor_comm [HasContrDualBases S] {cs ds : Fin 2 → C}
    (hb : S.τ (cs 1) = ds 0) (ha : S.τ (ds 1) = cs 0) (e : basisIdx (cs 0) ≃ basisIdx (cs 1))
    (M : Tensor S cs) (M' : Tensor S ds)
    (h : contractInnerT hb M M' =
      permT id (IsReindexing.unitTensor_of_tau_eq ha) (unitTensor (S := S) (ds 1))) :
    contractInnerT ha M' M =
      permT id (IsReindexing.unitTensor_of_tau_eq hb) (unitTensor (S := S) (cs 1))

modules.title: Dual tensors
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

The metric tensor identifies a tensor with the one obtained by dualising the color of a single
index: contracting slot `i` of `t` against `metricTensor (S.τ (c i))` returns a tensor of color
`Function.update c i (S.τ (c i))`, leaving every other slot alone. This is the raising and lowering
of a named index, `T^{μν} ↦ T_{μ}{}^{ν}`. `toDualMapAtIndex i` is that contraction, `crossToSlot`
against the metric, at every rank and every named slot.

A metric contracted against the metric at the dual color collapses to the unit tensor, in both
orders. So the contraction back against `metricTensor (c i)`, `fromDualMapAtIndex i`, inverts it,
and the two assemble into the linear equivalence `toDualAtIndex i`: the two color assignments
carry the same information. Dualising the same index twice returns the original tensor, up to the
reindexing of the colors.

## ii. Key results

- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.toDualMapAtIndex` : dualise the color of the index `i` by contracting with
    the metric tensor.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.fromDualMapAtIndex` : the returning contraction, against the metric tensor
    at `c i`.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.toDualMapAtIndex_toDualMapAtIndex` : dualising the index `i` twice returns
    the original tensor.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.toDualMapAtIndex_equivariant` : dualising an index commutes with the
    `G`-action.
- `TensorSpecies.Tensor.toDualAtIndex` : raising and lowering the index `i` as a linear
    equivalence.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. Dualising a named index
- B. Contracting a metric against its dual
- C. Dualising twice
- D. The returning contraction
- E. Equivariance
- F. Raising and lowering as an equivalence

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text: ## B. Contracting a metric against its dual
## F. Raising and lowering as an equivalence

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toDualMapAtIndex
declarations.doc:
The linear map between `S.Tensor c` and `S.Tensor (Function.update c i (S.τ (c i)))`
formed by contracting the index `i` with the metric tensor.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def toDualMapAtIndex : {n : ℕ} → {c : Fin n → C} → (i : Fin n) →
    S.Tensor c →ₗ[k] S.Tensor (Function.update c i (S.τ (c i)))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contractInnerT_dual_metricTensor_metricTensor
declarations.doc:
The metric at `τ c` contracted with the metric at `c` is the unit tensor at `c`,
`η^{μν} η_{νρ} = δ^μ_ρ`.
declarations.statement:
lemma contractInnerT_dual_metricTensor_metricTensor {c : C} :
    contractInnerT (S.τ_τ_apply c) (metricTensor (S := S) (S.τ c)) (metricTensor (S := S) c) =
      permT (id : Fin 2 → Fin 2) (IsReindexing.unitTensor_of_tau_eq rfl)
        (unitTensor (S := S) c)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contractInnerT_metricTensor_metricTensor_eq_dual_unit
declarations.doc:
The metric at `c` contracted with the metric at `τ c` is the unit tensor at `τ c`,
`η_{μν} η^{νρ} = δ_μ^ρ`.
declarations.statement:
lemma contractInnerT_metricTensor_metricTensor_eq_dual_unit {c : C} :
    contractInnerT rfl (metricTensor (S := S) c) (metricTensor (S := S) (S.τ c)) =
      permT (id : Fin 2 → Fin 2) (IsReindexing.unitTensor_of_tau_eq (S.τ_τ_apply c))
        (unitTensor (S := S) (S.τ c))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toDualMapAtIndex_toDualMapAtIndex
declarations.doc:
Dualising the index `i` twice returns the original tensor, up to the reindexing of the
colors.
declarations.statement:
lemma toDualMapAtIndex_toDualMapAtIndex {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C}
    (i : Fin n) (t : S.Tensor c) :
    toDualMapAtIndex (S := S) i (toDualMapAtIndex (S := S) i t) =
      permT (id : Fin n → Fin n)
        (IsReindexing.update_update_of_eq i (by simp [τ_τ_apply])) t

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.fromDualMapAtIndex
declarations.doc:
The linear map between `S.Tensor (Function.update c i (S.τ (c i)))` and `S.Tensor c`
formed by contracting the index `i` with the metric tensor. It is the inverse of
`toDualMapAtIndex`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def fromDualMapAtIndex : {n : ℕ} → {c : Fin n → C} → (i : Fin n) →
    S.Tensor (Function.update c i (S.τ (c i))) →ₗ[k] S.Tensor c

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.fromDualMapAtIndex_toDualMapAtIndex
declarations.statement:
lemma fromDualMapAtIndex_toDualMapAtIndex {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} (i : Fin n) (t : S.Tensor c) :
    fromDualMapAtIndex (S := S) i (toDualMapAtIndex (S := S) i t) = t

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toDualMapAtIndex_fromDualMapAtIndex
declarations.statement:
lemma toDualMapAtIndex_fromDualMapAtIndex {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} (i : Fin n)
