    (t : S.Tensor (Function.update c i (S.τ (c i)))) :
    toDualMapAtIndex (S := S) i (fromDualMapAtIndex (S := S) i t) = t

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toDualMapAtIndex_equivariant
declarations.doc: Dualising the index `i` commutes with the action of `G`.
declarations.statement:
lemma toDualMapAtIndex_equivariant {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} (i : Fin n) (g : G) (t : S.Tensor c) :
    toDualMapAtIndex (S := S) i (g • t) = g • toDualMapAtIndex (S := S) i t

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toDualAtIndex
declarations.doc:
The linear equivalence between `S.Tensor c` and `S.Tensor (Function.update c i (S.τ (c i)))`
formed by contracting the index `i` with the metric tensor.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def toDualAtIndex : {n : ℕ} → {c : Fin n → C} → (i : Fin n) →
    S.Tensor c ≃ₗ[k] S.Tensor (Function.update c i (S.τ (c i)))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toDualAtIndex_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma toDualAtIndex_apply {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} (i : Fin n) (t : S.Tensor c) :
    toDualAtIndex (S := S) i t = toDualMapAtIndex (S := S) i t

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toDualAtIndex_symm_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma toDualAtIndex_symm_apply {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} (i : Fin n)
    (t : S.Tensor (Function.update c i (S.τ (c i)))) :
    (toDualAtIndex (S := S) i).symm t = fromDualMapAtIndex (S := S) i t

modules.title: Elaboration of tensor expressions
modules.doc:
- Syntax in Lean allows us to represent tensor expressions in a way close to what we expect to
  see on pen-and-paper.
- The elaborator turns this syntax into a tensor tree.

## Examples

- Suppose `T` and `T'` are tensors with color `![c1, c2]`.
- `{T | μ ν}ᵀ` is `tensorNode T`.
- We can also write e.g. `{T | μ ν}ᵀ.tensor` to get the tensor itself.
- `{- T | μ ν}ᵀ` is `neg (tensorNode T)`.
- `{T | 0 ν}ᵀ` is `eval 0 0 (tensorNode T)`.
- `{T | [μ] ν}ᵀ` is `eval 0 μ (tensorNode T)`.
- `{T | μ ν + T' | μ ν}ᵀ` is `addNode (tensorNode T) (perm _ (tensorNode T'))`, where
  here `_` will be the identity permutation so does nothing.
- `{T | μ ν = T' | μ ν}ᵀ` is `(tensorNode T).tensor = (perm _ (tensorNode T')).tensor`.
- If `a ∈ k` then `{a •ₜ T | μ ν}ᵀ` is `smulNode a (tensorNode T)`.
- If `g ∈ S.G` then `{g •ₐ T | μ ν}ᵀ` is `actionNode g (tensorNode T)`.
- Suppose `T2` is a tensor with color `![c3]`.
  Then `{T | μ ν ⊗ T2 | σ}ᵀ` is `prodNode (tensorNode T) (tensorNode T2)`.
- If `T3` is a tensor with color `![S.τ c1, S.τ c2]`, then
  `{T | μ ν ⊗ T3 | μ σ}ᵀ` is `contr 0 1 _ (prodNode (tensorNode T) (tensorNode T3))`.
  `{T | μ ν ⊗ T3 | μ ν }ᵀ` is
  `contr 0 0 _ (contr 0 1 _ (prodNode (tensorNode T) (tensorNode T3)))`.
- If `T4` is a tensor with color `![c2, c1]` then
  `{T | μ ν + T4 | ν μ }ᵀ`is `addNode (tensorNode T) (perm _ (tensorNode T4))` where `_`
  is the permutation of the two indices of `T4`.
  `{T | μ ν = T4 | ν μ }ᵀ` is `(tensorNode T).tensor = (perm _ (tensorNode T4)).tensor` is the
  permutation of the two indices of `T4`.

## Comments

- In all of these expressions `μ`, `ν` etc are free. It does not matter what they are called,
  Lean will elaborate them in the same way. In other words, `{T | μ ν ⊗ T3 | μ ν }ᵀ` is exactly
  the same to Lean as `{T | α β ⊗ T3 | α β }ᵀ`.
- Note that compared to ordinary index notation, we do not rise or lower the indices.
  This is for two reasons: 1) It is difficult to make this general for all tensor species,
  2) It is a redundancy in ordinary index notation, since the tensor `T` itself already tells you
  this information.

sections.text: ## Syntax of tensor expressions to indices.

## Test cases

We pin the elaboration of the `{ … }ᵀ` notation for each construct it supports: bare tensor
nodes, a genuine `Tensorial` instance, negation, evaluation, scalar multiplication, the group
action, products, contractions, addition and equality. Together these check that the elaborator
inserts neither a redundant `Tensorial.toTensor` wrapper on a bare `S.Tensor` term nor an
identity `permT` when the two sides already align, while keeping the `toTensor` coercion of a
genuine `Tensorial` instance and a genuine `permT` for a real reindexing.

The second element of each pair is the number corresponding to that index.

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.evalPCoeff
declarations.doc:
Given a `i : Fin (n + 1)`, a `b : basisIdx (c i)` and a pure tensor
`p : Pure S c`, `evalPCoeff i b p` is the `b`th component of `p i`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def evalPCoeff (i : Fin (n + 1)) (φ : basisIdx (c i)) (p : Pure S c) : k

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.evalPCoeff_update_self
declarations.statement:
lemma evalPCoeff_update_self (i : Fin (n + 1)) [inst : DecidableEq (Fin (n + 1))]
    (φ : basisIdx (c i)) (p : Pure S c)
    (x : V (c i)) :
    evalPCoeff i φ (p.update i x) = (b (c i)).repr x φ

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.evalPCoeff_update_succAbove
declarations.statement:
lemma evalPCoeff_update_succAbove (i : Fin (n + 1)) [inst : DecidableEq (Fin (n + 1))]
    (j : Fin n)
    (φ : basisIdx (c i)) (p : Pure S c)
    (x : V (c (i.succAbove j))) :
    evalPCoeff i φ (p.update (i.succAbove j) x) = evalPCoeff i φ p

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.evalPCoeff_basisVector
declarations.statement:
lemma evalPCoeff_basisVector (i : Fin (n + 1)) (φ : basisIdx (c i)) (b' : ComponentIdx (S := S) c) :
    evalPCoeff i φ (Pure.basisVector c b') = if b' i = φ then (1 : k) else 0

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.evalP
declarations.doc:
Given a `i : Fin (n + 1)`, a `φ : basisIdx (c i)` and a pure tensor
`p : Pure S c`, `evalP i φ p` is the tensor formed by evaluating the `i`th index
of `p` at `φ`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def evalP (i : Fin (n + 1)) (φ : basisIdx (c i)) (p : Pure S c) :
  Tensor S (c ∘ i.succAbove)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.evalP_update_add
declarations.statement:
lemma evalP_update_add [inst : DecidableEq (Fin (n + 1))] (i j : Fin (n + 1))
    (φ : basisIdx (c i)) (p : Pure S c)
    (x y: V (c j)) :
    evalP i φ (p.update j (x + y)) =
    evalP i φ (p.update j x) + evalP i φ (p.update j y)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.evalP_update_smul
declarations.statement:
lemma evalP_update_smul [inst : DecidableEq (Fin (n + 1))] (i j : Fin (n + 1))
    (φ : basisIdx (c i)) (p : Pure S c)
    (r : k)
    (x : V (c j)) :
    evalP i φ (p.update j (r • x)) =
    r • evalP i φ (p.update j x)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.evalPMultilinear
declarations.doc: The multi-linear map formed by evaluation of an index of pure tensors.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def evalPMultilinear {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1)→ C}
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (φ : basisIdx (c i)) :
    MultilinearMap k (fun i => V (c i))
      (S.Tensor (c ∘ i.succAbove))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.evalT
declarations.doc: Evaluation of a tensor at a given index and basis element.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def evalT {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1) → C} (i : Fin (n + 1))
      (φ : basisIdx (c i)) :
    Tensor S c →ₗ[k] Tensor S (c ∘ i.succAbove)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.evalT_pure
declarations.statement:
lemma evalT_pure {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1) → C} (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (φ : basisIdx (c i)) (p : Pure S c) :
    evalT i φ p.toTensor = Pure.evalP i φ p

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.evalT_basis
declarations.statement:
lemma evalT_basis {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1) → C} (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (b : ComponentIdx c) (x : basisIdx (c i)) :
    evalT i x (basis (S := S) c b) = if b i = x then basis (c ∘ i.succAbove)
      (fun j => b (i.succAbove j)) else 0

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.evalT_permT
declarations.doc: Commuting evaluation with permutations.

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.evalT_evalT_basis
declarations.doc: Commutation of two evaluations on a tensor basis vector.
declarations.statement:
lemma evalT_evalT_basis {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    (k1 : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (k2 : Fin (n + 1)) (φ1 : basisIdx (c k1))
    (φ2 : basisIdx ((c ∘ k1.succAbove) k2)) (ψ : ComponentIdx (S := S) c) :
    evalT k2 φ2 (evalT k1 φ1 (basis (S := S) c ψ)) =
      permT id (IsReindexing.succAbove_succAbove_comm k1 k2)
        (evalT (k2.predAbove k1)
          (basisIdxCongr
            (congrArg c (Fin.succAbove_succAbove_predAbove k1 k2).symm) φ1)
          (evalT (k1.succAbove k2) φ2 (basis (S := S) c ψ)))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.evalT_evalT
declarations.doc:
Evaluating two tensor indices commutes, up to the canonical reindexing
identifying the two possible orders in which the indices are removed.
declarations.statement:
lemma evalT_evalT {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    (k1 : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (k2 : Fin (n + 1)) (φ1 : basisIdx (c k1))
    (φ2 : basisIdx ((c ∘ k1.succAbove) k2)) (t : Tensor S c) :
    evalT k2 φ2 (evalT k1 φ1 t) =
      permT id (IsReindexing.succAbove_succAbove_comm k1 k2)
        (evalT (k2.predAbove k1)
          (basisIdxCongr
            (congrArg c (Fin.succAbove_succAbove_predAbove k1 k2).symm) φ1)
          (evalT (k1.succAbove k2) φ2 t))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contrT_evalT
declarations.doc:
Commuting evaluation with contraction. Evaluating index `k` and then contracting the
pair `i j` equals contracting the corresponding pair `k.succAbove i`, `k.succAbove j` and
then evaluating the residual index, up to the identity reindexing
`IsReindexing.succAbove_succSuccAbove_comm`.
declarations.statement:
lemma contrT_evalT {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1 + 1) → C}
    (k : Fin (n + 1 + 1 + 1)) (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (φ : basisIdx (c k))
    (hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ ((c ∘ k.succAbove) i) = (c ∘ k.succAbove) j) (t : Tensor S c) :
    contrT n i j hij (evalT k φ t) =
    permT id (.succAbove_succSuccAbove_comm k i j hij.1)
      (evalT (Fin.predPredAbove (k.succAbove i) (k.succAbove j) (by simp [hij.1]) k (by simp))
        (basisIdxCongr (by simp) φ)
        (contrT (n + 1) (k.succAbove i) (k.succAbove j) ⟨by simp [hij.1], hij.2⟩ t))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.evalT_prodT_right
declarations.doc:
Evaluating an index in the right factor of a tensor product commutes with forming the
product, up to the identity reindexing which identifies the two ways of removing that
index from the appended color list.
declarations.statement:
lemma evalT_prodT_right {n n1 : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} {c1 : Fin (n1 + 1) → C}
    (i : Fin (n1 + 1)) (x : basisIdx (c1 i)) (t : Tensor S c) (t1 : Tensor S c1) :
    prodT t (evalT i x t1) =
    permT id (IsReindexing.append_succAbove_natAdd (n := n) (n1 := n1) i)
      (evalT (Fin.natAdd (m := n1 + 1) n i) (basisIdxCongr (by simp) x) (prodT t t1))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.evalT_basis_single
declarations.doc:
Evaluating the single-index basis tensor `basis ![c] (single.symm b)` at the index `x`
yields the field element `1` if `b = x` (transported across `![c] 0 = c`) and `0` otherwise:
evaluation of a one-index basis tensor is the Kronecker delta.
declarations.statement:
lemma evalT_basis_single {c : C} (b : basisIdx c) (x : basisIdx (![c] 0)) :
    (evalT 0 x (basis (S := S) ![c] (ComponentIdx.single.symm b))).toScalar =
    if basisIdxCongr (by simp) b =  x then 1 else 0

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.eq_sum_evalT_of_single_tensor_basis
declarations.doc:
Basis expansion of a one-index tensor: every `t : Tensor S ![c]` is the sum over basis
indices `i` of its evaluation coefficient `toScalar (evalT 0 i t)` times the corresponding
basis tensor.
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_sum_evalT_of_single_tensor_basis {c : C} (t : Tensor S ![c]) :
    t = ∑ i, toScalar (evalT 0 i t) • basis ![c] (ComponentIdx.single.symm
      (basisIdxCongr (by simp) i))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.eq_sum_evalT
declarations.doc:
Reconstruction of a tensor from the evaluations of its last index: every `t : Tensor S c`
is the sum over basis indices `i` of the evaluation `evalT (Fin.last n) i t` tensored with
the basis covector `basis ![c (Fin.last n)] (single.symm i)`, with the appended index
permuted back into the last slot.
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_sum_evalT {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1) → C} (t : Tensor S c) :
    t = ∑ i, permT id (IsReindexing.append_succ_last c) (prodT (evalT (Fin.last n) i t)
      (basis ![c (Fin.last n)] (ComponentIdx.single.symm i)))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.eq_sum_evalT_zero
declarations.doc:
Reconstruction of a tensor from the evaluations of its first index: every `t : Tensor S c`
is the sum over basis indices `i` of the basis covector `basis ![c 0] (single.symm i)` tensored
with the evaluation `evalT 0 i t`, with the prepended index permuted back into the first slot.
This is the first-index analogue of `eq_sum_evalT`.
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_sum_evalT_zero {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1) → C} (t : Tensor S c) :
    t = ∑ i, permT _ (IsReindexing.append_of_first c)
    (prodT (basis ![c 0] (ComponentIdx.single.symm i)) (evalT 0 i t))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.ext_of_evalT
declarations.statement:
lemma ext_of_evalT {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1) → C} (t1 t2 : Tensor S c)
    (h : ∀ i φ, evalT i φ t1 = evalT i φ t2) :
    t1 = t2

modules.title: The Levi-Civita tensor as a real Lorentz tensor
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

This file defines the rank-four Levi-Civita tensor `εᵘᵛᵖᵟ` as a real Lorentz tensor in
`d = 3` spatial dimensions, with `ε⁰¹²³ = 1`, and proves its antisymmetry under each
adjacent transposition of indices.

The component on a multi-index `f` is the generalized Kronecker delta of `f` against the
identity, i.e. the sign of `f` when `f` is a permutation and `0` otherwise. The integer
components are carried by `TensorSpecies.Tensor.TensorInt.toTensor`.

## ii. Key results

- `leviCivita` : the rank-four Levi-Civita tensor `ε4`, with `ε⁰¹²³ = 1`.
- `leviCivita_basis_repr_apply` : its standard-basis components as a generalized Kronecker delta.
- `leviCivita_basis_repr_eq_leviCivitaSymbol` : its standard-basis components as the
  general-dimension Levi-Civita symbol `leviCivitaSymbol` at `ι = Fin 4`.
- `leviCivita_antisymm`, `leviCivita_antisymm_mid`, `leviCivita_antisymm_last` : antisymmetry
  under each adjacent transposition of the indices.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. Definition
- B. Components in the standard basis
- C. Antisymmetry

## iv. References

* None.

declarations.doc:

The component on a multi-index `f` is the generalized Kronecker delta of `f` against the
identity, i.e. the sign of `f` when `f` is a permutation and `0` otherwise.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def leviCivita : ℝT[3, .up, .up, .up, .up]

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.leviCivita_eq_ofInt
declarations.doc: The `TensorInt.toTensor` form of the Levi-Civita tensor.
declarations.statement:
lemma leviCivita_eq_ofInt : ε4 =
    TensorInt.toTensor (S := realLorentzTensor 3)
    (c := ![Color.up, Color.up, Color.up, Color.up]) fun f =>
    generalizedKroneckerDelta (fun i => finSumFinEquiv (f i)) (id : Fin 4 → Fin 4)

declarations.name: euclidLeviCivita
declarations.doc: The Euclidean Levi-Civita symbol `ε_{ijkl}` in dimension 4.
declarations.statement: def _root_.euclidLeviCivita (g : Fin 4 → Fin 4) : ℝ

declarations.name: euclidLeviCivita_eq_leviCivitaSymbol
declarations.doc:
The Euclidean Levi-Civita symbol in dimension 4 is the general-dimension
Levi-Civita symbol `leviCivitaSymbol` at `ι = Fin 4`, carried to the reals.
declarations.statement:
lemma _root_.euclidLeviCivita_eq_leviCivitaSymbol (g : Fin 4 → Fin 4) :
    euclidLeviCivita g = (leviCivitaSymbol g : ℝ)

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.leviCivita_basis_repr_apply
declarations.doc:
The components of the Levi-Civita tensor in the standard basis are the generalized
Kronecker delta of the multi-index against the identity.
declarations.statement:
lemma leviCivita_basis_repr_apply
    (b : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor 3) ![Color.up, Color.up, Color.up, Color.up]) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr ε4 b
      = (generalizedKroneckerDelta (fun i => finSumFinEquiv (b i)) (id : Fin 4 → Fin 4) : ℝ)

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.leviCivita_basis_repr_eq_leviCivitaSymbol
declarations.doc:
The components of the Levi-Civita tensor in the standard basis are the
general-dimension Levi-Civita symbol `leviCivitaSymbol` of the multi-index at
`ι = Fin 4`.
declarations.statement:
lemma leviCivita_basis_repr_eq_leviCivitaSymbol
    (b : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor 3) ![Color.up, Color.up, Color.up, Color.up]) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr ε4 b
      = (leviCivitaSymbol (fun i => finSumFinEquiv (b i)) : ℝ)

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.leviCivita_basis_repr_eq_zero_of_eq
declarations.doc:
The Levi-Civita tensor vanishes on any multi-index with a repeated value: if two distinct
index positions `i ≠ j` carry the same basis index, the component is zero.
declarations.statement:
lemma leviCivita_basis_repr_eq_zero_of_eq
    {b : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor 3) ![Color.up, Color.up, Color.up, Color.up]}
    {i j : Fin 4} (hij : i ≠ j) (h : b i = b j) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr ε4 b = 0

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.leviCivita_antisymm
declarations.doc:
The Levi-Civita tensor is antisymmetric in its first two indices
`{ε4 | μ ν ρ σ = - ε4 | ν μ ρ σ}ᵀ`.
declarations.statement: lemma leviCivita_antisymm : {ε4 | μ ν ρ σ = - (ε4 | ν μ ρ σ)}ᵀ

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.leviCivita_antisymm_mid
declarations.doc:
The Levi-Civita tensor is antisymmetric in its middle two indices
`{ε4 | μ ν ρ σ = - ε4 | μ ρ ν σ}ᵀ`.
declarations.statement: lemma leviCivita_antisymm_mid : {ε4 | μ ν ρ σ = - (ε4 | μ ρ ν σ)}ᵀ

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.leviCivita_antisymm_last
declarations.doc:
The Levi-Civita tensor is antisymmetric in its last two indices
`{ε4 | μ ν ρ σ = - ε4 | μ ν σ ρ}ᵀ`.
declarations.statement: lemma leviCivita_antisymm_last : {ε4 | μ ν ρ σ = - (ε4 | μ ν σ ρ)}ᵀ

modules.doc:
This file complexifies the real Lorentz Levi-Civita tensor and records its components in the
Gaussian integer tensor basis.

declarations.name: complexLorentzTensor.leviCivita_isReindexing
declarations.doc:
The index colors of the complexified real Levi-Civita tensor agree with four complex
contravariant Lorentz indices.
declarations.statement:
lemma leviCivita_isReindexing : IsReindexing
    (realLorentzTensor.colorToComplex ∘
      ![realLorentzTensor.Color.up, realLorentzTensor.Color.up,
        realLorentzTensor.Color.up, realLorentzTensor.Color.up])
    ![Color.up, Color.up, Color.up, Color.up] id

declarations.name: complexLorentzTensor.leviCivita
declarations.doc: The Levi-Civita tensor `εᵘᵛᵖᵟ` as a complex Lorentz tensor, with `ε⁰¹²³ = 1`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def leviCivita : ℂT[.up, .up, .up, .up]

declarations.name: complexLorentzTensor.leviCivita_eq_ofGaussianInt
declarations.doc:
The complex Levi-Civita tensor has the Levi-Civita symbol as its real component and zero
imaginary component in the standard basis.
declarations.statement:
lemma leviCivita_eq_ofGaussianInt : ε4ℂ = ofGaussianInt (fun
    b : ComponentIdx (S := complexLorentzTensor) ![Color.up, Color.up, Color.up, Color.up] =>
    (generalizedKroneckerDelta
      (fun i => finSumFinEquiv (basisIdxCongr (c1 := Color.up) (by fin_cases i <;> rfl) (b i)))
      (id : Fin 4 → Fin 4) : GaussianInt))

declarations.name: complexLorentzTensor.leviCivita_eq_ofGaussianInt_prod
declarations.doc:
The components of the complex Levi-Civita tensor as the product over pairs `i < j` of the
sign of `b j - b i`, from `leviCivitaSymbol_eq_prod_prod_Ioi`. Unlike the determinant appearing
in `leviCivita_eq_ofGaussianInt`, these components are cheap to evaluate, e.g. by `decide`.
declarations.statement:
lemma leviCivita_eq_ofGaussianInt_prod : ε4ℂ = ofGaussianInt (fun
    b : ComponentIdx (S := complexLorentzTensor) ![Color.up, Color.up, Color.up, Color.up] =>
    (((∏ i : Fin 4, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i,
      (if finSumFinEquiv (basisIdxCongr (c1 := Color.up) (by fin_cases i <;> rfl) (b i)) <
          finSumFinEquiv (basisIdxCongr (c1 := Color.up) (by fin_cases j <;> rfl) (b j)) then 1
        else if finSumFinEquiv (basisIdxCongr (c1 := Color.up) (by fin_cases i <;> rfl) (b i)) =
          finSumFinEquiv (basisIdxCongr (c1 := Color.up) (by fin_cases j <;> rfl) (b j))
        then 0 else -1) : ℤ) :
      GaussianInt)))

modules.title: Contraction identities for the Levi-Civita tensor
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

This file proves the "epsilon-epsilon" contraction identities for the rank-four Levi-Civita
tensor `leviCivita` (notation `ε4`) in `d = 4`, stated in terms of the standard-basis
components of `ε4` itself (`realLorentzTensor.leviCivita_basis_repr_apply`).

The underlying facts about the `generalizedKroneckerDelta` alone, with no
tensor content, live in `Physlib.Mathematics.KroneckerDelta.Contraction`, next to the
definition of `generalizedKroneckerDelta`. Here we specialise those facts to the components of
`ε4`, where `(ε4)_b = (Tensor.basis _).repr ε4 b` is the standard-basis component of `ε4`, an
integer Levi-Civita symbol carried to the reals, and the sums run over the remaining
(uncontracted) component slots.

It also proves the Lorentzian tensor identities obtained by lowering all four indices of one
factor: the complete contraction is `-24`, while contracting three index pairs gives `-6` times
the unit tensor.

The Lorentzian proofs proceed through reusable component statements: lowering all four indices
contributes the orientation sign, tensor contractions become finite sums of matching components,
and the Euclidean contraction theorems evaluate those sums.

## ii. Key results

- `euclidLeviCivita_symbol_contract_zero` : full Euclidean contraction equals `24`.
- `euclidLeviCivita_symbol_contract_one` : the triple Euclidean contraction equals `6 · δ[a,b]`.
- `euclidLeviCivita_symbol_contract_two` :
  `∑_h (ε4)_{r,s,h} · (ε4)_{t,w,h} = 2 · (δ[r,t]·δ[s,w] - δ[r,w]·δ[s,t])`.
- `realLorentzTensor.leviCivita_lowered_basis_repr_apply` : lowering all four indices changes
  every standard-basis component by the Lorentzian orientation sign `-1`.
- `realLorentzTensor.leviCivita_contract_three_basis_repr_apply` : the tensor triple contraction
  is the sum of matching standard-basis components.
- `leviCivita_contract_self` : `ε^{μνρσ} ε_{μνρσ} = -24`.
- `leviCivita_contract_three` : `ε^{μνρσ} ε_{μνρτ} = -6 δ^σ_τ`.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. Euclidean epsilon-epsilon contraction identities
- B. Lorentzian epsilon-epsilon contraction identities
  - B.1. The epsilon-epsilon contraction identities

## iv. References

* None.

declarations.name: euclidLeviCivita_symbol_contract_zero
declarations.doc:
**Full Euclidean Levi-Civita contraction** `∑_b (ε4)_b · (ε4)_b = 24` at the symbol level:
summing the square of every standard-basis component of `ε4` over all four `Fin 4` index slots,
paired naively (no metric), counts the `4! = 24` permutations. The Lorentz contraction
`ε^{μνρσ} ε_{μνρσ}` lowers one factor with `η` and equals `-24` instead.
declarations.statement:
lemma euclidLeviCivita_symbol_contract_zero :
    ∑ g : (Fin 4 → Fin 4), euclidLeviCivita g * euclidLeviCivita g = 24

declarations.name: euclidLeviCivita_symbol_contract_one
declarations.doc:
**Triple Euclidean Levi-Civita contraction** `∑_h (ε4)_{a,h} · (ε4)_{b,h} = 6 · δ[a,b]` at
the symbol level: contracting three of the four `Fin 4` component slots of `ε4` with the naive
Kronecker pairing leaves one free pair `a, b` and the factor `3! = 6`. The Lorentz form carries
an extra `det η = -1`.
declarations.statement:
lemma euclidLeviCivita_symbol_contract_one (a b : Fin 4) :
    ∑ h : Fin 3 → Fin 4, euclidLeviCivita (Fin.cons a h) * euclidLeviCivita (Fin.cons b h)
      = 6 * ((kroneckerDelta a b : ℕ) : ℝ)

declarations.name: euclidLeviCivita_symbol_contract_one_last
declarations.doc:
**Triple Euclidean Levi-Civita contraction with the free index last.** This is the same
contraction as `euclidLeviCivita_symbol_contract_one`, in the slot order produced by the tensor
notation for `ε^{μνρσ} ε_{μνρτ}`.
declarations.statement:
lemma euclidLeviCivita_symbol_contract_one_last (a b : Fin 4) :
    ∑ h : Fin 3 → Fin 4, euclidLeviCivita (Fin.snoc h a) * euclidLeviCivita (Fin.snoc h b)
      = 6 * ((kroneckerDelta a b : ℕ) : ℝ)

declarations.name: euclidLeviCivita_symbol_contract_two
declarations.doc:
**Double Euclidean Levi-Civita contraction**
`∑_h (ε4)_{r,s,h} · (ε4)_{t,w,h} = 2 · (δ[r,t]·δ[s,w] - δ[r,w]·δ[s,t])` at the symbol level:
contracting two of the four `Fin 4` component slots of `ε4` with the naive Kronecker pairing
leaves two free pairs and the factor `2! = 2`. The Lorentz form carries an extra `det η = -1`.
declarations.statement:
lemma euclidLeviCivita_symbol_contract_two (r s t w : Fin 4) :
    ∑ h : Fin 2 → Fin 4, euclidLeviCivita (Fin.cons r (Fin.cons s h))
          * euclidLeviCivita (Fin.cons t (Fin.cons w h))
      = 2 * (((kroneckerDelta r t : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((kroneckerDelta s w : ℕ) : ℝ)
          - ((kroneckerDelta r w : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((kroneckerDelta s t : ℕ) : ℝ))

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.leviCivita_lowered_basis_repr_apply
declarations.doc:
Lowering all four indices of the Levi-Civita tensor changes the sign of every standard-basis
component. This is the tensor-component form of the Lorentzian orientation factor
`det η = -1`.
declarations.statement:
lemma leviCivita_lowered_basis_repr_apply
    (b : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor 3)
      ![Color.down, Color.down, Color.down, Color.down]) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr ({ε4 | τ(μ) τ(ν) τ(ρ) τ(σ)}ᵀ) b =
      - (Tensor.basis _).repr ε4 b

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.leviCivita_basis_contract_self
declarations.doc:
The sum of the squared standard-basis components of the contravariant Levi-Civita tensor is
`4! = 24`.
declarations.statement:
lemma leviCivita_basis_contract_self :
    ∑ b : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor 3)
        ![Color.up, Color.up, Color.up, Color.up],
      (Tensor.basis _).repr ε4 b * (Tensor.basis _).repr ε4 b = 24

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.leviCivita_basis_contract_three
declarations.doc:
Contracting the first three standard-basis components of two contravariant Levi-Civita tensors
gives `3! = 6` times the Kronecker delta on the remaining components.
declarations.statement:
lemma leviCivita_basis_contract_three (a b : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    ∑ h : Fin 3 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3,
      (Tensor.basis _).repr ε4 (Fin.snoc h a) *
      (Tensor.basis _).repr ε4 (Fin.snoc h b) =
      6 * (if a = b then 1 else 0)

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.leviCivita_contract_three_basis_repr_apply
declarations.doc:
The standard-basis component formula for the tensor contraction
`ε^{μνρσ} ε_{μνρτ}`.
declarations.statement:
lemma leviCivita_contract_three_basis_repr_apply
    (b : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor 3) ![Color.up, Color.down]) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr
        {ε4 | μ ν ρ σ ⊗ ε4 | τ(μ) τ(ν) τ(ρ) τ(τ)}ᵀ b =
      ∑ h : Fin 3 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3,
        (Tensor.basis _).repr ε4 (Fin.snoc h (b 0)) *
          (Tensor.basis _).repr ({ε4 | τ(μ) τ(ν) τ(ρ) τ(σ)}ᵀ) (Fin.snoc h (b 1))

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.leviCivita_contract_three
declarations.doc:
Contracting three indices of the Lorentzian Levi-Civita tensor with a fully lowered copy gives
`-6` times the mixed-index unit tensor.
declarations.statement:
lemma leviCivita_contract_three : {ε4 | μ ν ρ σ ⊗ ε4 | τ(μ) τ(ν) τ(ρ) τ(τ) =
    (-6) • unitTensor (S := realLorentzTensor) Color.down | σ τ }ᵀ

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.leviCivita_contract_self_eq_sum
declarations.doc:
Fully contracting the tensor product of `ε4` and its fully lowered form is the sum of the
products of their matching standard-basis components.
declarations.statement:
lemma leviCivita_contract_self_eq_sum :
    {ε4 | μ ν ρ σ ⊗ ε4 | τ(μ) τ(ν) τ(ρ) τ(σ)}ᵀ.toScalar =
      ∑ b : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor 3)
          ![Color.up, Color.up, Color.up, Color.up],
        (Tensor.basis _).repr ε4 b *
          (Tensor.basis _).repr ({ε4 | τ(μ) τ(ν) τ(ρ) τ(σ)}ᵀ) b

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.leviCivita_contract_self
declarations.doc: Fully contracting the Lorentzian Levi-Civita tensor with a lowered copy gives `-24`.
declarations.statement:
lemma leviCivita_contract_self :
    {ε4 | μ ν ρ σ ⊗ ε4 | τ(μ) τ(ν) τ(ρ) τ(σ)}ᵀ.toScalar = - 24

declarations.doc:
A component of the metric tensor is the corresponding component of the metric intertwiner
in the tensor-product basis.

    S.metricTensor c = permT id (by simp [h]) (metricTensor c1)

declarations.statement:
lemma permT_fromPairTContr_metric_metric {c : C} :
    permT ![1, 0] (And.intro (by decide) (fun i => by fin_cases i <;> rfl))
    (fromPairTContr ((S.metric c) (1 : k))
    ((S.metric ((S.τ c))) (1 : k))) = (unitTensor c)

    fromPairTContr ((S.metric c) (1 : k))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.contrT_metricTensor_metricTensor
declarations.doc:
The contraction of the metric tensor with its dual gives the unit tensor.
This is the de-categorification of `S.contr_metric`.
declarations.statement:
lemma contrT_metricTensor_metricTensor {c : C} :
    contrT 2 1 2 (by simp; rfl) (prodT (metricTensor c) (metricTensor (S.τ c))) =
      permT ![1, 0] (And.intro (by decide) (fun i => by fin_cases i <;> rfl))
      (unitTensor (S := S) c)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.contrT_metricTensor_metricTensor_eq_dual_unit
declarations.statement:
lemma contrT_metricTensor_metricTensor_eq_dual_unit {c : C} :
    contrT 2 1 2 (by simp; rfl) (prodT (metricTensor c) (metricTensor (S.τ c))) =
      permT ![0, 1] (And.intro (by decide) (fun i => by
        fin_cases i
        · change S.τ (S.τ c) = c
          simp
        · rfl))
      (unitTensor (S := S) (S.τ c))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.contrT_dual_metricTensor_metricTensor
declarations.statement:
lemma contrT_dual_metricTensor_metricTensor {c : C} :
    contrT 2 1 2 (by change _ ∧ S.τ (S.τ c) = c; simp)
      (prodT (metricTensor (S.τ c)) (metricTensor c)) =
      permT id (by simp; exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩) (unitTensor (S := S) c)

modules.title: The product of tensors
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

In this module we define the tensor product of
- index components of tensors,
- pure tensors, and
- tensors.
We prove a number of properties about these products, for example,
permutation of the factors, equivariance, and associativity.

## ii. Key results

- `Pure.prodP` : The tensor product of two pure tensors.
- `prodT` : The tensor product of two tensors.

The following results exist for both `prodP` and `prodT` :
- `prodT_swap` : Swapping the order of the product of two tensors.
- `prodT_permT_left` : Permuting the indices of the left tensor commute with the product.
- `prodT_permT_right` : Permuting the indices of the right tensor commute with the product.
- `prodT_equivariant` : The product of two tensors is equivariant.
- `prodT_assoc` : The product of three tensors is associative.
- `prodT_assoc'` : The product of three tensors is associative in the other direction.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. Products of index components
  - A.1. The product of component indices as an equivalence
- B. Products of pure tensors
  - B.1. Indexing pure tensors by `Fin n1 ⊕ Fin n2` rather than `Fin (n1 + n2)`
  - B.2. The product of two pure tensors
  - B.3. The vectors making up product of two pure tensors
  - B.4. The product of two pure basis vectors
  - B.5. The basis components of the product of two pure tensors
  - B.6. Equivariance of the product of two pure tensors
  - B.7. Product with a tensor with no indices on the right
  - B.8. Swapping the order of the product of two pure tensors
  - B.9. Permuting the indices of the left tensor in a product
  - B.10. Permuting the indices of the right tensor in a product
  - B.11. Associativity of the product of three pure tensors in one direction
  - B.12. Associativity of the product of three pure tensors in the other direction
- C. Products of tensors
  - C.1. Indexing tensors by `Fin n1 ⊕ Fin n2` rather than `Fin (n1 + n2)`
  - C.2. The product of two tensors
  - C.3. The product of two pure tensors as a tensor
  - C.4. The product of basis vectors
  - C.5. The product as an equivalence
  - C.6. Rewriting the basis for the product in terms of the tensor product basis
  - C.7. Equivariance of the product of two tensors
  - C.8. The product with the default tensor with no indices on the right
  - C.9. Swapping the order of the product of two tensors
  - C.10. Permuting the indices of the left tensor in a product
  - C.11. Permuting the indices of the right tensor in a product
  - C.12. Associativity of the product of three tensors in one direction
  - C.13. Associativity of the product of three tensors in the other direction

## iv. References

* Tooby-Smith, Formalization of physics index notation in Lean 4, arXiv:2411.07667.
  [ref: tooby_smith_2024_index_notation]

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.prodP
declarations.doc:
Given two pure tensors `p1 : Pure S c` and `p2 : Pure S c`, `prodP p p2` is the tensor
product of those tensors returning an element in
`Pure S (Sum.elim c c1 ∘ ⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm)`.
declarations.statement:
def Pure.prodP {n1 n2} {c : Fin n1 → C} {c1 : Fin n2 → C}
    (p1 : Pure S c) (p2 : Pure S c1) : Pure S (Fin.append c c1)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.prodP_apply_castAdd
declarations.statement:
lemma Pure.prodP_apply_castAdd {n1 n2} {c : Fin n1 → C} {c1 : Fin n2 → C}
    (p1 : Pure S c) (p2 : Pure S c1) (i : Fin n1) :
    Pure.prodP p1 p2 (Fin.castAdd n2 i) =
    LinearEquiv.cast (R := k) (by simp) (p1 i)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.prodP_apply_natAdd
declarations.statement:
lemma Pure.prodP_apply_natAdd {n1 n2} {c : Fin n1 → C} {c1 : Fin n2 → C}
    (p1 : Pure S c) (p2 : Pure S c1) (i : Fin n2) :
    Pure.prodP p1 p2 (Fin.natAdd n1 i) =
    LinearEquiv.cast (R := k) (by simp) (p2 i)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.prodP_apply_finSumFinEquiv
declarations.statement:
lemma Pure.prodP_apply_finSumFinEquiv {n1 n2} {c : Fin n1 → C} {c1 : Fin n2 → C}
    (p1 : Pure S c) (p2 : Pure S c1) (i : Fin n1 ⊕ Fin n2) :
    Pure.prodP p1 p2 (finSumFinEquiv i) =
    match i with
    | Sum.inl i => LinearEquiv.cast (R := k) (by simp) (p1 i)
    | Sum.inr i => LinearEquiv.cast (R := k) (by simp) (p2 i)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.prodP_basisVector
declarations.statement:
lemma Pure.prodP_basisVector {n n1 : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} {c1 : Fin n1 → C}
    (φ : ComponentIdx c) (φ1 : ComponentIdx (S := S) c1) :
    Pure.prodP (Pure.basisVector c φ) (Pure.basisVector c1 φ1) =
    Pure.basisVector _ (ComponentIdx.prod.symm (φ, φ1))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.prodP_component
declarations.statement:
lemma Pure.prodP_component {n m : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} {c1 : Fin m → C}
    (p : Pure S c) (p1 : Pure S c1)
    (φ : ComponentIdx (Fin.append c c1)) :
    (p.prodP p1).component φ = p.component (ComponentIdx.prod φ).1 *
    p1.component (ComponentIdx.prod φ).2

TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.prodP_zero_right
TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.prodP_swap
declarations.statement:
lemma Pure.prodP_swap {n n1} {c : Fin n → C} {c1 : Fin n1 → C} (p : Pure S c) (p1 : Pure S c1) :

declarations.statement:
lemma Pure.prodP_update_left {n1 n2} {c : Fin n1 → C} {c1 : Fin n2 → C}
    (p1 : Pure S c) (p2 : Pure S c1) (i : Fin n1) (x : V (c i)) :
    Pure.prodP (Pure.update p1 i x) p2
    = Pure.update (Pure.prodP p1 p2) (Fin.castAdd n2 i)
      (LinearEquiv.cast (R := k) (by simp) x)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.prodP_update_right
declarations.statement:

    (p1 : Pure S c) (p2 : Pure S c1) (i : Fin n2) (x : V (c1 i)) :
    Pure.prodP p1 (Pure.update p2 i x)
    = Pure.update (Pure.prodP p1 p2) (Fin.natAdd n1 i)
      (LinearEquiv.cast (R := k) (by simp) x)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.prodP_update_add_toTensor_left
declarations.statement:
lemma Pure.prodP_update_add_toTensor_left {n1 n2} {c : Fin n1 → C} {c1 : Fin n2 → C}
    (p1 : Pure S c) (p2 : Pure S c1) (i : Fin n2) (x y : V (c1 i)) :
    (Pure.prodP p1 (Pure.update p2 i (x + y))).toTensor
    = (Pure.prodP p1 (Pure.update p2 i x)).toTensor
    + (Pure.prodP p1 (Pure.update p2 i y)).toTensor

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.prodT
declarations.doc:
The tensor product of two tensors as a bi-linear map from
`S.Tensor c` and `S.Tensor c1` to `S.Tensor (Fin.append c c1)`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def prodT {n1 n2} {c : Fin n1 → C} {c1 : Fin n2 → C} :
    S.Tensor c →ₗ[k] S.Tensor c1 →ₗ[k] S.Tensor (Fin.append c c1)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.prodT_pure
TensorSpecies.Tensor.prodT_basis
declarations.statement:
lemma prodT_basis {n1 n2} {c : Fin n1 → C} {c1 : Fin n2 → C}
    (b : ComponentIdx c) (b1 : ComponentIdx (S := S) c1) :
    (basis c b).prodT (basis c1 b1) =
    (Pure.basisVector _ (ComponentIdx.prod.symm (b, b1))).toTensor

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.prodT_basis'
declarations.statement:
lemma prodT_basis' {n1 n2} {c : Fin n1 → C} {c1 : Fin n2 → C}
    (b : ComponentIdx c) (b1 : ComponentIdx (S := S) c1) :
    (basis c b).prodT (basis c1 b1) =
    basis (Fin.append c c1) (ComponentIdx.prod.symm (b, b1))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.tensorEquivProd
declarations.doc:
The linear equivalence between `S.Tensor c ⊗[k] S.Tensor c1` and
`S.Tensor (Fin.append c c1)`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def tensorEquivProd {n n2 : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} {c1 : Fin n2 → C} :
    S.Tensor c ⊗[k] S.Tensor c1 ≃ₗ[k] S.Tensor (Fin.append c c1)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.basis_prod_eq
declarations.doc: Rewriting basis for the product in terms of the tensor product basis.
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_prod_eq {n1 n2} {c : Fin n1 → C} {c1 : Fin n2 → C} :
    basis (S := S) (Fin.append c c1) =
    (((Tensor.basis (S := S) c).tensorProduct (Tensor.basis (S := S) c1)).reindex
    (ComponentIdx.prod.symm)).map tensorEquivProd

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.prodT_basis_repr_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma prodT_basis_repr_apply {n m : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} {c1 : Fin m → C}
    (t : Tensor S c) (t1 : Tensor S c1)
    (b : ComponentIdx (Fin.append c c1)) :
    (basis (Fin.append c c1)).repr (prodT t t1) b =
    (basis c).repr t (ComponentIdx.prod b).1 *
    (basis c1).repr t1 (ComponentIdx.prod b).2

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.prodT_equivariant
TensorSpecies.Tensor.prodT_default_right

## Real Lorentz tensors

Within this directory `Pre` is used to denote that the definitions are preliminary and
which are used to define `realLorentzTensor`.

## Basis and discrete functor objects

These re-express fields of `realLorentzTensor d` in terms of `Lorentz` data.

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.Color
declarations.doc: The colors associated with real representations of O(1, 3) of interest to physics.
declarations.statement:
inductive Color
  /-- The color associated with contravariant Lorentz vectors. -/
  | up : Color
  /-- The color associated with covariant Lorentz vectors. -/
  | down : Color
deriving Fintype

declarations.doc: Color for real Lorentz tensors is decidable.
declarations.statement: instance : DecidableEq Color

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor
declarations.doc: The tensor structure for real Lorentz tensors.
declarations.statement:
def realLorentzTensor (d : ℕ := 3) : TensorSpecies
    ℝ realLorentzTensor.Color (LorentzGroup d)
    (fun | Color.up => Lorentz.ContrMod d | Color.down => Lorentz.CoMod d)
    (fun _ => Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d)
    (fun | Color.up => Lorentz.ContrMod.rep | Color.down => Lorentz.CoMod.rep)
    (fun | Color.up => Lorentz.contrBasis d | Color.down => Lorentz.coBasis d)

declarations.name: realLorentzConjTensor
declarations.doc:
The real Lorentz tensors as a conjugation species: over `ℝ` conjugation is trivial, so every
colour is its own conjugate.
declarations.statement:

    (modules d) (fun _ => Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d)
    (fun | Color.up => Lorentz.ContrMod.rep | Color.down => Lorentz.CoMod.rep)
    (fun | Color.up => Lorentz.contrBasis d | Color.down => Lorentz.coBasis d)

    TensorSpecies.basisIdxCongr (basisIdx := fun _ => Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) h i = i

declarations.doc:
At every real Lorentz color, the bases at the color and its dual are dual bases, with
labels matched by the identity.
declarations.statement:
lemma isContrDualMatching_refl (c : realLorentzTensor.Color) :
    IsContrDualMatching (realLorentzTensor d) c (Equiv.refl _)

declarations.doc: Real Lorentz tensors have dual bases under contraction, with the identity matching.
declarations.statement: instance : HasContrDualBases (realLorentzTensor d)

declarations.doc: The dual-label matching of real Lorentz tensors is the identity.
declarations.statement:
lemma contrDualIdxEquiv_eq_refl (c : realLorentzTensor.Color) :
    HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv (realLorentzTensor d) c = Equiv.refl _

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.contrPCoeff_basis
declarations.statement:
lemma contrPCoeff_basis {d n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → realLorentzTensor.Color} (i j : Fin n)
    (hij : i ≠ j ∧ (realLorentzTensor d).τ (c i) = c j)
    (b : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor d) c) :
    Pure.contrPCoeff i j hij (Pure.basisVector c b) = if b i = b j then 1 else 0

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.contrT_eq_sum_evalT
declarations.statement:
lemma contrT_eq_sum_evalT {n} {d} (c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → Color) (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1))
    (h : i ≠ j ∧ (realLorentzTensor d).τ (c i) = c j) (t : ℝT(d, c)) :
    contrT n i j h t = ∑ (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d), permT id (by
      simp [Fin.succSuccAbove_eq_predAbove h.1])
      (evalT ((Fin.predAbove 0 i).predAbove j) μ (evalT i μ t))

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.contrT_toScalar
declarations.statement:
lemma contrT_toScalar {d} (c : Fin 2 → Color)
    (h : 0 ≠ 1 ∧ (realLorentzTensor d).τ (c 0) = c 1) (t : ℝT(d, c)) :
    (contrT 0 0 1 h t).toScalar = ∑ (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d), {t | [μ] [μ]}ᵀ.toScalar

modules.title: Components of real Lorentz cross contractions
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

This file gives the standard-basis component formula for `crossToEnd` on real Lorentz tensors.
The contraction pairing of the standard covariant and contravariant bases reduces the generic
component expansion to one finite sum.

## ii. Key results

- `realLorentzTensor.crossToEnd_basis_repr_apply_eq_fin` expresses each component of a cross
  contraction as a sum over the contracted Lorentz index.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. Basis components

## iv. References

* None.

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.crossToEnd_basis_repr_apply_eq_fin
declarations.doc:
For real Lorentz tensors, the component formula for `crossToEnd` collapses to one sum because
the standard contravariant and covariant bases are dual under contraction.
declarations.statement:
lemma crossToEnd_basis_repr_apply_eq_fin {d nA nB : ℕ} {cA : Fin (nA + 1) → Color}
    {cB : Fin (nB + 1) → Color} (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin (nB + 1))
    (hc : (realLorentzTensor d).τ (cA i) = cB j) (t : ℝT(d, cA)) (M : ℝT(d, cB))
    (φ : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor d)
      (Fin.append (cA ∘ i.succAbove) (cB ∘ j.succAbove))) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (crossToEnd i j hc t M) φ =
      ∑ x : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d,
        (Tensor.basis cA).repr t (i.insertNth x (fun m => φ (Fin.castAdd nB m))) *
          (Tensor.basis cB).repr M (j.insertNth x (fun m => φ (Fin.natAdd nA m)))

modules.title: Lorentz co vectors
modules.doc:
In this module we define Lorentz vectors as real Lorentz tensors with a single up index.
We create an API around Lorentz vectors to make working with them as easy as possible.

We define the tensorial instance on `Lorentz.coVector`, and show

declarations.name: Lorentz.CoVector.indexEquiv
declarations.doc:
The equivalence between the type of indices of a Lorentz vector and
`Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d`.
declarations.statement:
def indexEquiv {d : ℕ} :
    ComponentIdx (S := (realLorentzTensor d)) ![Color.down] ≃ Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d

declarations.name: Lorentz.CoVector.tensorial
declarations.statement: instance tensorial {d : ℕ} : Tensorial (realLorentzTensor d) ![.down] (CoVector d)

declarations.name: Lorentz.CoVector.toTensor_symm_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma toTensor_symm_apply {d : ℕ} (p : ℝT[d, .down]) :
    (toTensor (self := tensorial)).symm p =
    (Equiv.piCongrLeft' _ indexEquiv <|
    Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite <|
    (Tensor.basis (S := (realLorentzTensor d)) _).repr p)

declarations.name: Lorentz.CoVector.toTensor_symm_pure
declarations.statement:
lemma toTensor_symm_pure {d : ℕ} (p : Pure (realLorentzTensor d) ![.down]) (i : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    (toTensor (self := tensorial)).symm p.toTensor i =
    ((Lorentz.coBasis d).repr (p 0)) (indexEquiv.symm i 0)

declarations.statement:
lemma toTensor_symm_basis {d : ℕ} (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    (toTensor (self := tensorial)).symm (Tensor.basis ![Color.down] (indexEquiv.symm μ)) =
    basis μ

declarations.statement:
lemma toTensor_basis_eq_tensor_basis {d : ℕ} (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :

declarations.name: Lorentz.CoVector.basis_eq_map_tensor_basis
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_eq_map_tensor_basis {d} : basis =
    ((Tensor.basis (S := realLorentzTensor d) ![Color.down]).map
    toTensor.symm).reindex indexEquiv

declarations.name: Lorentz.CoVector.tensor_basis_map_eq_basis_reindex
declarations.statement:
lemma tensor_basis_map_eq_basis_reindex {d} :
    (Tensor.basis (S := realLorentzTensor d) ![Color.down]).map toTensor.symm =
    basis.reindex indexEquiv.symm

declarations.name: Lorentz.CoVector.tensor_basis_repr_toTensor_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma tensor_basis_repr_toTensor_apply {d : ℕ} (p : CoVector d) (μ : ComponentIdx ![Color.down]) :
    (Tensor.basis ![Color.down]).repr (toTensor p) μ =
    p (indexEquiv μ)

declarations.name: Lorentz.CoVector.smul_eq_sum
declarations.statement:
lemma smul_eq_sum {d : ℕ} (i : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) (Λ : LorentzGroup d) (p : CoVector d) :
    (Λ • p) i = ∑ j, Λ⁻¹.1 j i * p j

declarations.name: Lorentz.CoVector.smul_eq_mulVec
declarations.statement:
lemma smul_eq_mulVec {d} (Λ : LorentzGroup d) (p : CoVector d) :
    Λ • p = (LorentzGroup.transpose Λ⁻¹).1 *ᵥ p

declarations.name: Lorentz.CoVector.smul_add
declarations.statement:
lemma smul_add {d : ℕ} (Λ : LorentzGroup d) (p q : CoVector d) :
    Λ • (p + q) = Λ • p + Λ • q

declarations.statement:

    (b : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor d) ![Color.down, Color.down]) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (coMetric d) b =
    minkowskiMatrix (b 0) (b 1)

lemma metricTensor_repr_apply_eq_minkowskiMatrix {d : ℕ} (c : Color)
    (φ : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor d) ![c, c]) :

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.toDualMapAtIndex_basis_repr_apply
declarations.doc:
Raising or lowering one index of a real Lorentz tensor contracts that slot's components with
the Minkowski matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma toDualMapAtIndex_basis_repr_apply {d n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1) → Color}
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (t : ℝT(d, c))
    (φ : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor d)
      (Function.update c i ((realLorentzTensor d).τ (c i)))) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (Tensor.toDualMapAtIndex (S := realLorentzTensor d) i t) φ =
      ∑ x : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d,
        (Tensor.basis c).repr t (i.insertNth x (fun m => φ (i.succAbove m))) *
          minkowskiMatrix x (φ i)

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.toDualMapAtIndex_basis_repr_apply_eq_mul
declarations.doc:
In the standard Lorentz basis, raising or lowering an index multiplies the component with that
index fixed by the corresponding diagonal entry of the Minkowski metric.
declarations.statement:
lemma toDualMapAtIndex_basis_repr_apply_eq_mul {d n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1) → Color}
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (t : ℝT(d, c))
    (φ : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor d)
      (Function.update c i ((realLorentzTensor d).τ (c i)))) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (Tensor.toDualMapAtIndex (S := realLorentzTensor d) i t) φ =
      (Tensor.basis c).repr t φ * minkowskiMatrix (φ i) (φ i)

declarations.statement:
lemma ContrMod.contr_metric {d : ℕ} :
    (TensorProduct.comm ℝ _ _ <|
      (TensorProduct.lid ℝ _).lTensor _ <|
      (ContrMod.contr.toLinearMap.rTensor (CoMod d)).lTensor (ContrMod d) <|
      (TensorProduct.assoc ℝ (ContrMod d) (CoMod d) (CoMod d)).symm.toLinearMap.lTensor
        (ContrMod d) <|
      TensorProduct.assoc ℝ (ContrMod d) (ContrMod d) ((CoMod d) ⊗[ℝ] (CoMod d)) <|
      (ContrMod.metric d 1) ⊗ₜ[ℝ] (CoMod.metric d 1)) = ContrMod.unit d (1 : ℝ)

    (TensorProduct.assoc ℝ (CoMod d) (ContrMod d) (ContrMod d)).symm.toLinearMap.lTensor
      (CoMod d) <|

modules.title: Complex Lorentz tensors from real Lorentz tensors
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

In this module we describe how to pass from real Lorentz tensors to complex Lorentz tensors
in a functorial way.
Specifically, we construct a canonical equivariant semilinear map

* `toComplex : ℝT(3, c) →ₛₗ[Complex.ofRealHom] ℂT(colorToComplex ∘ c)`

which is compatible with the natural operations on tensors (permutations of
indices, tensor products, contractions and evaluations).

## ii. Key results

The main definitions and statements are:

* `colorToComplex` upgrades the colour of a real Lorentz tensor to the
  corresponding complex Lorentz colour.
* `TensorSpecies.Tensor.ComponentIdx.complexify` transports component indices
  along `colorToComplex`.
* `toComplex` is the basic semilinear map from real to complex Lorentz tensors.
* `toComplex_basis` and `toComplex_pure_basisVector` show that `toComplex`
  sends basis tensors to basis tensors.
* `toComplex_eq_zero_iff` and `toComplex_injective` show that `toComplex` is
  injective.
* `toComplex_equivariant` states that `toComplex` is equivariant for the action
  of the complexified Lorentz group.
* `permT_toComplex`, `prodT_toComplex`, `contrT_toComplex` and `evalT_toComplex`
  express that `toComplex` commutes with the basic tensor operations.

## iii. Table of contents

* A. Colours and component indices
* B. The semilinear map `toComplex`
  * B.1. Expression in the tensor basis
  * B.2. Behaviour on basis vectors and injectivity
  * B.3. Equivariance under the Lorentz action
* C. Compatibility with permutations: `permT`
* D. Compatibility with tensor products: `prodT`
* E. Compatibility with contraction: `contrT`
* F. Compatibility with evaluation: `evalT`

## iv. References

* None — the general formalism of Lorentz tensors and their operations is
  developed in other parts of the library; here we only specialise to the
  passage from real to complex Lorentz tensors.

sections.text:
## A. Colours and component indices

We first explain how the Lorentz colour data and component indices for real
tensors are transported to the complex setting.

## B. The semilinear map `toComplex`

We now define the basic semilinear map from real Lorentz tensors to complex
Lorentz tensors. It is characterised by sending the standard tensor basis on
the real side to the corresponding basis on the complex side, and is therefore
determined by the behaviour on components.

### B.3. Equivariance under the Lorentz action

Finally we record that `toComplex` is equivariant for the natural action of
`SL(2, ℂ)` (and hence the induced Lorentz action) on tensors.

## C. Compatibility with permutations: `permT`

We first show that complexification is compatible with permutation of tensor
slots. On colours this is encoded in the `IsReindexing` predicate, and on tensors
by the operator `permT`.

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.colorToComplex
declarations.doc: The map from colors of real Lorentz tensors to complex Lorentz tensors.
declarations.statement: def colorToComplex (c : realLorentzTensor.Color) : complexLorentzTensor.Color

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.basisIdxColorToComplex
declarations.doc:
The basis index type of a complexified real color is `Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3`, the basis index type
of the real color.
declarations.statement:
def basisIdxColorToComplex : (c : realLorentzTensor.Color) →
    complexLorentzTensor.basisIdx (colorToComplex c) ≃ Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.colorToComplex_match_up
declarations.doc:
`simp` helper: reduce `match c j` after a case split on `c j`
(avoids dependent `rw` / `Pi.smul_apply`).
declarations.statement:
lemma colorToComplex_match_up {n} {c : Fin n → realLorentzTensor.Color} {j}
    (hc : c j = realLorentzTensor.Color.up) :
    (match c j with
      | .up => complexLorentzTensor.Color.up
      | .down => complexLorentzTensor.Color.down)
      = complexLorentzTensor.Color.up

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.colorToComplex_match_down
declarations.statement:
lemma colorToComplex_match_down {n} {c : Fin n → realLorentzTensor.Color} {j}
    (hc : c j = realLorentzTensor.Color.down) :
    (match c j with
      | .up => complexLorentzTensor.Color.up
      | .down => complexLorentzTensor.Color.down)
      = complexLorentzTensor.Color.down

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.colorToComplex_comp_eq_match
declarations.statement:
lemma colorToComplex_comp_eq_match {n} (c : Fin n → realLorentzTensor.Color) (j : Fin n) :
    (colorToComplex ∘ c) j =
      (match c j with
        | .up => complexLorentzTensor.Color.up
        | .down => complexLorentzTensor.Color.down)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.ComponentIdx.complexify
declarations.doc:
The complexification of the component index of a real Lorentz tensor to
a complex Lorentz tensor.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def _root_.TensorSpecies.Tensor.ComponentIdx.complexify {n}
    {c : Fin n → realLorentzTensor.Color} :
    ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor) c ≃
      ComponentIdx (S := complexLorentzTensor) (colorToComplex ∘ c)

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.ComponentIdx.complexify_apply
realLorentzTensor.ComponentIdx.complexify_toFun_apply
realLorentzTensor.basisIdxCongr_basisIdxColorToComplex_symm
declarations.statement:
lemma basisIdxCongr_basisIdxColorToComplex_symm {c c' : realLorentzTensor.Color}
    (h : colorToComplex c = colorToComplex c') (x : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    basisIdxCongr (basisIdx := complexLorentzTensor.basisIdx) h
      ((basisIdxColorToComplex c).symm x) = (basisIdxColorToComplex c').symm x

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.basisIdxTauEquiv_basisIdxCongr_basisIdxColorToComplex_symm
declarations.statement:
lemma basisIdxTauEquiv_basisIdxCongr_basisIdxColorToComplex_symm
    {c c' : realLorentzTensor.Color}
    (h : colorToComplex c' = complexLorentzTensor.τ (colorToComplex c)) (x : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    basisIdxTauEquiv (colorToComplex c) (basisIdxCongr h ((basisIdxColorToComplex c').symm x)) =
      (basisIdxColorToComplex c).symm x

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.toComplex
declarations.doc:
The semilinear map from real Lorentz tensors to complex Lorentz tensors,
defined through basis.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def toComplex {n} {c : Fin n → realLorentzTensor.Color} :
    ℝT(3, c) →ₛₗ[Complex.ofRealHom] ℂT(colorToComplex ∘ c)

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.toComplex_eq_sum_basis
declarations.statement:
lemma toComplex_eq_sum_basis {n} (c : Fin n → realLorentzTensor.Color) (v : ℝT(3, c)) :
    toComplex v = ∑ i, (Tensor.basis (S := realLorentzTensor) c).repr v
      (ComponentIdx.complexify.symm i) •
      Tensor.basis (S := complexLorentzTensor) (colorToComplex ∘ c) i

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.toComplex_repr
declarations.doc:
The representation of `toComplex v` in the complexified basis equals
the real representation coerced to complex.
declarations.statement:
lemma toComplex_repr {n} {c : Fin n → realLorentzTensor.Color}
    (v : ℝT(3, c)) (i : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor) c) :
    (Tensor.basis (S := complexLorentzTensor) (colorToComplex ∘ c)).repr
      (toComplex v) i.complexify =
    ↑((Tensor.basis (S := realLorentzTensor) c).repr v i)

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.toComplex_basis
declarations.doc: `toComplex` sends basis elements to basis elements.
declarations.statement:
lemma toComplex_basis {n} {c : Fin n → realLorentzTensor.Color}
    (i : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor) c) :
    toComplex (c := c) ((Tensor.basis (S := realLorentzTensor) c) i) =
      (Tensor.basis (S := complexLorentzTensor) (colorToComplex ∘ c)) i.complexify

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.toComplex_pure_basisVector
declarations.doc: `toComplex` on a pure basis vector.
declarations.statement:
lemma toComplex_pure_basisVector {n} {c : Fin n → realLorentzTensor.Color}
    (b : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor) c) :
    toComplex (c := c) (Pure.basisVector c b |>.toTensor)
      =
    (Pure.basisVector (colorToComplex ∘ c) b.complexify).toTensor

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.toComplex_map_smul
declarations.statement:
lemma toComplex_map_smul {n} (c : Fin n → realLorentzTensor.Color) (r : ℝ) (t : ℝT(3, c)) :
    toComplex (c := c) (r • t) = (Complex.ofReal r) • toComplex (c := c) t

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.toComplex_eq_zero_iff
declarations.statement:
lemma toComplex_eq_zero_iff {n} (c : Fin n → realLorentzTensor.Color) (v : ℝT(3, c)) :
    toComplex v = 0 ↔ v = 0

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.toComplex_injective
declarations.doc: The map `toComplex` is injective.
declarations.statement:
lemma toComplex_injective {n} (c : Fin n → realLorentzTensor.Color) :
    Function.Injective (toComplex (c := c))

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.toComplexVector
declarations.doc: For a given color, the map turning a real Lorentz vector into a complex one.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def toComplexVector (c : realLorentzTensor.Color) :
  realLorentzTensor.modules 3 c →ₛₗ[Complex.ofRealHom] complexLorentzTensor.modules
    (colorToComplex c)

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.toComplexVector_up_eq_inclCongrRealLorentz
declarations.statement:
lemma toComplexVector_up_eq_inclCongrRealLorentz (v : Lorentz.ContrMod 3) :
    toComplexVector Color.up v = Lorentz.inclCongrRealLorentz v

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.toComplexVector_down_eq_inclCoRealLorentz
declarations.statement:
lemma toComplexVector_down_eq_inclCoRealLorentz (v : Lorentz.CoMod 3) :
    toComplexVector Color.down v = Lorentz.inclCoRealLorentz v

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.toComplexPure
declarations.doc: The function which turns a real pure tensor into a complex one.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def toComplexPure {c : Fin n → Color} (p : Pure realLorentzTensor c) :
    Pure complexLorentzTensor (colorToComplex ∘ c)

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.toComplexPure_component
declarations.statement:
lemma toComplexPure_component {c : Fin n → Color} (p : Pure realLorentzTensor c)
    (φ : ComponentIdx c) : (toComplexPure p).component (ComponentIdx.complexify φ) =
      p.component φ

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.actionP_toComplexPure
declarations.statement:
lemma actionP_toComplexPure {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → Color) (p : Pure realLorentzTensor c)
    (Λ : SL(2, ℂ)) :
    Λ • toComplexPure p = toComplexPure (toLorentzGroup Λ • p)

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.toComplex_pure
declarations.statement:
lemma toComplex_pure {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → Color) (p : Pure realLorentzTensor c) :
    toComplex p.toTensor = (toComplexPure p).toTensor

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.toComplex_equivariant
declarations.doc: The map `toComplex` is equivariant.

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.isReindexing_colorToComplex
declarations.doc: The `IsReindexing` condition is preserved under `colorToComplex`.

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.permT_basis_real
declarations.doc: `permT` sends basis vectors to basis vectors.
declarations.statement:
lemma permT_basis_real {n m : ℕ}
    {c : Fin n → realLorentzTensor.Color} {c1 : Fin m → realLorentzTensor.Color}
    {σ : Fin m → Fin n} (h : IsReindexing c c1 σ)
    (b : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor) c) :
    permT (S := realLorentzTensor) σ h ((Tensor.basis (S := realLorentzTensor) c) b)
    = (Tensor.basis (S := realLorentzTensor) c1)
      (fun j => b (σ j))

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.permT_basis_complex
declarations.statement:
lemma permT_basis_complex {n m : ℕ}
    {c : Fin n → complexLorentzTensor.Color} {c1 : Fin m → complexLorentzTensor.Color}
    {σ : Fin m → Fin n} (h : IsReindexing c c1 σ)
    (b : ComponentIdx (S := complexLorentzTensor) c) :
    permT (S := complexLorentzTensor) σ h ((Tensor.basis (S := complexLorentzTensor) c) b)
      =
    (Tensor.basis (S := complexLorentzTensor) c1)
      (fun j => basisIdxCongr (h.2 j) (b (σ j)))

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.permT_toComplex
declarations.doc: The map `toComplex` commutes with permT.

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.colorToComplex_append
declarations.doc: `colorToComplex` commutes with `Fin.append` (as functions).

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.isReindexing_prodTColorToComplex
declarations.statement:
lemma isReindexing_prodTColorToComplex {n m : ℕ}
    {c : Fin n → realLorentzTensor.Color} {c1 : Fin m → realLorentzTensor.Color} :
    IsReindexing (Fin.append (colorToComplex ∘ c) (colorToComplex ∘ c1))
      (colorToComplex ∘ Fin.append c c1)
      (id : Fin (n + m) → Fin (n + m))

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.prodTColorToComplex
declarations.doc:
`prodT` on the complex side, with colors written as `colorToComplex ∘ Fin.append ...`.
This is `prodT` followed by a cast using `colorToComplex_append`.

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.complexify_prod
declarations.doc: `complexify` commutes with `prod` of component indices.
declarations.statement:
lemma complexify_prod {n m : ℕ}
    {c : Fin n → realLorentzTensor.Color} {c1 : Fin m → realLorentzTensor.Color}
    (b : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor) c)
    (b1 : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor) c1) :
    ComponentIdx.complexify (c := Fin.append c c1) (ComponentIdx.prod.symm (b, b1))
      =
    cast (congr_arg ComponentIdx (colorToComplex_append c c1).symm)
      (ComponentIdx.prod.symm (ComponentIdx.complexify (c := c) b,
        ComponentIdx.complexify (c := c1) b1))

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.prodT_toComplex
declarations.doc: The map `toComplex` commutes with prodT.

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.tau_colorToComplex
declarations.doc: `τ` commutes with `colorToComplex` on the Lorentz `up/down` colors.
declarations.statement:
lemma tau_colorToComplex (x : realLorentzTensor.Color) :
    (complexLorentzTensor).τ (colorToComplex x) = colorToComplex ((realLorentzTensor).τ x)

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.ComponentIdx.complexify_comp_succSuccAbove
declarations.doc:
`complexify` commutes with precomposition by `succSuccAbove`.
We use `fun k => b (Fin.succSuccAbove i j k)` and direct application
`(ComponentIdx.complexify b) (Fin.succSuccAbove i j m)` rather than composition so that
dependent `ComponentIdx` types unify correctly (avoiding `Function.comp` type mismatch).
declarations.statement:
lemma ComponentIdx.complexify_comp_succSuccAbove
    {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → realLorentzTensor.Color}
    {i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)} (b : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor) c) (m : Fin n) :
    (ComponentIdx.complexify (c := c ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove i j)
      (fun k => b (Fin.succSuccAbove i j k))) m =
    (ComponentIdx.complexify (c := c) b) (Fin.succSuccAbove i j m)

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.toComplex_contrP_basisVector
declarations.doc:
For a real basis vector, `toComplex(contrP(basisVector c b))` equals
`contrP(basisVector (colorToComplex ∘ c) (complexify b))` (complex species).
declarations.statement:
lemma toComplex_contrP_basisVector {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → realLorentzTensor.Color}
    {i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)} (h : i ≠ j ∧ (realLorentzTensor).τ (c i) = c j)
    (b : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor) c) :
    toComplex (c := c ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove i j)
      (Pure.contrP (S := realLorentzTensor) i j h (Pure.basisVector c b))
      =
    Pure.contrP (S := complexLorentzTensor) i j
      (by
        simpa [Function.comp_apply] using And.intro h.1
          (by simpa [tau_colorToComplex] using congrArg colorToComplex h.2))
      (Pure.basisVector (colorToComplex ∘ c) (ComponentIdx.complexify b))

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.contrT_toComplex
declarations.doc: The map `toComplex` commutes with `contrT`.
declarations.statement:
lemma contrT_toComplex {n : ℕ}
    {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → realLorentzTensor.Color} {i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)}
    (h : i ≠ j ∧ (realLorentzTensor).τ (c i) = c j) (t : ℝT(3, c)) :
    toComplex (c := c ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove i j) (contrT (S := realLorentzTensor) n i j h t)
      =
    contrT (S := complexLorentzTensor) n i j (by
        simpa [Function.comp_apply] using
          And.intro h.1 (by
            simpa [tau_colorToComplex] using congrArg colorToComplex h.2))
      (toComplex (c := c) t)

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.ComponentIdx.complexify_comp_succAbove
declarations.doc: `complexify` commutes with precomposition by `succAbove`.
declarations.statement:
lemma ComponentIdx.complexify_comp_succAbove
    {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1) → realLorentzTensor.Color} (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (b : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor) c) (m : Fin n) :
    (ComponentIdx.complexify (c := c ∘ i.succAbove) (fun k => b (i.succAbove k))) m =
    (ComponentIdx.complexify (c := c) b) (i.succAbove m)

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.evalIdxToComplex
declarations.doc: Convert an evaluation index from the real basis index to the complex basis index.

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.evalTColorToComplex
declarations.doc:
`evalT` on the complex side, but with output colors as `colorToComplex ∘ (c ∘ i.succAbove)`.
Implemented via `permT (σ := id) (by simp)` as a transport.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def evalTColorToComplex {n : ℕ}
    {c : Fin (n + 1) → realLorentzTensor.Color} (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (b : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    ℂT(colorToComplex ∘ c) → ℂT(colorToComplex ∘ (c ∘ i.succAbove))

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.toComplex_evalP_basisVector
declarations.doc:
For a real basis vector, `toComplex(evalP(basisVector c b))` equals
`evalP(basisVector (colorToComplex ∘ c) (complexify b))` (complex species).
declarations.statement:
lemma toComplex_evalP_basisVector {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1) → realLorentzTensor.Color}
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (b : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (b' : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor) c) :
    toComplex (c := c ∘ i.succAbove)
      (Pure.evalP (S := realLorentzTensor) i b (Pure.basisVector c b'))
      =
    permT (S := complexLorentzTensor) (σ := (id : Fin n → Fin n))
      (by simp [Function.comp_apply])
      (Pure.evalP (S := complexLorentzTensor) i (evalIdxToComplex (c := c) i b)
        (Pure.basisVector (colorToComplex ∘ c) (ComponentIdx.complexify b')))

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.evalT_toComplex
declarations.doc: The map `toComplex` commutes with `evalT`.
declarations.statement:
lemma evalT_toComplex {n : ℕ}
    {c : Fin (n + 1) → realLorentzTensor.Color}
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (b : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (t : ℝT(3, c)) :
    toComplex (c := c ∘ i.succAbove)
        ((TensorSpecies.Tensor.evalT (S := realLorentzTensor) (c := c) i b) t)
      =
    evalTColorToComplex (c := c) i b (toComplex (c := c) t)

modules.title: Unit tensors for real Lorentz tensors
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

This file computes the unit tensors of `realLorentzTensor` in the standard covariant and
contravariant bases.

## ii. Key results

- `realLorentzTensor.unitTensor_repr_apply` identifies the standard-basis components of either
  real Lorentz unit tensor with the Kronecker delta.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. Basis components

## iv. References

* None.

declarations.name: realLorentzTensor.unitTensor_repr_apply
declarations.doc:
In the standard contravariant and covariant bases, either real Lorentz unit tensor has
Kronecker-delta components.
declarations.statement:
lemma unitTensor_repr_apply {d : ℕ} (c : Color)
    (φ : ComponentIdx (S := realLorentzTensor d) ![(realLorentzTensor d).τ c, c]) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (unitTensor (S := realLorentzTensor d) c) φ =
      if φ 0 = φ 1 then 1 else 0

declarations.name: Lorentz.CoMod.unitVal
declarations.doc: The contra-co unit for complex lorentz vectors. Usually denoted `δⁱᵢ`.
declarations.statement: def CoMod.unitVal (d : ℕ := 3) : ContrMod d ⊗[ℝ] CoMod d

declarations.name: Lorentz.CoMod.unitVal_expand_tmul
declarations.doc: Expansion of `CoMod.unitVal` into basis.
declarations.statement:
lemma CoMod.unitVal_expand_tmul {d : ℕ} : CoMod.unitVal d =
    ∑ i, contrBasis d i ⊗ₜ[ℝ] coBasis d i

declarations.name: Lorentz.CoMod.unit
declarations.doc:
The contra-co unit for complex lorentz vectors as a morphism
`𝟙_ (Rep ℂ SL(2,ℂ)) ⟶ complexContr ⊗ complexCo`, manifesting the invariance under
the `SL(2, ℂ)` action.

declarations.name: Lorentz.CoMod.unit_apply_one
declarations.statement: lemma CoMod.unit_apply_one {d : ℕ} : (CoMod.unit d) (1 : ℝ) = CoMod.unitVal d

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.unitVal
declarations.doc: The co-contra unit for complex lorentz vectors. Usually denoted `δᵢⁱ`.
declarations.statement: def ContrMod.unitVal (d : ℕ := 3) : CoMod d ⊗[ℝ] ContrMod d

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.unitVal_expand_tmul
declarations.doc: Expansion of `ContrMod.unitVal` into basis.
declarations.statement:
lemma ContrMod.unitVal_expand_tmul {d : ℕ} : ContrMod.unitVal d =
    ∑ i, coBasis d i ⊗ₜ[ℝ] contrBasis d i

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.unit
declarations.doc:
The co-contra unit for complex lorentz vectors as a morphism
`𝟙_ (Rep ℝ (LorentzGroup d)) ⟶ CoMod.rep ⊗ ContrMod.rep`, manifesting the invariance under
the `LorentzGroup d` action.
declarations.statement:
def ContrMod.unit (d : ℕ) : (Representation.trivial ℝ (LorentzGroup d) ℝ).IntertwiningMap
    ((CoMod.rep).tprod (ContrMod.rep))

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.unit_apply_one
declarations.statement: lemma ContrMod.unit_apply_one {d : ℕ} : (ContrMod.unit d) (1 : ℝ) = ContrMod.unitVal d

declarations.name: Lorentz.CoMod.contr_unit
declarations.doc: Contraction on the right with `CoMod.unit` does nothing.
declarations.statement:
lemma CoMod.contr_unit {d : ℕ} (x : CoMod d) :
    (TensorProduct.lid ℝ _ <|
    CoMod.contr.toLinearMap.rTensor _ <|
    (TensorProduct.assoc ℝ (CoMod d) (ContrMod d) (CoMod d)).symm <|
    x ⊗ₜ[ℝ] (CoMod.unit d (1 : ℝ))) = x

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.contr_unit
declarations.doc: Contraction on the right with `ContrMod.unit` does nothing.
declarations.statement:
lemma ContrMod.contr_unit {d : ℕ} (x : ContrMod d) :
    (TensorProduct.lid ℝ _ <|
    ContrMod.contr.toLinearMap.rTensor _ <|
    (TensorProduct.assoc ℝ (ContrMod d) (CoMod d) (ContrMod d)).symm <|
    x ⊗ₜ[ℝ] (ContrMod.unit d (1 : ℝ))) = x

declarations.name: Lorentz.CoMod.unit_symm
declarations.statement:
lemma CoMod.unit_symm {d : ℕ} :
    (CoMod.unit d) (1 : ℝ) = LinearMap.lTensor _ (LinearEquiv.cast (by rfl)).toLinearMap
      (TensorProduct.comm ℝ _ _ ((ContrMod.unit d) (1 : ℝ)))

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.unit_symm
declarations.statement:
lemma ContrMod.unit_symm {d : ℕ} :
    (ContrMod.unit d) (1 : ℝ) = LinearMap.lTensor _ (LinearEquiv.cast (by simp)).toLinearMap
    (TensorProduct.comm ℝ _ _ ((CoMod.unit d) (1 : ℝ)))

modules.title: Lorentz Vectors
modules.doc:
In this module we define Lorentz vectors as real Lorentz tensors with a single up index.
We create an API around Lorentz vectors to make working with them as easy as possible.

sections.text: ## Properties of the inner product (note not the Minkowski product)
