declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.coordCLM
declarations.doc: The continuous linear map from a Lorentz vector to one of its coordinates.
declarations.statement: def coordCLM {d : ℕ} (i : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) : Vector d →L[ℝ] ℝ

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.coordCLM_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma coordCLM_apply {d : ℕ} (i : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) (v : Vector d) :
    coordCLM i v = v i

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.coord_continuous
declarations.statement:
lemma coord_continuous {d : ℕ} (i : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    Continuous (fun v : Vector d => v i)

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.coord_contDiff
declarations.statement:
lemma coord_contDiff {n} {d : ℕ} (i : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    ContDiff ℝ n (fun v : Vector d => v i)

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.coord_differentiable
declarations.statement:
lemma coord_differentiable {d : ℕ} (i : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    Differentiable ℝ (fun v : Vector d => v i)

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.coord_differentiableAt
declarations.statement:
lemma coord_differentiableAt {d : ℕ} (i : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) (v : Vector d) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun v : Vector d => v i) v

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.euclidCLE
declarations.doc: The continuous linear equivalence between `Vector d` and Euclidean space.
declarations.statement: def euclidCLE (d : ℕ) : Vector d ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d)

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.equivPi
declarations.doc: The continuous linear equivalence between `Vector d` and the corresponding `Pi` type.
declarations.statement:
def equivPi (d : ℕ) :
    Vector d ≃L[ℝ] Π (_ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d), ℝ

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.equivPi_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma equivPi_apply {d : ℕ} (v : Vector d) (i : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    equivPi d v i = v i

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.continuous_of_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma continuous_of_apply {d : ℕ} {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α]
    (f : α → Vector d)
    (h : ∀ i : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d, Continuous (fun x => f x i)) :
    Continuous f

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.differentiable_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma differentiable_apply {d : ℕ} {α : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup α] [NormedSpace ℝ α]
    (f : α → Vector d) :
    (∀ i : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d, Differentiable ℝ (fun x => f x i)) ↔ Differentiable ℝ f

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.contDiff_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma contDiff_apply {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {d : ℕ} {α : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup α] [NormedSpace ℝ α]
    (f : α → Vector d) :
    (∀ i : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d, ContDiff ℝ n (fun x => f x i)) ↔ ContDiff ℝ n f

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.fderiv_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma fderiv_apply {d : ℕ} {α : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup α] [NormedSpace ℝ α]
    (f : α → Vector d) (h : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (x : α) (dt : α) (ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    fderiv ℝ f x dt ν = fderiv ℝ (fun y => f y ν) x dt

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.fderiv_coord
declarations.statement:
lemma fderiv_coord {d : ℕ} (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) (x : Vector d) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun v : Vector d => v μ) x = coordCLM μ

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.basis
declarations.doc: The basis on `Vector d` indexed by `Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d`.
declarations.statement: def basis {d : ℕ} : Basis (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℝ (Vector d)

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.basis_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_apply {d : ℕ} (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    basis μ ν = if μ = ν then 1 else 0

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.basis_repr_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_repr_apply {d : ℕ} (p : Vector d) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    basis.repr p μ = p μ

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.map_apply_eq_basis_mulVec
declarations.statement:
lemma map_apply_eq_basis_mulVec {d : ℕ} (f : Vector d →ₗ[ℝ] Vector d) (p : Vector d) :
    (f p) = (LinearMap.toMatrix basis basis) f *ᵥ p

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.sum_basis_eq_zero_iff
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_basis_eq_zero_iff {d : ℕ} (f : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d → ℝ) :
    (∑ μ, f μ • basis μ) = 0 ↔ ∀ μ, f μ = 0

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.sum_inl_inr_basis_eq_zero_iff
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_inl_inr_basis_eq_zero_iff {d : ℕ} (f₀ : ℝ) (f : Fin d → ℝ) :
    f₀ • basis (Sum.inl 0) + (∑ i, f i • basis (Sum.inr i)) = 0 ↔
    f₀ = 0 ∧ ∀ i, f i = 0

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.spatialPart
declarations.doc:
Extract spatial components from a Lorentz vector,
returning them as a vector in Euclidean space.
declarations.statement: abbrev spatialPart {d : ℕ} (v : Vector d) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.spatialPart_apply_eq_toCoord
declarations.statement:
lemma spatialPart_apply_eq_toCoord {d : ℕ} (v : Vector d) (i : Fin d) :
    spatialPart v i = v (Sum.inr i)

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.spatialPart_basis_sum_inr
declarations.statement:
lemma spatialPart_basis_sum_inr {d : ℕ} (i : Fin d) (j : Fin d) :
    spatialPart (basis (Sum.inr i)) j =
      (Finsupp.single (Sum.inr i : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) 1) (Sum.inr j)

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.spatialPart_basis_sum_inl
declarations.statement:
lemma spatialPart_basis_sum_inl {d : ℕ} (i : Fin d) :
    spatialPart (basis (Sum.inl 0)) i = 0

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.spatialCLM
declarations.doc: The spatial part of a Lorentz vector as a continuous linear map.
declarations.statement: def spatialCLM (d : ℕ) : Vector d →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.spatialCLM_apply_eq_spatialPart
declarations.statement:
lemma spatialCLM_apply_eq_spatialPart {d : ℕ} (v : Vector d) (i : Fin d) :
    spatialCLM d v i = spatialPart v i

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.spatialCLM_basis_sum_inl
declarations.statement:
lemma spatialCLM_basis_sum_inl {d : ℕ} :
    spatialCLM d (basis (Sum.inl 0)) = 0

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.spatialCLM_basis_sum_inr
declarations.statement:
lemma spatialCLM_basis_sum_inr {d : ℕ} (i : Fin d) :
    spatialCLM d (basis (Sum.inr i)) = EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin d) ℝ i

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.timeComponent
declarations.doc: Extract time component from a Lorentz vector
declarations.statement: abbrev timeComponent {d : ℕ} (v : Vector d) : ℝ

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.timeComponent_basis_sum_inr
declarations.statement:
lemma timeComponent_basis_sum_inr {d : ℕ} (i : Fin d) :
    timeComponent (basis (Sum.inr i)) = 0

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.timeComponent_basis_sum_inl
declarations.statement:
lemma timeComponent_basis_sum_inl {d : ℕ} :
    timeComponent (d := d) (basis (Sum.inl 0)) = 1

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.temporalCLM
declarations.doc: The temporal part of a Lorentz vector as a continuous linear map.
declarations.statement: def temporalCLM (d : ℕ) : Vector d →L[ℝ] ℝ

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.temporalCLM_apply_eq_timeComponent
declarations.statement:
lemma temporalCLM_apply_eq_timeComponent {d : ℕ} (v : Vector d) :
    temporalCLM d v = timeComponent v

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.temporalCLM_basis_sum_inr
declarations.statement:
lemma temporalCLM_basis_sum_inr {d : ℕ} (i : Fin d) :
    temporalCLM d (basis (Sum.inr i)) = 0

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.temporalCLM_basis_sum_inl
declarations.statement:
lemma temporalCLM_basis_sum_inl {d : ℕ} :
    temporalCLM d (basis (Sum.inl 0)) = 1

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.ofTemporalComponent
declarations.doc:
The continuous linear map corresponding to the creation of a
Lorentz Vector with only a non-zero temporal component.
declarations.statement: def ofTemporalComponent {d : ℕ} : ℝ →L[ℝ] Vector d

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.ofSpatialComponent
declarations.doc:
The continuous linear map corresponding to the creation of a
Lorentz Vector with only non-zero spatial components.
declarations.statement: def ofSpatialComponent {d : ℕ} : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) →L[ℝ] Vector d

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.asSmoothManifold
declarations.doc: The structure of a smooth manifold on Vector .
declarations.statement: def asSmoothManifold (d : ℕ) : ModelWithCorners ℝ (Vector d) (Vector d)

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.basis_inner
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_inner {d : ℕ} (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) (p : Lorentz.Vector d) :
    ⟪Lorentz.Vector.basis μ, p⟫_ℝ = p μ

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.inner_basis
declarations.statement:
lemma inner_basis {d : ℕ} (p : Lorentz.Vector d) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    ⟪p, Lorentz.Vector.basis μ⟫_ℝ = p μ

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.eq_zero_of_timeComponent_of_spatialPart
declarations.doc: A vector with zero time component and zero spatial part is zero.
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_timeComponent_of_spatialPart {d : ℕ} {u : Vector d} (h0 : u.timeComponent = 0)
    (hs : u.spatialPart = 0) : u = 0

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.apply_inr_eq_zero_of_norm_spatialPart
declarations.doc: The spatial components of a vector whose spatial part has zero norm vanish.
declarations.statement:
lemma apply_inr_eq_zero_of_norm_spatialPart {d : ℕ} {u : Vector d} (h : ‖u.spatialPart‖ = 0)
    (i : Fin d) : u (Sum.inr i) = 0

modules.title: Minkowski product on Lorentz vectors
modules.doc: In this module we define and create an API around the Minkowski product on Lorentz vectors.

sections.text: ## The adjoint of a linear map

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.minkowskiProductMap
declarations.doc: The Minkowski product of Lorentz vectors in the +--- convention..
declarations.statement: def minkowskiProductMap {d : ℕ} (p q : Vector d) : ℝ

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.minkowskiProductMap_toCoord
declarations.statement:
lemma minkowskiProductMap_toCoord {d : ℕ} (p q : Vector d) :
    minkowskiProductMap p q = p (Sum.inl 0) * q (Sum.inl 0) -
    ∑ i, p (Sum.inr i) * q (Sum.inr i)

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.minkowskiProductMap_symm
declarations.statement:
lemma minkowskiProductMap_symm {d : ℕ} (p q : Vector d) :
    minkowskiProductMap p q = minkowskiProductMap q p

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.minkowskiProductMap_add_fst
declarations.statement:
lemma minkowskiProductMap_add_fst {d : ℕ} (p q r : Vector d) :
    minkowskiProductMap (p + q) r = minkowskiProductMap p r + minkowskiProductMap q r

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.minkowskiProductMap_add_snd
declarations.statement:
lemma minkowskiProductMap_add_snd {d : ℕ} (p q r : Vector d) :
    minkowskiProductMap p (q + r) = minkowskiProductMap p q + minkowskiProductMap p r

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.minkowskiProductMap_smul_fst
declarations.statement:
lemma minkowskiProductMap_smul_fst {d : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (p q : Vector d) :
    minkowskiProductMap (c • p) q = c * minkowskiProductMap p q

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.minkowskiProductMap_smul_snd
declarations.statement:
lemma minkowskiProductMap_smul_snd {d : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (p q : Vector d) :
    minkowskiProductMap p (c • q) = c * minkowskiProductMap p q

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.minkowskiProduct
declarations.doc: The Minkowski product of two Lorentz vectors as a linear map.
declarations.statement: def minkowskiProduct {d : ℕ} : Vector d →L[ℝ] Vector d →L[ℝ] ℝ

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.minkowskiProduct_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma minkowskiProduct_apply {d : ℕ} (p q : Vector d) :
    ⟪p, q⟫ₘ = minkowskiProductMap p q

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.minkowskiProduct_symm
declarations.statement:
lemma minkowskiProduct_symm {d : ℕ} (p q : Vector d) :
    ⟪p, q⟫ₘ = ⟪q, p⟫ₘ

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.minkowskiProduct_toCoord
declarations.statement:
lemma minkowskiProduct_toCoord {d : ℕ} (p q : Vector d) :
    ⟪p, q⟫ₘ = p (Sum.inl 0) * q (Sum.inl 0) - ∑ i, p (Sum.inr i) * q (Sum.inr i)

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.minkowskiProduct_toCoord_minkowskiMatrix
declarations.statement:
lemma minkowskiProduct_toCoord_minkowskiMatrix {d : ℕ} (p q : Vector d) :
    ⟪p, q⟫ₘ = ∑ μ, minkowskiMatrix μ μ * p μ * q μ

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.minkowskiProduct_invariant
declarations.statement:
lemma minkowskiProduct_invariant {d : ℕ} (p q : Vector d) (Λ : LorentzGroup d) :
    ⟪Λ • p, Λ • q⟫ₘ = ⟪p, q⟫ₘ

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.minkowskiProduct_eq_timeComponent_spatialPart
declarations.statement:
lemma minkowskiProduct_eq_timeComponent_spatialPart {d : ℕ} (p q : Vector d) :
    ⟪p, q⟫ₘ = p.timeComponent * q.timeComponent -
      ⟪p.spatialPart, q.spatialPart⟫_ℝ

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.minkowskiProduct_self_eq_timeComponent_spatialPart
declarations.statement:
lemma minkowskiProduct_self_eq_timeComponent_spatialPart {d : ℕ} (p : Vector d) :
    ⟪p, p⟫ₘ = ‖p.timeComponent‖ ^ 2 - ‖p.spatialPart‖ ^ 2

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.minkowskiProduct_self_le_timeComponent_sq
declarations.statement:
lemma minkowskiProduct_self_le_timeComponent_sq {d : ℕ} (p : Vector d) :
    ⟪p, p⟫ₘ ≤ p.timeComponent ^ 2

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.minkowskiProduct_self_eq_sq_sub
declarations.doc: `⟪u, u⟫ₘ = (u⁰)² - ‖u_spatial‖²`.
declarations.statement:
lemma minkowskiProduct_self_eq_sq_sub {d : ℕ} (u : Vector d) :
    ⟪u, u⟫ₘ = u.timeComponent ^ 2 - ‖u.spatialPart‖ ^ 2

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.minkowskiProduct_add_self
declarations.doc: `⟪u + v, u + v⟫ₘ = ⟪u, u⟫ₘ + 2 ⟪u, v⟫ₘ + ⟪v, v⟫ₘ`.
declarations.statement:
lemma minkowskiProduct_add_self {d : ℕ} (u v : Vector d) :
    ⟪u + v, u + v⟫ₘ = ⟪u, u⟫ₘ + 2 * ⟪u, v⟫ₘ + ⟪v, v⟫ₘ

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.minkowskiProduct_smul_self
declarations.doc: `⟪μ • u, μ • u⟫ₘ = μ² ⟪u, u⟫ₘ`.
declarations.statement:
lemma minkowskiProduct_smul_self {d : ℕ} (μ : ℝ) (u : Vector d) :
    ⟪μ • u, μ • u⟫ₘ = μ ^ 2 * ⟪u, u⟫ₘ

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.sqrt_minkowskiProduct_smul_self
declarations.doc: `√⟪μ • u, μ • u⟫ₘ = μ √⟪u, u⟫ₘ` for `μ ≥ 0`.
declarations.statement:
lemma sqrt_minkowskiProduct_smul_self {d : ℕ} {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 ≤ μ) (u : Vector d) :
    √⟪μ • u, μ • u⟫ₘ = μ * √⟪u, u⟫ₘ

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.minkowskiProduct_basis_left
declarations.statement:
lemma minkowskiProduct_basis_left {d : ℕ} (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) (p : Vector d) :
    ⟪basis μ, p⟫ₘ = minkowskiMatrix μ μ * p μ

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.minkowskiProduct_basis_right
declarations.statement:
lemma minkowskiProduct_basis_right {d : ℕ} (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) (p : Vector d) :
    ⟪p, basis μ⟫ₘ = minkowskiMatrix μ μ * p μ

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.minkowskiProduct_eq_zero_forall_iff
declarations.statement:
lemma minkowskiProduct_eq_zero_forall_iff {d : ℕ} (p : Vector d) :
    (∀ q : Vector d, ⟪p, q⟫ₘ = 0) ↔ p = 0

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.map_minkowskiProduct_eq_self_forall_iff
declarations.statement:
lemma map_minkowskiProduct_eq_self_forall_iff {d : ℕ} (f : Vector d →ₗ[ℝ] Vector d) :
    (∀ p q : Vector d, ⟪f p, q⟫ₘ = ⟪p, q⟫ₘ) ↔ f = LinearMap.id

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.adjoint
declarations.doc:
The adjoint of a linear map from `Vector d` to itself with respect to
the `minkowskiProduct`.
declarations.statement: def adjoint {d : ℕ} (f : Vector d →ₗ[ℝ] Vector d) : Vector d →ₗ[ℝ] Vector d

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.map_minkowskiProduct_eq_adjoint
declarations.statement:
lemma map_minkowskiProduct_eq_adjoint {d : ℕ} (f : Vector d →ₗ[ℝ] Vector d) (p q : Vector d) :
    ⟪f p, q⟫ₘ = ⟪p, adjoint f q⟫ₘ

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.minkowskiProduct_map_eq_adjoint
declarations.statement:
lemma minkowskiProduct_map_eq_adjoint {d : ℕ} (f : Vector d →ₗ[ℝ] Vector d) (p q : Vector d) :
    ⟪p, f q⟫ₘ = ⟪adjoint f p, q⟫ₘ

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.IsLorentz
declarations.doc:
A linear map `Vector d →ₗ[ℝ] Vector d` satisfies `IsLorentz` if it preserves
the minkowski product.
declarations.statement:
def IsLorentz {d : ℕ} (f : Vector d →ₗ[ℝ] Vector d) :
    Prop

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.isLorentz_iff
declarations.statement:
lemma isLorentz_iff {d : ℕ} (f : Vector d →ₗ[ℝ] Vector d) :
    IsLorentz f ↔ ∀ p q : Vector d, ⟪f p, f q⟫ₘ = ⟪p, q⟫ₘ

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.isLorentz_iff_basis
declarations.statement:
lemma isLorentz_iff_basis {d : ℕ} (f : Vector d →ₗ[ℝ] Vector d) :
    IsLorentz f ↔ ∀ μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d, ⟪f (basis μ), f (basis ν)⟫ₘ = ⟪basis μ, basis ν⟫ₘ

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.isLorentz_iff_comp_adjoint_eq_id
declarations.statement:
lemma isLorentz_iff_comp_adjoint_eq_id {d : ℕ} (f : Vector d →ₗ[ℝ] Vector d) :
    IsLorentz f ↔ adjoint f ∘ₗ f = LinearMap.id

declarations.name: Lorentz.Vector.isLorentz_iff_toMatrix_mem_lorentzGroup
declarations.statement:
lemma isLorentz_iff_toMatrix_mem_lorentzGroup {d : ℕ} (f : Vector d →ₗ[ℝ] Vector d) :
    IsLorentz f ↔ LinearMap.toMatrix Vector.basis Vector.basis f ∈ LorentzGroup d

modules.title: Real Lorentz vectors
modules.doc: We define real Lorentz vectors in as representations of the Lorentz group.

sections.text: ## Isomorphism between contravariant and covariant Lorentz vectors

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrBasis
declarations.doc: The standard basis of contravariant Lorentz vectors.
declarations.statement: def contrBasis (d : ℕ := 3) : Basis (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℝ (ContrMod d)

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrBasis_ρ_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma contrBasis_ρ_apply {d : ℕ} (M : LorentzGroup d) (i j : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (contrBasis d) (contrBasis d)) (ContrMod.rep M) i j =
    M.1 i j

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrBasis_toFin1dℝ
declarations.statement:
lemma contrBasis_toFin1dℝ {d : ℕ} (i : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    (contrBasis d i).toFin1dℝ = Pi.single i 1

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrBasis_repr_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma contrBasis_repr_apply {d : ℕ} (p : ContrMod d) (i : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    (contrBasis d).repr p i = p.val i

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrBasisFin
declarations.doc: The standard basis of contravariant Lorentz vectors indexed by `Fin (1 + d)`.
declarations.statement: def contrBasisFin (d : ℕ := 3) : Basis (Fin (1 + d)) ℝ (ContrMod d)

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrBasisFin_toFin1dℝ
declarations.statement:
lemma contrBasisFin_toFin1dℝ {d : ℕ} (i : Fin (1 + d)) :
    (contrBasisFin d i).toFin1dℝ = Pi.single (finSumFinEquiv.symm i) 1

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrBasisFin_repr_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma contrBasisFin_repr_apply {d : ℕ} (p : ContrMod d) (i : Fin (1 + d)) :
    (contrBasisFin d).repr p i = p.val (finSumFinEquiv.symm i)

declarations.name: Lorentz.continuous_contr
declarations.statement:
lemma continuous_contr {T : Type} [TopologicalSpace T] (f : T → ContrMod d)
    (h : Continuous (fun i => (f i).toFin1dℝ)) : Continuous f

declarations.name: Lorentz.contr_continuous
declarations.statement:
lemma contr_continuous {T : Type} [TopologicalSpace T] (f : ContrMod d → T)
    (h : Continuous (f ∘ (@ContrMod.toFin1dℝEquiv d).symm)) : Continuous f

declarations.name: Lorentz.coBasis
declarations.doc: The standard basis of contravariant Lorentz vectors.
declarations.statement: def coBasis (d : ℕ := 3) : Basis (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℝ (CoMod d)

declarations.name: Lorentz.coBasis_ρ_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma coBasis_ρ_apply {d : ℕ} (M : LorentzGroup d) (i j : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (coBasis d) (coBasis d)) (CoMod.rep M) i j =
    M⁻¹ᵀ i j

declarations.name: Lorentz.coBasis_repr_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma coBasis_repr_apply {d : ℕ} (p : CoMod d) (i : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    (coBasis d).repr p i = p.val i

declarations.name: Lorentz.coBasis_toFin1dℝ
declarations.statement:
lemma coBasis_toFin1dℝ {d : ℕ} (i : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    (coBasis d i).toFin1dℝ = Pi.single i 1

declarations.name: Lorentz.coBasisFin
declarations.doc: The standard basis of covariant Lorentz vectors indexed by `Fin (1 + d)`.
declarations.statement: def coBasisFin (d : ℕ := 3) : Basis (Fin (1 + d)) ℝ (CoMod d)

declarations.name: Lorentz.coBasisFin_toFin1dℝ
declarations.statement:
lemma coBasisFin_toFin1dℝ {d : ℕ} (i : Fin (1 + d)) :
    (coBasisFin d i).toFin1dℝ = Pi.single (finSumFinEquiv.symm i) 1

declarations.name: Lorentz.coBasisFin_repr_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma coBasisFin_repr_apply {d : ℕ} (p : CoMod d) (i : Fin (1 + d)) :
    (coBasisFin d).repr p i = p.val (finSumFinEquiv.symm i)

declarations.name: Lorentz.Contr.toCo
declarations.doc:
The morphism of representations from `ContrMod.rep` to `CoMod.rep` defined by multiplication
with the metric.
declarations.statement: def Contr.toCo (d : ℕ) : IntertwiningMap (ContrMod.rep (d := d)) (CoMod.rep (d := d))

declarations.name: Lorentz.Co.toContr
declarations.doc:
The morphism of representations from `CoMod.rep` to `ContrMod.rep` defined by multiplication
with the metric.
declarations.statement: def Co.toContr (d : ℕ) : IntertwiningMap (CoMod.rep (d := d)) (ContrMod.rep (d := d))

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrIsoCo
declarations.doc:
The isomorphism between `ContrMod.rep` and `CoMod.rep` induced by multiplication with the
Minkowski metric.
declarations.statement: def contrIsoCo (d : ℕ) : Representation.Equiv (ContrMod.rep (d := d)) (CoMod.rep (d := d))

declarations.name: Lorentz.Contr.ρ_stdBasis
declarations.statement:
lemma ρ_stdBasis (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) (Λ : LorentzGroup 3) :
    ContrMod.rep Λ (ContrMod.stdBasis μ) = ∑ j, Λ.1 j μ • ContrMod.stdBasis j

sections.text: ## Contracting contr vectors with contr vectors etc.

## Lemmas related to contraction.

We derive the lemmas in main for `contrContrContractField`.
# The Minkowski metric and the standard basis

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrModCoModBi
declarations.doc:
The bi-linear map corresponding to contraction of a contravariant Lorentz vector with a
covariant Lorentz vector.
declarations.statement: def contrModCoModBi (d : ℕ) : ContrMod d →ₗ[ℝ] CoMod d →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ

declarations.name: Lorentz.coModContrModBi
declarations.doc:
The bi-linear map corresponding to contraction of a covariant Lorentz vector with a
contravariant Lorentz vector.
declarations.statement: def coModContrModBi (d : ℕ) : CoMod d →ₗ[ℝ] ContrMod d →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.contr
declarations.doc:
The linear map from ContrMod d ⊗ CoMod d to ℝ given by
summing over components of contravariant Lorentz vector and
covariant Lorentz vector in the
standard basis (i.e. the dot product).
In terms of index notation this is the contraction is ψⁱ φᵢ.
declarations.statement:
def ContrMod.contr : ((ContrMod.rep).tprod (CoMod.rep)).IntertwiningMap
    (Representation.trivial ℝ (LorentzGroup d) ℝ)

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.contr_tmul
declarations.statement:
lemma ContrMod.contr_tmul (ψ : ContrMod d) (φ : CoMod d) :
    ⟪ψ, φ⟫ₘ = ψ.toFin1dℝ ⬝ᵥ φ.toFin1dℝ

declarations.name: Lorentz.CoMod.contr
declarations.doc:
The linear map from CoMod d ⊗ ContrMod d to ℝ given by
summing over components of contravariant Lorentz vector and
covariant Lorentz vector in the
standard basis (i.e. the dot product).
In terms of index notation this is the contraction is ψⁱ φᵢ.
declarations.statement:
def CoMod.contr : ((CoMod.rep (d := d)).tprod (ContrMod.rep (d := d))).IntertwiningMap
    (Representation.trivial ℝ (LorentzGroup d) ℝ)

declarations.name: Lorentz.CoMod.contr_tmul
declarations.statement:
lemma CoMod.contr_tmul (φ : CoMod d) (ψ : ContrMod d) :
    ⟪φ, ψ⟫ₘ = φ.toFin1dℝ ⬝ᵥ ψ.toFin1dℝ

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.contr_tmul_symm
declarations.statement: lemma ContrMod.contr_tmul_symm (φ : ContrMod d) (ψ : CoMod d) : ⟪φ, ψ⟫ₘ = ⟪ψ, φ⟫ₘ

declarations.name: Lorentz.CoMod.contr_tmul_symm
declarations.statement: lemma CoMod.contr_tmul_symm (φ : CoMod d) (ψ : ContrMod d) : ⟪φ, ψ⟫ₘ = ⟪ψ, φ⟫ₘ

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContract
declarations.doc:
The linear map from ContrMod d ⊗ ContrMod d to ℝ induced by the homomorphism
`Contr.toCo` and the contraction `ContrMod.contr`.
declarations.statement:
def contrContrContract : ((ContrMod.rep (d := d)).tprod (ContrMod.rep (d := d))).IntertwiningMap
    (Representation.trivial ℝ (LorentzGroup d) ℝ)

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContractField
declarations.doc:
The linear map from ContrMod d ⊗ ContrMod d to ℝ induced by the homomorphism
`Contr.toCo` and the contraction `ContrMod.contr`.
declarations.statement: def contrContrContractField : ContrMod d ⊗[ℝ] ContrMod d →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContract_hom_tmul
declarations.statement:
lemma contrContrContract_hom_tmul (φ : ContrMod d) (ψ : ContrMod d) :
    ⟪φ, ψ⟫ₘ = φ.toFin1dℝ ⬝ᵥ η *ᵥ ψ.toFin1dℝ

declarations.name: Lorentz.coCoContract
declarations.doc:
The linear map from CoMod d ⊗ CoMod d to ℝ induced by the homomorphism
`Co.toContr` and the contraction `CoMod.contr`.
declarations.statement:
def coCoContract : ((CoMod.rep (d := d)).tprod (CoMod.rep (d := d))).IntertwiningMap
    (Representation.trivial ℝ (LorentzGroup d) ℝ)

declarations.name: Lorentz.coCoContract_hom_tmul
declarations.statement:
lemma coCoContract_hom_tmul (φ : CoMod d) (ψ : CoMod d) :
    ⟪φ, ψ⟫ₘ = φ.toFin1dℝ ⬝ᵥ η *ᵥ ψ.toFin1dℝ

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContractField.action_tmul
declarations.statement: lemma action_tmul (g : LorentzGroup d) : ⟪ContrMod.rep g x, ContrMod.rep g y⟫ₘ = ⟪x, y⟫ₘ

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContractField.as_sum
declarations.statement:
lemma as_sum : ⟪x, y⟫ₘ = x.val (Sum.inl 0) * y.val (Sum.inl 0) -
    ∑ i, x.val (Sum.inr i) * y.val (Sum.inr i)

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContractField.as_sum_toSpace
declarations.statement:
lemma as_sum_toSpace : ⟪x, y⟫ₘ = x.val (Sum.inl 0) * y.val (Sum.inl 0) -
    ⟪x.toSpace, y.toSpace⟫_ℝ

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContractField.stdBasis_inl
declarations.statement:
lemma stdBasis_inl {d : ℕ} :
    ⟪@ContrMod.stdBasis d (Sum.inl 0), ContrMod.stdBasis (Sum.inl 0)⟫ₘ = (1 : ℝ)

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContractField.symm
declarations.statement: lemma symm : ⟪x, y⟫ₘ = ⟪y, x⟫ₘ

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContractField.dual_mulVec_right
declarations.statement: lemma dual_mulVec_right : ⟪x, dual Λ *ᵥ y⟫ₘ = ⟪Λ *ᵥ x, y⟫ₘ

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContractField.dual_mulVec_left
declarations.statement: lemma dual_mulVec_left : ⟪dual Λ *ᵥ x, y⟫ₘ = ⟪x, Λ *ᵥ y⟫ₘ

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContractField.right_parity
declarations.statement: lemma right_parity : ⟪x, ContrMod.rep LorentzGroup.parity y⟫ₘ = ∑ i, x.val i * y.val i

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContractField.self_parity_eq_zero_iff
declarations.statement: lemma self_parity_eq_zero_iff : ⟪y, ContrMod.rep LorentzGroup.parity y⟫ₘ = 0 ↔ y = 0

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContractField.nondegenerate
declarations.doc: The metric tensor is non-degenerate.
declarations.statement: lemma nondegenerate : (∀ (x : ContrMod d), ⟪x, y⟫ₘ = 0) ↔ y = 0

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContractField.matrix_apply_eq_iff_sub
declarations.statement: lemma matrix_apply_eq_iff_sub : ⟪x, Λ *ᵥ y⟫ₘ = ⟪x, Λ' *ᵥ y⟫ₘ ↔ ⟪x, (Λ - Λ') *ᵥ y⟫ₘ = 0

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContractField.matrix_eq_iff_eq_forall'
declarations.statement:
lemma matrix_eq_iff_eq_forall' : (∀ (v : ContrMod d), (Λ *ᵥ v) = Λ' *ᵥ v) ↔
    ∀ (w v : ContrMod d), ⟪v, Λ *ᵥ w⟫ₘ = ⟪v, Λ' *ᵥ w⟫ₘ

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContractField.matrix_eq_iff_eq_forall
declarations.statement: lemma matrix_eq_iff_eq_forall : Λ = Λ' ↔ ∀ (w v : ContrMod d), ⟪v, Λ *ᵥ w⟫ₘ = ⟪v, Λ' *ᵥ w⟫ₘ

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContractField.matrix_eq_id_iff
declarations.statement: lemma matrix_eq_id_iff : Λ = 1 ↔ ∀ (w v : ContrMod d), ⟪v, Λ *ᵥ w⟫ₘ = ⟪v, w⟫ₘ

declarations.name: LorentzGroup.mem_iff_invariant
declarations.statement:
lemma _root_.LorentzGroup.mem_iff_invariant : Λ ∈ LorentzGroup d ↔
    ∀ (w v : ContrMod d), ⟪Λ *ᵥ v, Λ *ᵥ w⟫ₘ = ⟪v, w⟫ₘ

declarations.name: LorentzGroup.mem_iff_norm
declarations.statement:
lemma _root_.LorentzGroup.mem_iff_norm : Λ ∈ LorentzGroup d ↔
    ∀ (w : ContrMod d), ⟪Λ *ᵥ w, Λ *ᵥ w⟫ₘ = ⟪w, w⟫ₘ

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContractField.inl_sq_eq
declarations.statement:
lemma inl_sq_eq (v : ContrMod d) : v.val (Sum.inl 0) ^ 2 =
    (⟪v, v⟫ₘ) + ∑ i, v.val (Sum.inr i) ^ 2

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContractField.le_inl_sq
declarations.statement: lemma le_inl_sq (v : ContrMod d) : ⟪v, v⟫ₘ ≤ v.val (Sum.inl 0) ^ 2

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContractField.ge_abs_inner_product
declarations.statement:
lemma ge_abs_inner_product (v w : ContrMod d) : v.val (Sum.inl 0) * w.val (Sum.inl 0) -
    ‖⟪v.toSpace, w.toSpace⟫_ℝ‖ ≤ ⟪v, w⟫ₘ

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContractField.ge_sub_norm
declarations.statement:
lemma ge_sub_norm (v w : ContrMod d) : v.val (Sum.inl 0) * w.val (Sum.inl 0) -
    ‖v.toSpace‖ * ‖w.toSpace‖ ≤ ⟪v, w⟫ₘ

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContractField.basis_left
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_left {v : ContrMod d} (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    ⟪ ContrMod.stdBasis μ, v⟫ₘ = η μ μ * v.toFin1dℝ μ

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContractField.on_basis_mulVec
declarations.statement:
lemma on_basis_mulVec (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    ⟪ContrMod.stdBasis μ, Λ *ᵥ ContrMod.stdBasis ν⟫ₘ = η μ μ * Λ μ ν

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContractField.on_basis
declarations.statement: lemma on_basis (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) : ⟪ContrMod.stdBasis μ, ContrMod.stdBasis ν⟫ₘ = η μ ν

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContractField.matrix_apply_stdBasis
declarations.statement:
lemma matrix_apply_stdBasis (ν μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    Λ ν μ = η ν ν * ⟪ContrMod.stdBasis ν, Λ *ᵥ ContrMod.stdBasis μ⟫ₘ

declarations.name: Lorentz.contrContrContractField.same_eq_det_toSelfAdjoint
declarations.statement:
lemma same_eq_det_toSelfAdjoint (x : ContrMod 3) :
    ⟪x, x⟫ₘ = det (ContrMod.toSelfAdjoint x).1

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.contr_basis
declarations.statement:
lemma ContrMod.contr_basis {d : ℕ} (i j : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    ContrMod.contr (contrBasis d i ⊗ₜ coBasis d j) = if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0

declarations.name: Lorentz.CoMod.contr_basis
declarations.statement:
lemma CoMod.contr_basis {d : ℕ} (i j : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    CoMod.contr (coBasis d i ⊗ₜ[ℝ] contrBasis d j) = if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0

modules.doc:
## Modules associated with Real Lorentz vectors

We define the modules underlying real Lorentz vectors.

These definitions are preludes to the definitions of
`Lorentz.contr` and `Lorentz.co`.

sections.text:
## The norm

(Not the Minkowski norm, but the norm of a vector in `ContrMod d`.)

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod
declarations.doc: The module for contravariant (up-index) real Lorentz vectors.
declarations.statement:
structure ContrMod (d : ℕ) where
  /-- The underlying value as a vector `Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d → ℝ`. -/
  val : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d → ℝ

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.ext
declarations.statement: lemma ext {ψ ψ' : ContrMod d} (h : ψ.val = ψ'.val) : ψ = ψ'

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.toFin1dℝFun
declarations.doc: The equivalence between `ContrMod` and `Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d → ℝ`.
declarations.statement: def toFin1dℝFun : ContrMod d ≃ (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d → ℝ)

declarations.doc:
The instance of `AddCommGroup` on `ContrMod` defined via its equivalence
with `Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d → ℝ`.
declarations.statement: instance : AddCommGroup (ContrMod d)

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.toFin1dℝAddEquiv
declarations.doc: The additive equivalence between `ContrMod` and `Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d → ℝ`.
declarations.statement: def toFin1dℝAddEquiv : ContrMod d ≃+ (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d → ℝ)

declarations.doc:
The instance of `Module` on `ContrMod` defined via its equivalence
with `Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d → ℝ`.
declarations.statement: instance : Module ℝ (ContrMod d)

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.val_add
declarations.statement: lemma val_add (ψ ψ' : ContrMod d) : (ψ + ψ').val = ψ.val + ψ'.val

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.val_smul
declarations.statement: lemma val_smul (r : ℝ) (ψ : ContrMod d) : (r • ψ).val = r • ψ.val

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.toFin1dℝEquiv
declarations.doc: The linear equivalence between `ContrMod` and `(Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d → ℝ)`.
declarations.statement: def toFin1dℝEquiv : ContrMod d ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d → ℝ)

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.toFin1dℝ
declarations.doc:
The underlying element of `Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d → ℝ` of a element in `ContrMod` defined
through the linear equivalence `toFin1dℝEquiv`.
declarations.statement: abbrev toFin1dℝ (ψ : ContrMod d)

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.toFin1dℝ_eq_val
declarations.statement: lemma toFin1dℝ_eq_val (ψ : ContrMod d) : ψ.toFin1dℝ = ψ.val

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.stdBasis
declarations.doc: The standard basis of `ContrMod` indexed by `Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d`.
declarations.statement: def stdBasis : Basis (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℝ (ContrMod d)

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.stdBasis_toFin1dℝEquiv_apply_same
declarations.statement:
lemma stdBasis_toFin1dℝEquiv_apply_same (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) :
    toFin1dℝEquiv (stdBasis μ) μ = 1

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.stdBasis_apply_same
declarations.statement: lemma stdBasis_apply_same (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) : (stdBasis μ).val μ = 1

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.stdBasis_toFin1dℝEquiv_apply_ne
declarations.statement:
lemma stdBasis_toFin1dℝEquiv_apply_ne {μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d} (h : μ ≠ ν) :
    toFin1dℝEquiv (stdBasis μ) ν = 0

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.stdBasis_inl_apply_inr
declarations.statement: lemma stdBasis_inl_apply_inr (i : Fin d) : (stdBasis (Sum.inl 0)).val (Sum.inr i) = 0

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.stdBasis_apply
declarations.statement: lemma stdBasis_apply (μ ν : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) : (stdBasis μ).val ν = if μ = ν then 1 else 0

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.stdBasis_decomp
declarations.doc: Decomposition of a contravariant Lorentz vector into the standard basis.
declarations.statement: lemma stdBasis_decomp (v : ContrMod d) : v = ∑ i, v.toFin1dℝ i • stdBasis i

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.mulVec
declarations.doc: Multiplication of a matrix with a vector in `ContrMod`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev mulVec (M : Matrix (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℝ) (v : ContrMod d) :
    ContrMod d

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.mulVec_toFin1dℝ
declarations.statement:
lemma mulVec_toFin1dℝ (M : Matrix (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℝ) (v : ContrMod d) :
    (M *ᵥ v).toFin1dℝ = M *ᵥ v.toFin1dℝ

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.mulVec_val
declarations.statement:
lemma mulVec_val (M : Matrix (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℝ) (v : ContrMod d) :
    (M *ᵥ v).val = M *ᵥ v.val

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.mulVec_sub
declarations.statement:
lemma mulVec_sub (M : Matrix (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℝ) (v w : ContrMod d) :
    M *ᵥ (v - w) = M *ᵥ v - M *ᵥ w

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.sub_mulVec
declarations.statement:
lemma sub_mulVec (M N : Matrix (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℝ) (v : ContrMod d) :
    (M - N) *ᵥ v = M *ᵥ v - N *ᵥ v

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.mulVec_add
declarations.statement:
lemma mulVec_add (M : Matrix (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℝ) (v w : ContrMod d) :
    M *ᵥ (v + w) = M *ᵥ v + M *ᵥ w

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.one_mulVec
declarations.statement: lemma one_mulVec (v : ContrMod d) : (1 : Matrix (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℝ) *ᵥ v = v

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.mulVec_mulVec
declarations.statement:
lemma mulVec_mulVec (M N : Matrix (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℝ) (v : ContrMod d) :
    M *ᵥ (N *ᵥ v) = (M * N) *ᵥ v

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.norm
declarations.doc:
A `NormedAddCommGroup` structure on `ContrMod`. This is not an instance, as we
don't want it to be applied always.
declarations.statement: def norm : NormedAddCommGroup (ContrMod d)

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.toSpace
declarations.doc:
The underlying space part of a `ContrMod` formed by removing the first element.
A better name for this might be `tail`.
declarations.statement: def toSpace (v : ContrMod d) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.rep
declarations.doc: The representation of the Lorentz group acting on `ContrMod d`.
declarations.statement: def rep : Representation ℝ (LorentzGroup d) (ContrMod d)

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.rep_apply_toFin1dℝ
declarations.statement:
lemma rep_apply_toFin1dℝ (g : LorentzGroup d) (ψ : ContrMod d) :
    (rep g ψ).toFin1dℝ = g.1 *ᵥ ψ.toFin1dℝ

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.toSelfAdjoint
declarations.doc:
The linear equivalence between the vector-space `ContrMod 3` and self-adjoint
`2×2`-complex matrices.
declarations.statement: def toSelfAdjoint : ContrMod 3 ≃ₗ[ℝ] selfAdjoint (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.toSelfAdjoint_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma toSelfAdjoint_apply (x : ContrMod 3) : toSelfAdjoint x =
    x.toFin1dℝ (Sum.inl 0) • ⟨pauliMatrix (Sum.inl 0), pauliMatrix_selfAdjoint _⟩
    - x.toFin1dℝ (Sum.inr 0) • ⟨pauliMatrix (Sum.inr 0), pauliMatrix_selfAdjoint _⟩
    - x.toFin1dℝ (Sum.inr 1) • ⟨pauliMatrix (Sum.inr 1), pauliMatrix_selfAdjoint _⟩
    - x.toFin1dℝ (Sum.inr 2) • ⟨pauliMatrix (Sum.inr 2), pauliMatrix_selfAdjoint _⟩

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.toSelfAdjoint_apply_coe
declarations.statement:
lemma toSelfAdjoint_apply_coe (x : ContrMod 3) : (toSelfAdjoint x).1 =
    x.toFin1dℝ (Sum.inl 0) • PauliMatrix.pauliMatrix (Sum.inl 0)
    - x.toFin1dℝ (Sum.inr 0) • PauliMatrix.pauliMatrix (Sum.inr 0)
    - x.toFin1dℝ (Sum.inr 1) • PauliMatrix.pauliMatrix (Sum.inr 1)
    - x.toFin1dℝ (Sum.inr 2) • PauliMatrix.pauliMatrix (Sum.inr 2)

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.toSelfAdjoint_stdBasis
declarations.statement:
lemma toSelfAdjoint_stdBasis (i : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    toSelfAdjoint (stdBasis i) = PauliMatrix.pauliBasis' i

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.toSelfAdjoint_symm_basis
declarations.statement:
lemma toSelfAdjoint_symm_basis (i : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    toSelfAdjoint.symm (PauliMatrix.pauliBasis' i) = (stdBasis i)

declarations.doc:
The type `ContrMod d` carries an instance of a topological group, induced by
it's equivalence to `Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d → ℝ`.
declarations.statement: instance : TopologicalSpace (ContrMod d)

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.toFin1dℝEquiv_isInducing
declarations.statement: lemma toFin1dℝEquiv_isInducing : IsInducing (@ContrMod.toFin1dℝEquiv d)

declarations.name: Lorentz.ContrMod.toFin1dℝEquiv_symm_isInducing
declarations.statement: lemma toFin1dℝEquiv_symm_isInducing : IsInducing ((@ContrMod.toFin1dℝEquiv d).symm)

declarations.name: Lorentz.CoMod
declarations.doc: The module for covariant (up-index) complex Lorentz vectors.
declarations.statement:
structure CoMod (d : ℕ) where
  /-- The underlying value as a vector `Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d → ℝ`. -/
  val : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d → ℝ

declarations.name: Lorentz.CoMod.ext
declarations.statement: lemma ext {ψ ψ' : CoMod d} (h : ψ.val = ψ'.val) : ψ = ψ'

declarations.name: Lorentz.CoMod.toFin1dℝFun
declarations.doc: The equivalence between `CoℝModule` and `Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d → ℝ`.
declarations.statement: def toFin1dℝFun : CoMod d ≃ (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d → ℝ)

declarations.doc:
The instance of `AddCommGroup` on `CoℝModule` defined via its equivalence
with `Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d → ℝ`.
declarations.statement: instance : AddCommGroup (CoMod d)

declarations.name: Lorentz.CoMod.toFin1dℝAddEquiv
declarations.doc: The additive equivalence between `CoℝModule` and `Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d → ℝ`.
declarations.statement: def toFin1dℝAddEquiv : CoMod d ≃+ (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d → ℝ)

declarations.doc:
The instance of `Module` on `CoℝModule` defined via its equivalence

modules.title: Derivatives of Lorentz velocities
modules.doc:
Derivatives of unit four-velocity curves and the spatial-part constructor.

## i. Overview

Differentiating the normalization of a curve in `Lorentz.Velocity` gives orthogonality
of its value and derivative. The spatial-part constructor has an explicit derivative,
obtained from the squared Euclidean norm and the square-root chain rule. Derivatives are
taken in the ambient Lorentz vector space. For a worldline's four-velocity parametrized
by proper time, the derivative is four-acceleration.

## ii. Key results

- `Lorentz.Velocity.minkowskiProduct_eq_zero_of_hasDerivAt`: the derivative of a curve of
  unit four-velocities is Minkowski orthogonal to its value.
- `Lorentz.Velocity.hasDerivAt_ofSpatialPart`: the ambient derivative of the unit
  four-velocity determined by a differentiable spatial-part curve.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. Derivative orthogonality
- B. Derivative of the spatial-part constructor

## iv. References

The proofs use the bilinear derivative rule from `Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Mul`
and the squared-norm derivative from `Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Calculus`.

declarations.doc:
The ambient derivative of the unit future-directed four-velocity determined by
a differentiable spatial-part curve.
declarations.statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_ofSpatialPart {d : ℕ} {p : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)}
    {p' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)} {t : ℝ} (hp : HasDerivAt p p' t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => (ofSpatialPart (p s)).1)
      (Vector.ofTemporalComponent (inner ℝ (p t) p' / Real.sqrt (1 + ‖p t‖ ^ 2)) +
        Vector.ofSpatialComponent p') t

modules.title: Reindexing of tensor components
modules.doc:
In this file we give results related to the reindexing of tensors.
If a tensor has indices specified by a list of colors `c : Fin n → C`, then reindexing the
tensor corresponds to a bijection `σ : Fin m → Fin n` such that `c ∘ σ = c1` for some other
list of colors `c1 : Fin m → C`. A reindexing might take a tensor ψⁱⱼ to a tensor ψʲᵢ
by reordering the indices, or it might take a tensor ψⁱⱼᵏ to a tensor ψⁱᵏ.

We are interested in the interaction of reindexing with the following operations on tensors:
- `Fin.append` corresponds to the product of tensors.
- `Fin.succAbove` corresponds to the evaluation of a tensor at a given index.
- `Fin.succSuccAbove` corresponds to the contraction of a tensor at two given indices.

sections.text:
## Index maps

The finite index maps out of which the reindexings below are built: `Fin.append` for products and
`Fin.succAbove` for a deleted slot. The lemmas on `Fin.succSuccAbove`, for a deleted pair, are in
`Physlib.Relativity.Tensors.Contraction.SuccSuccAbove`.

declarations.name: Fin.append_castAdd_natAdd_eq_id
declarations.doc: Splitting `Fin (m + n)` into its two blocks and reassembling them is the identity.
declarations.statement:
lemma append_castAdd_natAdd_eq_id {m n : ℕ} :
    Fin.append (Fin.castAdd n) (Fin.natAdd m) = (id : Fin (m + n) → Fin (m + n))

declarations.name: Fin.append_succAbove_const_eq_cycleIcc
declarations.doc:
Moving slot `i` to the end is the cycle `[i, last]`: the block map that lists the
`i.succAbove` survivors in order and then `i` is `Fin.cycleIcc i (Fin.last n)`.
declarations.statement:
lemma append_succAbove_const_eq_cycleIcc {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Fin.append i.succAbove (fun _ : Fin 1 => i) = ⇑(Fin.cycleIcc i (Fin.last n))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing

Given two lists of indices `c : Fin n → C` and `c1 : Fin m → C` a map

- A bijection
- Forms a commutative triangle with `c` and `c1`.

lemma swap {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} (i j : Fin n) :
    IsReindexing c (c ∘ Equiv.swap i j) (Equiv.swap i j)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.symm
declarations.doc: The inverse of a map satisfying `IsReindexing c c1 σ` is a reindexing of `c1` by `c`.
declarations.statement:
lemma symm {n m : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} {c1 : Fin m → C}
    {σ : Fin m → Fin n} (h : IsReindexing c c1 σ) : IsReindexing c1 c (h.inv σ)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.symm_of_id
declarations.statement:
lemma symm_of_id {n : ℕ} {c c1 : Fin n → C} (h : IsReindexing c c1 id) :
    IsReindexing c1 c id

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.comp
declarations.doc: The composition of two maps satisfying `IsReindexing` also satisfies the `IsReindexing`.

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.append_congr_left
declarations.statement:
lemma append_congr_left {n n' n2 : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} {c' : Fin n' → C}
    {σ : Fin n' → Fin n} (c2 : Fin n2 → C) (h : IsReindexing c c' σ) :
    IsReindexing (Fin.append c c2) (Fin.append c' c2)
      (Fin.append (Fin.castAdd n2 ∘ σ) (Fin.natAdd n))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.append_congr_right
declarations.statement:
lemma append_congr_right {n n' n2 : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} {c' : Fin n' → C}
    {σ : Fin n' → Fin n} (c2 : Fin n2 → C) (h : IsReindexing c c' σ) :
    IsReindexing (Fin.append c2 c) (Fin.append c2 c')
      (Fin.append (Fin.castAdd n) (Fin.natAdd n2 ∘ σ))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.append_zero_right
declarations.statement:
lemma append_zero_right {n} {c : Fin n → C}
    {c1 : Fin 0 → C} : IsReindexing c (Fin.append c c1) id

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.append_swap
declarations.statement:
lemma append_swap {n n2 : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} {c2 : Fin n2 → C} :
    IsReindexing (Fin.append c c2) (Fin.append c2 c)
      (Fin.append (Fin.natAdd n) (Fin.castAdd n2))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.append_assoc_right
declarations.statement:
lemma append_assoc_right   {n1 n2 n3 : ℕ} {c : Fin n1 → C} {c2 : Fin n2 → C} {c3 : Fin n3 → C} :
    IsReindexing (Fin.append c (Fin.append c2 c3)) (Fin.append (Fin.append c c2) c3)
      (Fin.cast (by grind))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.append_assoc_left
declarations.statement:
lemma append_assoc_left {n1 n2 n3 : ℕ} {c : Fin n1 → C} {c2 : Fin n2 → C} {c3 : Fin n3 → C} :
    IsReindexing (Fin.append (Fin.append c c2) c3) (Fin.append c (Fin.append c2 c3))
      (Fin.cast (by grind))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.append_succAbove_natAdd
declarations.statement:
lemma append_succAbove_natAdd {n n1 : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} {c1 : Fin (n1 + 1) → C}
    (i : Fin (n1 + 1)) :
    IsReindexing (Fin.append c c1 ∘ (Fin.natAdd n i).succAbove)
      (Fin.append c (c1 ∘ i.succAbove)) id

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.append_succAbove_castAdd
declarations.statement:
lemma append_succAbove_castAdd {n n1 : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1) → C} {c1 : Fin (n1 + 1) → C}
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsReindexing (Fin.append c c1 ∘ (Fin.castAdd (n1 + 1) i).succAbove)
      (Fin.append (c ∘ i.succAbove) c1) (Fin.cast (by grind))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.append_succSuccAbove_natAdd
declarations.doc:
Removing two entries from the right component of `Fin.append c1 c` commutes with the
append: removing the `i`-th and `j`-th entries of `c` and then appending `c1` matches
removing the corresponding entries of `Fin.append c1 c`, via the identity permutation.
This is used for the commutation of taking a *product* of tensors
with *contraction* of indices.
declarations.statement:
lemma append_succSuccAbove_natAdd {n n1 : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    {c1 : Fin n1 → C} (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) :
    IsReindexing (Fin.append c1 c ∘ (Fin.natAdd n1 i).succSuccAbove (Fin.natAdd n1 j))
      (Fin.append c1 (c ∘ i.succSuccAbove j)) id

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.succAbove_of_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
Given a reindexing of `c` by `c1` via `σ` for which the index `i` is sent to `0`,
removing the `i`-th entry of `c1` and the first entry of `c` yields a reindexing of
`c ∘ Fin.succ` by `c1 ∘ i.succAbove` via the map sending `j` to the predecessor of
`σ (i.succAbove j)`.
declarations.statement:
lemma succAbove_of_eq_zero {n n1 : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1) → C} {c1 : Fin (n1 + 1) → C}
    {σ : Fin (n1 + 1) → Fin (n + 1)} (i : Fin (n1 + 1))
    (h : IsReindexing c c1 σ) (hi : σ i = 0) :
    IsReindexing (c ∘ Fin.succ) (c1 ∘ i.succAbove)
      (fun j => (σ (i.succAbove j)).pred (by simp [← hi, h.injective.eq_iff]))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.succAbove_of_neq_zero
declarations.doc:
Given a reindexing of `c` by `c1` via `σ` for which the index `i` is not sent to `0`,
removing the `i`-th entry of `c1` and the `(σ i)`-th entry of `c` yields a reindexing of
`c ∘ (σ i).succAbove` by `c1 ∘ i.succAbove` via the map
`(σ i).pred.predAbove ∘ σ ∘ i.succAbove`.
declarations.statement:
lemma succAbove_of_neq_zero {n n1 : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1) → C} {c1 : Fin (n1 + 1) → C}
    {σ : Fin (n1 + 1) → Fin (n + 1)} (i : Fin (n1 + 1))
    (h : IsReindexing c c1 σ) (hi : σ i ≠ 0) :
    IsReindexing (c ∘ (σ i).succAbove) (c1 ∘ i.succAbove)
      ((Fin.pred (σ i) hi).predAbove  ∘ σ ∘ i.succAbove)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.succAbove
declarations.doc:
Given a reindexing of `c` by `c1` via `σ`, removing the `i`-th entry of `c1` and the
`(σ i)`-th entry of `c` yields a reindexing of `c ∘ (σ i).succAbove` by `c1 ∘ i.succAbove`.
This unifies `succAbove_of_eq_zero` and `succAbove_of_neq_zero` via a case split on
whether `σ i = 0`. This is used for the commutation of *permutation*
of indices with *evaluation* of indices.

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.succAbove_of_succAbove_eq
declarations.doc:
The conclusion of `succAbove` from an explicit survivor relabelling: if `σ'` fills the square
`(σ i).succAbove ∘ σ' = σ ∘ i.succAbove`, carrying the complement of `i` to the complement of
`σ i`, then it is a reindexing of the two shortened colour lists. The square forces `σ'` to be
injective, hence bijective, so no bijectivity hypothesis is needed; this is why the statement is
restricted to equal lengths.

Where `succAbove` builds the relabelling from `σ` as a `dite` composite, the map here is the
caller's, which is what lets it stand in the statement of a lemma the caller instantiates.
declarations.statement:
lemma succAbove_of_succAbove_eq {n : ℕ} {c c1 : Fin (n + 1) → C}
    {σ : Fin (n + 1) → Fin (n + 1)} {σ' : Fin n → Fin n} (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (h : IsReindexing c c1 σ) (hσ' : (σ i).succAbove ∘ σ' = σ ∘ i.succAbove) :
    IsReindexing (c ∘ (σ i).succAbove) (c1 ∘ i.succAbove) σ'

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.succSuccAbove
declarations.doc:
Given a reindexing of `c` by `c1` via `σ` and two distinct indices `i ≠ j`, removing the
`i`-th and `j`-th entries of `c1` and the `(σ i)`-th and `(σ j)`-th entries of `c` yields a
reindexing of `c ∘ (σ i).succSuccAbove (σ j)` by `c1 ∘ i.succSuccAbove j`.
This is used for the commutation of *permutation* of indices with
*contraction* of indices.

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.succSuccAbove_comm
declarations.doc:
Removing two pairs of entries from `c` in either order gives the same colour list:
removing the `i1`-th and `j1`-th entries and then the (shifted) `i2`-th and `j2`-th entries
matches removing the `i2`-th and `j2`-th entries first and then the (shifted) `i1`-th and
`j1`-th entries, via the identity permutation.
This is used for the commutation of two *contractions*.

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.succAbove_succSuccAbove_comm
declarations.doc:
Removing one entry and then a pair of entries from `c` in either order gives the same
colour list: removing the `k`-th entry and then the (shifted) `i`-th and `j`-th entries
matches removing the `i`-th and `j`-th entries first and then the (shifted) `k`-th entry,
via the identity permutation.
This is used for the commutation of a *contraction* with an *evaluation*.

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.succSuccAbove_succAbove_comm
declarations.statement:
lemma succSuccAbove_succAbove_comm {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1 + 1) → C}
    (k : Fin (n + 1)) (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1 + 1)) :
    -- The corresponding position of k in the full list.
    let k' := Fin.succSuccAbove i j k
    let k'' := Fin.predAbove 0 k'
    -- The position of i after removing k'
    let i' := k''.predAbove i
    -- The position of j after removing k'
    let j' := k''.predAbove j
    IsReindexing ((c ∘ k'.succAbove) ∘ i'.succSuccAbove j')
      ((c ∘ i.succSuccAbove j) ∘ k.succAbove) id

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.succAbove_succAbove_comm
declarations.doc:
Removing two single entries from `c` in either order gives the same colour list:
removing the `k1`-th entry and then the (shifted) `k2`-th entry matches removing the
`k2`-th entry first and then the (shifted) `k1`-th entry, via the identity permutation.
This is used for the commutation of two *evaluations* of indices.

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.append_succ_last
declarations.doc:
Splitting a list of colours `c : Fin (n + 1) → C` into its first `n` entries and its
last entry recovers `c`: the identity permutation matches
`Fin.append (c ∘ (Fin.last n).succAbove) ![c (Fin.last n)]` with `c`.
declarations.statement:
lemma append_succ_last {n : ℕ} (c : Fin (n + 1) → C) :
    IsReindexing (Fin.append (c ∘ (Fin.last n).succAbove) ![c (Fin.last n)]) c id

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.move_last
declarations.doc:
Splitting a list of colours `c : Fin (n + 1) → C` at an arbitrary slot `i`, rather than at the
last one as in `append_succ_last`: the block map that lists the `i.succAbove` survivors and then
`i` itself matches `c` with the survivors of `i` followed by the surviving entry `c1 1` of a
rank-two list `c1` whose second entry is slot `i`'s colour.
declarations.statement:
lemma move_last {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1) → C} {c1 : Fin 2 → C} (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (hc : c i = c1 1) :
    IsReindexing c
      (Fin.append (c ∘ i.succAbove) (c1 ∘ (0 : Fin 2).succAbove))
      (Fin.append i.succAbove (fun _ : Fin 1 => i))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.update_update_of_eq
declarations.doc:
Updating slot `i` of `c` to `d` and then back to `e = c i` returns `c`, no other slot moving:
the colour cast a round trip of two contractions at slot `i` generates.
declarations.statement:
lemma update_update_of_eq {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} {d e : C} (i : Fin n) (he : c i = e) :
    IsReindexing c (Function.update (Function.update c i d) i e) (id : Fin n → Fin n)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.append_of_first
declarations.doc:
Splitting a list of colours `c : Fin (n + 1) → C` into its first entry and its remaining
`n` entries recovers `c`: the canonical reindexing `Fin (1 + n) ≃ Fin (n + 1)` matches
`Fin.append ![c 0] (c ∘ Fin.succAbove 0)` with `c`.
declarations.statement:
lemma append_of_first {n : ℕ} (c : Fin (n + 1) → C) :
    IsReindexing (Fin.append ![c 0] (c ∘ Fin.succAbove 0)) c (Fin.cast (by grind))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.fin_cast_isReindexing
declarations.doc:
Casting the domain along an equality `n1 = n` of lengths is a reindexing of `c` by
`c ∘ Fin.cast h`.
declarations.statement:
lemma fin_cast_isReindexing (n n1 : ℕ) {c : Fin n → C} (h : n1 = n) :
    IsReindexing c (c ∘ Fin.cast h) (Fin.cast h)

modules.title: Tensorial class
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

We define a class called `Tensorial`.
This class is used to enable the use of index notation on a type `M` via a linear equivalence to a
tensor of a `TensorSpecies`.

We define the class `Tensorial` here, and provide an API around its use.

## ii. Key results

- `Tensorial` : The class used to allow index notation on a type `M`.
- `Tensorial.numIndices` : The number of indices of an element of an `M`
  carrying a tensorial instance.
- `Tensorial.mulAction` : The action of the group `G` on a
  type `M` carrying a tensorial instance.
- `Tensorial.prod` : The product of two tensorial instances is a tensorial instance.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. Defining the tensorial class
  - A.1. Tensors carry a tensorial instance
  - A.2. The number of indices
- B. The action of the group on a module with a tensorial instance
  - B.1. Relation between the action and the equivalence to tensors
  - B.2. Linear properties of the action
  - B.3. The action as a linear map
  - B.4. The SMulCommClass property
- C. Properties of the basis
- D. Products of tensorial instances
  - D.1. The equivalence to tensors on products
  - D.2. The group action on products
  - D.3. The basis on products
- E. Continuous properties
  - E.1. Finite dimensionality
  - E.2. The map to tensors as a continuous linear equivalence
  - E.3. The Lorentz action as a continuous linear equivalence

## iv. References

* None.

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensorial
declarations.doc:
The tensorial class is used to define a tensor structure on a type `M` through a
linear equivalence with a module `S.Tensor c` for `S` a tensor species.
declarations.statement:
class Tensorial {n : outParam ℕ}

    {k : outParam Type} [CommRing k] {C : outParam Type} {G : outParam Type} [Group G]
    {V :outParam (C → Type)} [∀ c, AddCommGroup (V c)] [∀ c, Module k (V c)]
    {basisIdx : outParam (C → Type)} [∀ c, Fintype (basisIdx c)] [∀ c, DecidableEq (basisIdx c)]
    {rep : outParam ((c : C) → Representation k G (V c))}
    {b : outParam ((c : C) → Module.Basis (basisIdx c) k (V c))}
    (S : outParam (TensorSpecies k C G V basisIdx rep b))
    (c :outParam (Fin n → C)) (M : Type)
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module k M] where
  /-- The equivalence between `M` and `S.Tensor c` in a tensorial instance. -/
  toTensor : M ≃ₗ[k] S.Tensor c

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensorial.self
declarations.statement:
noncomputable instance self {n : ℕ} (S : TensorSpecies k C G V basisIdx rep b) (c : Fin n → C) :
    Tensorial S c (S.Tensor c)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensorial.self_toTensor_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma self_toTensor_apply {n : ℕ} (S : TensorSpecies k C G V basisIdx rep b)
    (c : Fin n → C) (t : S.Tensor c) :
    Tensorial.toTensor t = t

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensorial.numIndices
declarations.doc: The number of indices of a elements `t : M` where `M` carries a tensorial instance.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def numIndices (t : M) [Tensorial S c M] : ℕ

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensorial.mulAction
declarations.statement: noncomputable instance mulAction [Tensorial S c M] : MulAction G M

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensorial.smul_eq
declarations.statement:
lemma smul_eq {g : G} {t : M} [Tensorial S c M] :
    g • t = toTensor.symm (g • toTensor t)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensorial.toTensor_smul
declarations.statement:
lemma toTensor_smul {g : G} {t : M} [Tensorial S c M] :
    toTensor (g • t) = g • toTensor t

declarations.statement:
lemma smul_toTensor_symm {g : G} {t : Tensor S c} [self : Tensorial S c M] :
    g • (toTensor (self := self).symm t) = toTensor.symm (g • t)

declarations.statement:
lemma smulLinearMap_apply {g : G} [Tensorial S c M] (m : M) :

instance [Tensorial S c M] : SMulCommClass k G M
instance [Tensorial S c M] : SMulCommClass G k M

lemma basis_toTensor_apply [Tensorial S c M] (m : M) :
    (Tensor.basis c).repr (toTensor m) = ((Tensor.basis c).map toTensor.symm).repr m

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensorial.prod
TensorSpecies.Tensorial.toTensor_tprod
declarations.statement:
lemma toTensor_tprod {n2 : ℕ} {c2 : Fin n2 → C} {M₂ : Type}
    [Tensorial S c M] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [Module k M₂]
    [Tensorial S c2 M₂] (m : M) (m2 : M₂) :
    toTensor (m ⊗ₜ[k] m2) = Tensor.prodT (toTensor m) (toTensor m2)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensorial.smul_prod
declarations.statement:
lemma smul_prod {n2 : ℕ} {c2 : Fin n2 → C} {M₂ : Type}
    [Tensorial S c M] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [Module k M₂]
    [Tensorial S c2 M₂] (g : G) (m : M) (m2 : M₂) :
    g • (m ⊗ₜ[k] m2) = (g • m) ⊗ₜ[k] (g • m2)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensorial.basis_map_prod
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_map_prod {n2 : ℕ} {c2 : Fin n2 → C} {M₂ : Type}
    [Tensorial S c M] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [Module k M₂]
    [Tensorial S c2 M₂] :
    (Tensor.basis (S := S) (Fin.append c c2)).map
      (toTensor (M := (M ⊗[k] M₂))).symm =
    (((Tensor.basis (S := S) c).map (toTensor (M := M)).symm).tensorProduct
    ((Tensor.basis (S := S) c2).map (toTensor (M := M₂)).symm)).reindex
    (ComponentIdx.prod.symm)
