TensorSpecies.Tensorial.prod_tensor_basis_eq_map_reindex
TensorSpecies.Tensorial.prod_eq_sum_eval
declarations.doc:
Double basis expansion of an element of a tensor product `M ⊗[k] M₂` of two `Tensorial`
one-index spaces. Given bases `b`, `b2` of `M`, `M₂` coming from the single-index tensor bases,
every `x : M ⊗[k] M₂` is the double sum over `i, j` of the iterated evaluation coefficient
`toScalar (evalT 0 j (evalT 0 i (toTensor x)))` times `b i ⊗ₜ b2 j`.

declarations.statement: instance [Tensorial S c M] : FiniteDimensional k M

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensorial.toTensorCLM
declarations.doc:
The map from a type carrying an Tensorial instance to tensors, as a
continuous linear map.
declarations.statement:
def toTensorCLM [IsTopologicalAddGroup M]
    [ContinuousSMul k M] [Tensorial S c M] [T2Space M] : M ≃L[k] (S.Tensor c)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensorial.actionCLM
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz action on types carrying a tensorial instance as a continuous linear
map.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def actionCLM (g : G) [IsTopologicalAddGroup M]
    [ContinuousSMul k M] [Tensorial S c M] [T2Space M] : M →L[k] M

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensorial.actionCLM_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma actionCLM_apply {g : G} [IsTopologicalAddGroup M]
    [ContinuousSMul k M] [Tensorial S c M] [T2Space M] (m : M) :
    actionCLM S g m = g • m

modules.title: Tensor species
modules.doc:
- A tensor species is a structure including all of the ingredients needed to define a type of
  tensor.
- Examples of tensor species will include real Lorentz tensors, complex Lorentz tensors, and
  Einstein tensors.
- Tensor species are built upon symmetric monoidal categories.

declarations.name: TensorSpecies
declarations.doc:
The structure `TensorSpecies` contains the necessary structure needed to define
a system of tensors with index notation. Examples of `TensorSpecies` include real Lorentz tensors,
complex Lorentz tensors, and ordinary Euclidean tensors.
declarations.statement:
structure TensorSpecies (k : Type) [CommRing k] (C : Type) (G : Type) [Group G]
    (V : C → Type) [∀ c, AddCommGroup (V c)] [∀ c, Module k (V c)]
    (basisIdx : C → Type) [∀ c, Fintype (basisIdx c)] [∀ c, DecidableEq (basisIdx c)]
    (rep : (c : C) → Representation k G (V c)) (basis : (c : C) → Basis (basisIdx c) k (V c)) where
  /-- A map from `C` to `C`. An involution. -/
  τ : C → C
  /-- The condition that `τ` is an involution. -/
  τ_involution : Function.Involutive τ
  /-- The contraction of vectors with dual colors. -/
  contr : (c : C) → ((rep c).tprod (rep (τ c))).IntertwiningMap (Representation.trivial k G k)
  /-- The invariant unit tensor for a given color. -/
  unit : (c : C) → ((Representation.trivial k G k)).IntertwiningMap ((rep (τ c)).tprod (rep c))
  /-- Contraction is symmetric with respect to duals. -/
  contr_tmul_symm : ∀ c (x : V c) (y : V (τ c)),
      contr c (x ⊗ₜ[k] y) = contr (τ c) (y ⊗ₜ Equiv.cast (congrArg V (τ_involution c).symm) x)
  /-- The unit is symmetric. -/
  unit_symm : ∀ c, unit c (1 : k) =
      LinearMap.lTensor _ (LinearEquiv.cast (τ_involution c)).toLinearMap
      (TensorProduct.comm k _ _ (unit (τ c) (1 : k)))
  /-- Contraction with unit leaves invariant. -/
  contr_unit : ∀ c (x : V c),
    (TensorProduct.lid k _ <|
    (contr c).toLinearMap.rTensor _ <|
    (TensorProduct.assoc k (V c) (V (τ c)) (V c)).symm <|
    x ⊗ₜ[k] (unit c (1 : k))) = x

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.basisIdxCongr
declarations.doc: The casting between `basisIdx c` and `basisIdx c1`.
declarations.statement:
def basisIdxCongr {c c1 : C} (h : c = c1) :
    basisIdx c ≃ basisIdx c1

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.basisIdxCongr_rfl
declarations.statement:
lemma basisIdxCongr_rfl (c : C) (i : basisIdx c) :
    basisIdxCongr (Eq.refl c) i = i

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.basisIdxCongr_symm
declarations.statement:
lemma basisIdxCongr_symm {c c1 : C} (h : c = c1) (i : basisIdx c1) :
    (basisIdxCongr h).symm i = basisIdxCongr h.symm i

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.basisIdxCongr_apply_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma basisIdxCongr_apply_apply {c c1 c2 : C} (h1 : c = c1) (h2 : c1 = c2) (i : basisIdx c) :
    basisIdxCongr h2 (basisIdxCongr h1 i) = basisIdxCongr (by simp [h1, h2]) i

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.basisIdxCongr_heq_arg
declarations.doc:
`basisIdxCongr` only depends on its endpoints up to `HEq` of the arguments: equal target
colours and heterogeneously equal labels give equal casts.
declarations.statement:
lemma basisIdxCongr_heq_arg {c1 c2 d : C} (h1 : c1 = d) (h2 : c2 = d)
    {x : basisIdx c1} {y : basisIdx c2} (hxy : HEq x y) :
    basisIdxCongr h1 x = basisIdxCongr h2 y

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.basisIdxCongr_heq
declarations.doc: A transported label is heterogeneously equal to the original.
declarations.statement: lemma basisIdxCongr_heq {c c1 : C} (h : c = c1) (x : basisIdx c) : basisIdxCongr h x ≍ x

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.basisIdxCongr_const
declarations.doc:
For a species whose every colour carries the same label type `I`, a label transport is the
identity.
declarations.statement:
lemma basisIdxCongr_const {I : Type} {c c1 : C} (h : c = c1) :
    basisIdxCongr (basisIdx := fun _ : C => I) h = Equiv.refl I

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.τ_τ_apply
declarations.statement: lemma τ_τ_apply (c : C) : S.τ (S.τ c) = c

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.basis_congr
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_congr {c c1 : C} (h : c = c1) (i : basisIdx c) :
    basis c i = LinearEquiv.cast (R := k) h.symm (basis c1 (basisIdxCongr h i))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.map_basis_eq
declarations.statement:
lemma map_basis_eq {c c1 : C} (h : c = c1) (i : basisIdx c) :
    LinearEquiv.cast (R := k) h (basis c i) = basis c1 (basisIdxCongr h i)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.contr_basis_congr
declarations.doc:
The contraction of two basis vectors does not change when their colour is transported along an
equality and their labels with it.
declarations.statement:
lemma contr_basis_congr {a a' : C} (h : a = a') (x : basisIdx a) (y : basisIdx (S.τ a)) :
    S.contr a (basis a x ⊗ₜ[k] basis (S.τ a) y) =
      S.contr a' (basis a' (basisIdxCongr h x) ⊗ₜ[k]
        basis (S.τ a') (basisIdxCongr (congrArg S.τ h) y))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.equivCast_basis
declarations.doc:
`map_basis_eq` with the cast spelled `Equiv.cast`, the form `contr_tmul_symm` applies to its
first vector.
declarations.statement:
lemma equivCast_basis {c c1 : C} (h : c = c1) (i : basisIdx c) :
    Equiv.cast (congrArg V h) (basis c i) = basis c1 (basisIdxCongr h i)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.numIndices
declarations.doc: The number of indices `n` from a tensor.
declarations.statement:
def numIndices {S : TensorSpecies k C G V basisIdx rep basis} {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C}
    (_ : PiTensorProduct k (fun i => V (c i))) : ℕ

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.WithMetric
declarations.doc:
Instance of a metric on a tensor species. For each color `c` an invariant tensor
in `V c ⊗ V c`, whose contraction against the metric of the dual color `τ c` is the unit.
Not every species has one: it requires every color to be self-dual,
which fails for the fundamental of `SU(N)`, `3 ≤ N`.
declarations.statement:
class WithMetric {k : Type} [CommRing k] {C : Type} {G : Type} [Group G]
    {V : C → Type} [∀ c, AddCommGroup (V c)] [∀ c, Module k (V c)]
    {basisIdx : C → Type} [∀ c, Fintype (basisIdx c)] [∀ c, DecidableEq (basisIdx c)]
    {rep : (c : C) → Representation k G (V c)} {basis : (c : C) → Basis (basisIdx c) k (V c)}
    (S : TensorSpecies k C G V basisIdx rep basis) where
  /-- The invariant metric tensor for a given color. -/
  metric : (c : C) → ((Representation.trivial k G k)).IntertwiningMap ((rep c).tprod (rep c))
  /-- On contracting metrics we get the unit. -/
  contr_metric : ∀ c,
    (TensorProduct.comm k _ _ <|
      (TensorProduct.lid k _).lTensor _ <|
      ((S.contr c).toLinearMap.rTensor (V (S.τ c))).lTensor (V c) <|
      (TensorProduct.assoc k (V c) (V (S.τ c)) (V (S.τ c))).symm.toLinearMap.lTensor (V c) <|
      TensorProduct.assoc k (V c) (V c) (V (S.τ c) ⊗[k] V (S.τ c)) <|
      (metric c 1) ⊗ₜ[k] (metric (S.τ c) 1)) = S.unit c (1 : k)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.metric
declarations.doc: The metric of a species with a metric, at the color `c`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev metric [S.WithMetric] (c : C) :
    ((Representation.trivial k G k)).IntertwiningMap ((rep c).tprod (rep c))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.contr_metric
declarations.doc: On contracting metrics we get the unit.
declarations.statement:
lemma contr_metric [S.WithMetric] (c : C) :
    (TensorProduct.comm k _ _ <|
      (TensorProduct.lid k _).lTensor _ <|
      ((S.contr c).toLinearMap.rTensor (V (S.τ c))).lTensor (V c) <|
      (TensorProduct.assoc k (V c) (V (S.τ c)) (V (S.τ c))).symm.toLinearMap.lTensor (V c) <|
      TensorProduct.assoc k (V c) (V c) (V (S.τ c) ⊗[k] V (S.τ c)) <|
      (S.metric c 1) ⊗ₜ[k] (S.metric (S.τ c) 1)) = S.unit c (1 : k)

modules.title: Species whose bases at dual colors are dual bases
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

This file defines `HasContrDualBases`: species whose basis at `S.τ c` is dual to the basis at `c`
under the pairing `S.contr c`.

A matching `e : basisIdx (S.τ c) ≃ basisIdx c` satisfies the δ law (`IsContrDualMatching`) if
`S.contr c (b c x₁ ⊗ₜ b (S.τ c) x₂) = if x₁ = e x₂ then 1 else 0`. The class asks for one such
matching at every color, so the label types need only be in bijection.

Over a nontrivial ring the matching is unique (`IsContrDualMatching.unique`). Hence
`contrDualIdxEquiv`, although picked by choice, is the only matching, so nothing depends on the
choice. A concrete species identifies it through `contrDualIdxEquiv_eq_of_isContrDualMatching`,
and the double-dual law `contrDualIdxEquiv_tau` is a theorem.

The contraction functionals are the dual basis of `b c` (`contr_tmul_basis_eq_dualBasis`).
Contracted basis vectors have δ coefficients (`Pure.contrPCoeff_basisVector`), and components of a
contraction are single sums (`contrT_basis_repr_apply_eq_sum_dual`).

## ii. Key results

- `TensorSpecies.IsContrDualMatching.unique` : the δ law determines the matching.
- `TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases` : the class.
- `TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv` : the matching of the labels at `S.τ c`
    with those at `c`.
- `TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases.contr_basis_eq_ite` : the δ law for `contrDualIdxEquiv`.
- `TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv_eq_of_isContrDualMatching` : any matching
    satisfying the δ law is `contrDualIdxEquiv`.
- `TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases.dualIdxEquiv` : the equivalence between labels of dual
    indices.
- `TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv_tau` : the matching at `S.τ c` is the
    inverse of the one at `c`, through `S.τ (S.τ c) = c`.
- `TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases.dualIdxEquiv_symm` : the inverse of `dualIdxEquiv` from `c1`
    to `c2` is `dualIdxEquiv` from `c2` to `c1`.
- `TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases.contr_tmul_basis_eq_dualBasis` : contracting with a basis vector
    at `S.τ c` is an element of `Module.Basis.dualBasis`.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. Matchings satisfying the δ law
- B. The class
- C. The matching
- D. The double dual
- E. The dual basis

## iv. References

There are no known references for the material in this module.

sections.text: ## A. Matchings satisfying the δ law

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.IsContrDualMatching
declarations.doc:
A matching `e` of the basis labels at `S.τ c` with those at `c` satisfies the δ law:
contracting a basis vector at `c` with one at `S.τ c` gives `1` if `e` matches their labels and
`0` otherwise.
declarations.statement:
def IsContrDualMatching (S : TensorSpecies k C G V basisIdx rep b) (c : C)
    (e : basisIdx (S.τ c) ≃ basisIdx c) : Prop

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.IsContrDualMatching.unique
declarations.doc:
Over a nontrivial ring the δ law determines the matching: the label matched with `x₂` is the
one whose basis vector pairs with `b (S.τ c) x₂` to `1`.

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases
declarations.doc:
A tensor species whose basis at `S.τ c` is dual to its basis at `c` under the pairing
`S.contr c`: for every color some matching of the labels satisfies the δ law.
declarations.statement:
class HasContrDualBases (S : TensorSpecies k C G V basisIdx rep b) : Prop where
  /-- At every color, some matching of the labels at `S.τ c` with those at `c` satisfies the δ
    law. -/
  exists_matching : ∀ c, ∃ e, IsContrDualMatching S c e

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv
declarations.doc:
A matching of the basis labels at `S.τ c` with those at `c` satisfying the δ law, chosen by
`Classical.choose`. Over a nontrivial ring it is the only one
(`contrDualIdxEquiv_eq_of_isContrDualMatching`).
declarations.statement: noncomputable def contrDualIdxEquiv (c : C) : basisIdx (S.τ c) ≃ basisIdx c

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases.contr_basis_eq_ite
declarations.doc: The δ law for `contrDualIdxEquiv`.
declarations.statement:
lemma contr_basis_eq_ite (c : C) (x₁ : basisIdx c) (x₂ : basisIdx (S.τ c)) :
    S.contr c (b c x₁ ⊗ₜ[k] b (S.τ c) x₂) =
      if x₁ = contrDualIdxEquiv S c x₂ then 1 else 0

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv_eq_of_isContrDualMatching
declarations.doc:
Any matching satisfying the δ law is `contrDualIdxEquiv`. This is how a concrete species
identifies its matching.

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases.dualIdxEquiv
declarations.doc:
The equivalence between labels of dual indices: a label at `c1` carried across the variance
dual by `contrDualIdxEquiv`, then along `h`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def dualIdxEquiv {c1 c2 : C} (h : S.τ c1 = c2) : basisIdx c1 ≃ basisIdx c2

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases.dualIdxEquiv_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma dualIdxEquiv_apply {c1 c2 : C} (h : S.τ c1 = c2) (x : basisIdx c1) :
    dualIdxEquiv h x = basisIdxCongr h ((contrDualIdxEquiv S c1).symm x)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv_tau
declarations.doc:
The matching at `S.τ c` is the inverse of the one at `c`, once `S.τ (S.τ c)` is identified
with `c` by `S.τ_τ_apply`. The inverse matching satisfies the δ law at `S.τ c` by
`contr_tmul_symm`, so uniqueness identifies the two.
declarations.statement:
lemma contrDualIdxEquiv_tau [Nontrivial k] (c : C) (x : basisIdx (S.τ (S.τ c))) :
    contrDualIdxEquiv S (S.τ c) x =
      (contrDualIdxEquiv S c).symm (basisIdxCongr (S.τ_τ_apply c) x)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases.dualIdxEquiv_symm
declarations.doc: The inverse of `dualIdxEquiv` from `c1` to `c2` is `dualIdxEquiv` from `c2` to `c1`.
declarations.statement:
lemma dualIdxEquiv_symm [Nontrivial k] {c1 c2 : C} (h : S.τ c1 = c2) (h' : S.τ c2 = c1) :
    (dualIdxEquiv h).symm = dualIdxEquiv h'

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.HasContrDualBases.contr_tmul_basis_eq_dualBasis
declarations.doc:
The functional `v ↦ S.contr c (v ⊗ₜ b (S.τ c) x)` is the element of `(b c).dualBasis` at the
label matched with `x`.
declarations.statement:
lemma contr_tmul_basis_eq_dualBasis (c : C) (x : basisIdx (S.τ c)) (v : V c) :
    S.contr c (v ⊗ₜ[k] b (S.τ c) x) = (b c).dualBasis (contrDualIdxEquiv S c x) v

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.unitTensor
declarations.doc: The unit tensor associated with a color `c`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def unitTensor (c : C) : S.Tensor ![S.τ c, c]

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.unitTensor_basis_repr
declarations.doc:
A component of the unit tensor is the corresponding component of the unit intertwiner in the
tensor-product basis.
declarations.statement:
lemma unitTensor_basis_repr (c : C) (φ : ComponentIdx (S := S) ![S.τ c, c]) :
    (Tensor.basis _).repr (unitTensor (S := S) c) φ =
      (Module.Basis.tensorProduct (b (S.τ c)) (b c)).repr ((S.unit c) (1 : k))
        (φ 0, φ 1)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.unitTensor_congr
declarations.statement:
lemma unitTensor_congr {c c1 : C} (h : c = c1) :
    unitTensor c = permT id (by simp [h]) (unitTensor (S := S) c1)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.unitTensor_eq_permT_dual
declarations.doc: The unit tensor is symmetric on dualing the color.
declarations.statement:
lemma unitTensor_eq_permT_dual (c : C) :
    S.unitTensor c = permT ![1, 0] (And.intro (by decide) (fun i => by fin_cases i <;> simp))
    (unitTensor (S.τ c))

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.dual_unitTensor_eq_permT_unitTensor
declarations.statement:
lemma dual_unitTensor_eq_permT_unitTensor (c : C) :
    S.unitTensor (S.τ c) = permT ![1, 0] (And.intro (by decide) (fun i => by fin_cases i <;> simp))
      (unitTensor c)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.unit_fromSingleTContrFromPairT_eq_fromSingleT
declarations.statement:
lemma unit_fromSingleTContrFromPairT_eq_fromSingleT {c : C} (x : V c) :
    fromSingleTContrFromPairT x ((S.unit c) (1 : k)) =
    fromSingleT x

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.contrT_single_unitTensor
declarations.doc: This lemma represents the de-categorification of `S.contr_unit`.
declarations.statement:
lemma contrT_single_unitTensor {c : C} (x : Tensor S ![c]) :
    contrT 1 0 1 (by simp; rfl) (prodT x (unitTensor c)) =
    permT id (by simp; rfl) x

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.contrT_unitTensor_dual_single
declarations.statement:
lemma contrT_unitTensor_dual_single {c : C} (x : Tensor S ![S.τ c]) :
    contrT 1 1 2 (by simp; rfl) (prodT (unitTensor c) x) =
    permT id (by simp; rfl) x

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.unitTensor_invariant
declarations.statement:
lemma unitTensor_invariant {c : C} (g : G) :
    g • S.unitTensor c = S.unitTensor c

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.unitTensor_pair_basis_repr
declarations.doc:
For a species with dual bases at dual colours, the unit tensor's components are a Kronecker δ,
the first label carried across the variance dual by `contrDualIdxEquiv`.
declarations.statement:
lemma unitTensor_pair_basis_repr [HasContrDualBases S] (c : C) (J y : basisIdx c) :
    (basis ![S.τ c, c]).repr (unitTensor c)
        (ComponentIdx.pair.symm ((HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv S c).symm J, y)) =
      if J = y then 1 else 0

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.unitTensor_basis_repr_eq_ite
declarations.doc: `unitTensor_pair_basis_repr` at an arbitrary component index.
declarations.statement:
lemma unitTensor_basis_repr_eq_ite [HasContrDualBases S] (c : C)
    (φ : ComponentIdx (S := S) ![S.τ c, c]) :
    (basis ![S.τ c, c]).repr (unitTensor c) φ =
      if HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv S c (φ 0) = φ 1 then 1 else 0

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix_permT_unitTensor
declarations.doc:
The component matrix of a unit tensor recoloured without moving its slots is the identity, with
the labels transported back to the unit tensor's colours.
declarations.statement:
lemma toMatrix_permT_unitTensor [HasContrDualBases S] (c : C) {cs : Fin 2 → C}
    {σ : Fin 2 → Fin 2} (hσ : ∀ i, σ i = i) (hperm : IsReindexing ![S.τ c, c] cs σ) :
    toMatrix (permT σ hperm (unitTensor (S := S) c)) =
      (1 : Matrix (basisIdx c) (basisIdx c) k).submatrix
        (fun x => HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv S c
          (basisIdxCongr (by rw [← hperm.2 0, hσ]; rfl) x))
        (fun y => basisIdxCongr (by rw [← hperm.2 1, hσ]; rfl) y)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix_unitTensor
declarations.doc: The unit tensor's component matrix is the identity, carried along `contrDualIdxEquiv`.
declarations.statement:
lemma toMatrix_unitTensor [HasContrDualBases S] (c : C) :
    toMatrix (unitTensor (S := S) c) =
      (1 : Matrix (basisIdx c) (basisIdx c) k).submatrix
        ⇑(HasContrDualBases.contrDualIdxEquiv S c) id

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.unitTensor_of_tau_eq
declarations.doc:
If `τ e = a`, the identity is a reindexing from `![τ e, e]` to `![a, e]`, so `permT` renames the
colours of `unitTensor e` to `![a, e]`.
declarations.statement:
lemma IsReindexing.unitTensor_of_tau_eq {a e : C} (h : S.τ e = a) :
    IsReindexing (![S.τ e, e] : Fin 2 → C) ![a, e] (id : Fin 2 → Fin 2)

declarations.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toMatrix_permT_unitTensor_of_tau_eq
declarations.doc:
The matrix of `unitTensor e`, with its colours renamed to `![a, e]`, is the identity matrix with
its rows relabelled by `dualIdxEquiv h`.
declarations.statement:
lemma toMatrix_permT_unitTensor_of_tau_eq [HasContrDualBases S] {a e : C} (h : S.τ e = a) :
    toMatrix (permT id (IsReindexing.unitTensor_of_tau_eq h) (unitTensor (S := S) e)) =
      (1 : Matrix (basisIdx e) (basisIdx e) k).submatrix (dualIdxEquiv h).symm id
